cards.name: GRIEF
cards.creator: icedcave
cards.description: One of the most anticipated top 1s in the game's history, with a verification process spanning 396 streams and a cumulative playtime of 922 hours; currently the hardest level in the game.
cards.note:
Mostly used for trading, or completing index's
Holo: just hypergamy bro..

cards.name: Artemis 13
cards.creator: mango
cards.description: A monochrome design level featuring many clubstep monsters scattered throughout. It was originally harder before being nerfed by Zoink following a controversy surrounding the original host. Features an extremely hard ship at 19%.
cards.note:
Wanted for index preety much
less wanted then grief for sure
8.9/10 imo

cards.name: Society
cards.creator: Neomarbilan
cards.description: The sequel to Escalator and a nerfed impossible level. Featuring a dreamcore/weirdcore aesthetic, it is filled with references and explores themes of mental instability.
cards.note:
Only popular because former top 1

- cduking

cards.name: Thinking Space II
cards.creator: CairoX
cards.description: An official sequel to Thinking Space and former top 1. Unlike the original, its decoration is in a glow design style, but it's more similar in gameplay as it has several gameplay references to the original and is also extremely end carried. The first top 1 in many years that was not built intentionally to be top 1.

cards.name: Amethyst
cards.creator: iMist
cards.description: A former top 1, dethroning Tidal Wave after two years. It's inspired by The Golden, including a cave decoration with rocks, geodes, and purple and pink crystals. The gameplay consists of a lot of extremely hard waves and ship gameplay, similar to The Golden but with an extension and a random 240 frame perfect first click.

cards.name: Flamewall
cards.creator: Narwall
cards.description: Almost seven minutes of extremely fast and challenging gameplay, using a similarly very fast and dramatic symphonic metal song, and featuring very few break sections for its length. Features a gargantuan roster of creators and took multiple years to come out, in part thanks to the verifier dying at 99% twice.

cards.name: Tidal Wave
cards.creator: OniLinkGD
cards.description: A former Top 1 and Onilink's first rated level, featuring incredibly difficult wave sections spread over its 3 minute runtime. Unlike most other top 1s, this level takes a very different approach to its style, theming it around the ocean and the beach with its blue and yellow colour scheme.

cards.name: Green Bullet
cards.creator: cherryteam
cards.description: Formerly known as “0 Bullet,” Created in collaboration with MiNaY & cherryteam as their hardest level yet. It showcases a neon-green structure throughout, and has fast-paced timings with excruciatingly tight gaps in-between. Its placement kicked Zodiac out of the top 150 after over 7 years.

cards.name: ORBIT
cards.creator: MindCap
cards.description: One of Mindcap's most ambitious projects to date, filled with over 2 minutes of fast-paced timings, all of which are orb clicks. The decoration is themed around space and gravity with depictions of celestial objects, black holes, and a ship part where you travel through a wormhole. Don't fall into The Ball Pit™.

cards.name: Antarctic Lights
cards.creator: declanlc
cards.description: The current hardest Nine Circles level in the game. Remake of Arctic Lights with improved decoration and a gigantic increase in difficulty, which is why it took almost 3 years to get verified.

cards.name: Nullscapes
cards.creator: ItzKiba
cards.description: The sequel to Shardscapes and the current hardest level to use one gamemode, that being robot. Expanding on its predecessor, it features more noticeable progression, an orb cycling gimmick and most importantly much more unforgiving gameplay. Includes a CBF blocker which has sparked a significant amount of controversy within the community.
cards.note: Often used as a filler for higher trades

cards.name: Quanteuse processing
cards.creator: Renn241
cards.description: An uncanny and extremely raw superbuffed remake of the main level Blast Processing, with gameplay by Renn241 and Blankb. Not meant to be a serious level.
cards.note: Often used as a filler for higher trades

cards.name: BOOBAWAMBA
cards.creator: akunakun
cards.description: The current hardest memory extreme, themed around a dark abandoned factory with limited visibility. Features a randomized ending where five details throughout the level determine whether or not to click their corresponding toggle triggers. Built over the course of two years and thousands of hours, Akunakun considers this his magnum opus.
cards.note: VERY Often used as a filler for higher trades

cards.name: The Bloop
cards.creator: murkkat
cards.note: Forgotten card

cards.name: Every End
cards.creator: MindCap
cards.description: The hardest endurance level in Geometry Dash, featuring over 7 minutes of simple yet brutal 1.0 cube timings. Its difficulty balancing and specific skillset have lead it to being very accessible for a top level. Despite its simple 1.0 aesthetic, its technically impressive background effect involved the usage of third party software developed by Absolute.

cards.name: Ashley Wave Trials
cards.creator: oddmod
cards.description: A level with a pink/red color scheme that is entirely wave, as the name suggests. The level remained unrated until CBF was added to the game and the level was eventually rated a while later.
cards.note:
this card is the son of a devil
overpriced as hell

cards.name: Silent clubstep
cards.creator: TheRealSailent
cards.description: One of the most legendary and recognizable levels in Geometry Dash. Formerly impossible and was initially hack-verified by Sailent in 1.8. Houses the "8 Jumps of Hell" and the infamous 6% ship part, among other classic sections.
cards.note: scs is extremely overpaid for, added very often in trades

cards.name: Ultra Paracosm
cards.creator: declanlc
cards.description: Superbuffed remake of Hyper Paracosm, created by declanlc and Renn241. Notably extremely first half heavy, with most of the difficulty concentrated in the first wave parts. Sadly not the easy demon

cards.name: Penumbral
cards.creator: cherryteam
cards.description: Currently the second-hardest CherryTeam level on the list, featuring an intense, flashy monochromatic palette and brutal ship and wave chokepoints. The first extreme demon to use xStep as its song.

cards.name: andromeda
cards.creator: Insxne97
cards.description: Relatively unknown considering its difficulty. Pink and purple space themed level with incredibly high-CPS gameplay and flashy visuals. Took over a year to be completed.
cards.note: very wacky price rating. either overpriced, fair or underpriced, really depends on the trade and context

cards.name: KILLSTEALER
cards.creator: Rynoxious
cards.description: An old XXL+ mega-collab that began way back in 2020 and was finished and verified more than half a decade later. The gameplay features many epic, but nerve-racking and learny parts, including the last ship closing in at the end. Despite its age, the gameplay is really well done and polished for its time, especially the decoration and song representation.

cards.name: Subsuming Vortex
cards.creator: Cursed
cards.description: Created all the way in 2018 by SeptaGon7 and redecorated by Renn241. The name is a reference to a Calamity Mod spell tome with the same name.
cards.note: who even trades this card?

cards.name: Anathema
cards.creator: nikroplays
cards.description: Legendary finale of the Dedication Series that took over 6 years to be finished and verified. Reminiscent of many different styles throughout 2.1.

cards.name: Defeated Circles
cards.creator: GXQ
cards.description: A Nine Circles styled level which takes heavy inspiration from the "You So Defeated" challenges, being especially apparent in the level's timing-based segments and its song choice. The level is overall first-half heavy, though the difficulty does not step down much in the latter half, ending off on a dual wave and a spam corridor.

cards.name: Avernus
cards.creator: PockeWindfish
cards.description: Well-known, poorly received, but unexpectedly enjoyable hell themed extreme which has gone through its fair share of controversy. Recognizable for its fixed hitboxes and ridiculous ship and wave sections.
cards.note: very fair card

cards.name: FOREST OF SPIKES
cards.creator: bims
cards.description: Tight and claustrophobic level set to a very intense Waterflame track. Themed around spikes, with nearly 50% of all objects in the level being a variant of spike. Very first-half carried, and contains an ending where you must identify and count flashing eyes and must click accordingly to avoid crashing a command prompt.
cards.note: A filler card for higher trades

cards.name: Acheron
cards.creator: ryamu
cards.description: Iconic sequel to Tartarus. Intimidating 1.9 styled level that gradually gets less red and more black as it continues. Known for its impossibly tight wave sections & chokepoints.

cards.name: Spectre
cards.creator: xander556
cards.description: Zodiac sequel that was in the works for 4 years. Vaguely cool-toned with many parts by some of the most famous creators, like CuLuC, Darwin and Helpegasus.

cards.name: Menace
cards.creator: Arraegen
cards.description: White, orange and black effect level with plenty of lore and an entire poem within it. Includes some incredibly unorthodox gameplay. The level's song was also created by the creator, Arraegen, specifically for this project.

cards.name: Abyss of Darkness
cards.creator: Exen
cards.description: Iconic megacollab with an equally as iconic song. Originally was finished in 2018, but was redecorated in 2021. Known for its slow gameplay and very inconsistent decoration quality.

cards.name: Tunnel of Despair
cards.creator: Exen
cards.description: Timing based greyscale level with red as its secondary color. Decorated exclusively by ivyteal. Generally repetitive with poorly received gameplay. Verification also features Zoink admitting to "hacking" Eternal Moment.

cards.name: Kyouki
cards.creator: Demishio
cards.description: Blue and purple glowy effect level and Demishio's 3rd extreme demon project. Memorably high quality gameplay and effects with an iconic Creo song.

cards.name: Sacrifice
cards.creator: Laniakea
cards.description: Laniakea's XL megacollab themed after the Touhou series. Heavily inspired by Artifice, it features various different pink and purple coloured design styles referencing the game it's based on. Has fast paced overall gameplay with the difficulty leaning toward the second half.

cards.name: Based After Based
cards.creator: akunakun
cards.description: Initially a top 10 made without spikes and entirely dual gameplay that avoids speed changes. The verifier somehow fluked the level from 78%.
cards.note: falls out of legendary soon. somewhat better than cognitohazard by a tiny margin

cards.name: cognitohazard
cards.creator: MercuryDT
cards.description: The hardest and most skillset varied extreme demon that was made for MatMart GDCIV2, featuring 2 player parts, very spammy gameplay, a very original memory ship and random elements, it was designed specifically to not be beaten by anyone. It's atmosphere is based on a glitchy theme and an actual cognitohazard in which mind control elements are in place. Along with surprisingly being legendary, and the hardest level of this rating, it's also the hardest level in the 2 player list, the hardest level with 0 frame perfects and the level with the most time spent in pending in the demonlist.
cards.note: falls out of legendary soon, nobody wants it

cards.name: The Lightning Rod
cards.creator: lavatrex
cards.description: Distinct and incredibly creative extreme themed around traversing and escaping the inside of an electric tower/rod. Supposedly one of the learniest levels on the main-list with extremely high-cps and quirky gameplay.
cards.note: name of the level is a joke and people might want it because of it

cards.name: Maniacal Chains
cards.creator: LordDivinity
cards.description: Originally meant to be a showcased impossible level built several years ago by LordDivinity, and eventually taken on and verified by spcreat. Using the same song as Killbot, the aesthetic is extremely flashy and intense, with the second and final drop comprising a large part of the level's difficulty.
cards.note: Most normal, highest epic card. preety rare

cards.name: Slaughterhouse
cards.creator: icedcave
cards.description: Former top 1 with some of the most iconic wave sections in the game. Memorable for how incredibly intimidating the gameplay is, paired with an extremely washed out menacing song, along with being previously hacked and beaten legit  2 months later.
cards.note: Almost Perfect level to flex

cards.name: Subterminal Point
cards.creator: SyQual
cards.description: Generally underwhelming Trueffet sequel with classic SyQual visuals. Has an incredibly low enjoyment rating with appalling chokepoints and hitboxes, paired with a bubbly song.
cards.note: peak level, people uses it to flex, or set as banner

cards.name: KOCMOC
cards.creator: cherryteam
cards.description: Formerly CherryTeam's hardest level. Although the level is mostly flashy pink and purple, it takes heavy inspiration from Slaughterhouse and mostly consists of tight wave spam and straight-fly. Pronounced as "cosmos".
cards.note: Most favourited level imo

cards.name: BEING HOME
cards.creator: Turtl123
cards.note: rank 41, not that bad, niche card

cards.name: Deimos (ItsHybrid)
cards.creator: ItsHybrid
cards.description: Extremely large megacollab and sequel to Phobos. Parts significantly vary in design and color similarly to Phobos, and the iconic final dual was kept nearly identical.
cards.note: Not bad card at all, very popular

cards.name: CHIL
cards.creator: McCoco
cards.description: A pure solo project which started out in early 2.2 and took over a year to verify. To fit its Camellia song, the visuals are extremely trippy with relentless camera effect usage and rapid pulses, which are especially apparent in the second half.
cards.note: People know it becayse it was the hardest level with the letter "C" at the begining

cards.name: zorin
cards.creator: Vodyanitsa
cards.description: A 3-minute-long XL extreme known for having no spikes from start to finish. It features a vibrant color palette and a carefree-styled art aesthetic, paired with an array of very gimmicky gameplay mechanics. This level is fairly well-received for its difficulty.
cards.note: unknown and niche level

cards.name: Prismline
cards.creator: itsharryy
cards.description: Colorful 2.2 glow level inspired by old glow levels. Also a semi-official sequel to Just DANCE with very similar gameplay and pacing, including the chokeable straight fly at the end.
cards.note: preety niche level

cards.name: Sakupen Circles
cards.creator: Diamond
cards.description: Flashy nine circles level known for its lack of balancing and iconic wave sections. Remake of the 1.9 impossible level of the same name, and was briefly top 1.
cards.note: Robbed for #1, still one of the most popular and wanted level

cards.name: The Salt Factory
cards.creator: Nickname
cards.note: preety niche level, i didnt know if this level existed or nah

cards.name: Master of Puppets
cards.creator: TheZinkYT
cards.note: level known for chokepoints

cards.name: Silentlocked
cards.creator: Skele
cards.description: A nerfed remake of the iconic impossible level "Silentlocked", which was an absurdly buffed version of the main level "Deadlocked" that went viral in early 2.0. While some impossible parts were changed, such as the wave sections, some others remained untouched, like the orb spams.
cards.note: Deadlocked remake, crazy level

cards.name: Eyes in the Water
cards.creator: nothawkyre
cards.description: Well known for its unique decoration, unique "eye" theme, and iconic song. Includes a very strange cast of creators, with Bli, ivyteal, and skywalker14 all participating. First ship is incredibly difficult.
cards.note: really popular learny level

cards.name: CONVULSION
cards.creator: Stellar
cards.description: The hardest 1.9GDPS level, taking on a red, black and blue colour scheme with very flashy visuals and a menacing atmosphere. Its gameplay is very learny with many fakes and structures blending in with the decoration, and features a difficult ship section halfway through.
cards.note: An epic card used to trade legendaries

cards.name: Snowbound
cards.creator: Amplitron
cards.description: Snow-themed XL solo extreme by amplitron, featuring an atmospheric art-design styled decoration. This level's pacing remains calm until the drop, where slow turns to flow, rapidly transitioning into fast-paced and High-CPS gameplay complementing its drum and bass track.
cards.note: An epic card used to trade legendaries

cards.name: Firework
cards.creator: Trick
cards.description: Iconic greyscale former top 1 by CherryTeam. Loaded with classic sections like the red-orb ship and the difficult wave burst at 49%. Surprisingly not wave and ship carried.
cards.note: a popular level both created and verified by Trick that might be worth to increase the value of the trade

cards.name: Through The Gates
cards.creator: TeamTheDashers
cards.description: An initially hacked-verified level in 2018 that went through several stages. Even though it was verified in 2023, it took another three years for the level to get rated alongside other historical levels. Some say this level is a spiritual successor to Thinking Space.
cards.note: An epic card used to trade legendaries

cards.name: Apocalyptic Trilogy
cards.creator: APTeamOfficial
cards.description: Legendary but poorly received extreme that combines and superbuffs Cataclysm, Bloodbath and Aftermath. Took roughly 5 years to be finished and verified and has incredibly rough quality inconsistency.
cards.note: An epic card used to trade legendaries

cards.name: Pinnacle of Life
cards.creator: skzyl
cards.note: An epic card used to trade legendaries

cards.name: KOSETSU
cards.creator: fwefwe
cards.description: Strange wintery realism collab with incredibly talented creators like Bli & Motheye. Uses an incredibly strange atmospheric song and goes a little crazy with 2.2 shaders.
cards.note: An epic card used to trade legendaries. also used in alot of trading for holos

cards.name: Voltage (ThePurgatory)
cards.creator: ThePurgatory115
cards.description: A yellow/orange electricity themed level created by The Purgatory team that took roughly four years to finish. Strangely it is pretty underground for its difficulty.
cards.note: An epic card used to trade legendaries

cards.name: NOMAD
cards.creator: reesevt
cards.description: Using "Exit Music (For A Film)" by Radiohead for the song, Nomad is an extremely short and dense precision test with a mild runtime of 57 seconds, containing primarily desert and blizzard themes for its aesthetic. Has an interesting choice of gameplay, utilizing only three gamemodes: cube, ship, and UFO.

cards.name: NervHell
cards.creator: ASVTeam
cards.note: Really all of the mid tier epics are the exact same, price is set by the curve

cards.name: Loops of Fury
cards.creator: Enfur
cards.description: Grayscale effect level that contains sections where the gameplay loops several times over (hence its name). Has a very chokeable ending.
cards.note: Really all of the mid tier epics are the exact same, price is set by the curve

cards.name: Fracture
cards.creator: Arrow
cards.description: A fast-paced indigo Nine Circles level that is a staple within the New Zealand Geometry Dash community. Features a sleek, polished design influenced by many of the creator's favorite creators at the time, with its structuring loosely inspired by Arctic Lights. Took over 2 years to be rated after its initial release.
cards.note: Really all of the mid tier epics are the exact same, price is set by the curve

cards.name: poocubed
cards.creator: Lisp
cards.description: The 3rd level in the poocu series, consisting of some of the most colorful and innocent decoration on the list. Known for its high-cps off-the-grid gameplay, as well as overall maximum bubbliness.

cards.name: Deadlier Clubstep

cards.name: The Hallucination

cards.description: Black and blue circles level known for its intense song and fast-paced sync gameplay. Decoration took over a year to be completed.
cards.note: Really all of the mid tier epics are the exact same, price is set by the curve

cards.name: COMBUSTION
cards.creator: Cersia

cards.note: Comobusatrion

cards.name: Saul Goodman
cards.creator: Renn241
cards.description: The hardest extreme in the Breaking Bad series, overall not supposed to be a serious level. Incredibly learny gameplay where everything is moving and bouncing, also filled to the brim with inside jokes. Atrocious endscreen.
cards.note: Popular rn because of doogs

cards.name: BRITNEY NO SCLEARS
cards.creator: wabas
cards.description: A deceivingly difficult solo extreme that was inspired by SARY NEVER CLEAR and Hard Machine. Notable for its name and usage of a Britany Spears song. It took over a year to get rated.
cards.note: Really all of the mid tier epics are the exact same, price is set by the curve

cards.name: Stellar Night
cards.creator: icedcave
cards.description: 2.1 solo extreme by icedcave. Notable for its thorny obstacles and deep-blue gradient color scheme. Would've been top 10 if rated upon release, however it never got rated until 4 years later. As such, it was the top 1 on the UDL for a decent amount of time.

cards.name: Gaggatrondra
cards.creator: MoistyJc
cards.description: Bright and energetic level using Problem by Ariana Grande. Includes a memorable dual with intense and quirky high-cps gameplay. cards.note: Really all of the mid tier epics are the exact same, price is set by the curve

cards.name: Sevvend Clubstep

cards.description: Industrial, minimalist cherry team level that's pretty click-sync.
cards.note: for some reason overpriced? no clue why but people just offer alot for it. ah those cherryslop cards...

cards.name: Edge of Destiny
cards.creator: CDMusic
cards.description: Beloved remake of classic extreme Blade of Justice. Stays very true to the original, but significantly enhances the decoration and buffs the gameplay into a bright and glowy masterpiece.

cards.name: Losing Your Mind

cards.description: 2.2 remake of Mind Control, complete with a combination of extremely gimmicky and traditional gameplay, featuring a fake dual wave at the drop, a pick-a-path corridor(s) at 63%, and a randomised ending. Decorated with a range of different decoration styles to match the original level.
cards.note: Really all of the mid tier epics are the exact same, price is set by the curve

cards.name: Haunted Ship
cards.creator: AWESOMEME360
cards.note: Really all of the mid tier epics are the exact same, price is set by the curve

cards.name: The Plunge

cards.description: Atmospheric and floaty vortex themed extreme with a washed out song that takes loose White Space inspiration. Very memorable endscreen with a realistic hand.
cards.note: Really all of the mid tier epics are the exact same, price is set by the curve

cards.name: Solar Flare
cards.creator: Lin
cards.description: A remake of Solar Circles, with warm colours and blue highlights. Consists of unique structuring and a lot of movements on the structures. Also features Janet, the sun at the halfway point.
cards.note: At least 5 ppl are fighting for most

cards.name: The Catacombs

cards.description: Very old 1.9 GDPS level built as an upcoming top 1 in 2019. Was verified by Slithium in 2024, and rated in 2026.
cards.note: Really all of the mid tier epics are the exact same, price is set by the curve

cards.name: LIMBO

cards.description: Legendary memory level hosted by MindCap. Built with the intention of providing a unique, different experience to players. The randomised key maze is perhaps most iconic ending in any extreme. One of the first extremes to have merch.

cards.name: Wavterminal

cards.description: Vibrant & hyper-saturated level that takes full advantage of shaders and gradient triggers. Includes spirals of swirling colors pairing well with its energetic song. One of most enjoyed extremes in the top 150!

cards.name: walter white

cards.name: Damascus
cards.creator: Dzeser
cards.description: Incredibly large megacollab 3 years in the making in which many classic creators (such as Tygrysek and Rob Buck) would remake their own most important level to them as their part. cards.name: Decks Dark
cards.creator: MadisonYuko
cards.description: An atmospheric Lotus Flower inspired level that uses only UFO, ship, duals, and a Radiohead song of the same name. Took 2 years to get rated and it was still nearly top 50 by the time it was placed.
cards.note: not any specialty, just for index, unknown level

cards.name: SARYYX NEVER CLEAR
cards.creator: artos
cards.description: SARY NEVER CLEAR and Hard Machine inspired design extreme with bright colors and heavy 1.9 influence. Gameplay is also loosely inspired by the aforementioned levels, with tight straight-fly and multiple brief spam sections.
cards.note: Popular level names like this gets much attencion

cards.name: The Yangire

cards.description: Well-received sequel to The Yandere. Inconsistent but incredible art and designs with parts almost 3 years old before being finished. Took over 130,000 attempts to be verified.

cards.name: Climax

cards.description: Typical purple glow-flow extreme heavily inspired by Kyouki, using the same song.
cards.note: random kid

cards.name: ORDINARY

cards.name: Sinister Silence

cards.description: 1.9 style extreme memorable for its nearly 9 minute runtime and incredibly large catalogue of creators. Utilizes a high-energy progressive rock song that easily gets your hands shaking as you progress.
cards.note: only wanted for %100 holo

cards.name: THE JET ENGINE
cards.creator: Billzer
cards.note: worthless other than holo %100

cards.name: Coalescence
cards.creator: Amplitron
cards.description: Fast-paced and intriguing fusion of extremes Fog and Shimmer. Consists of an entire minute of 4x speed gameplay. The song is also a collab by the artists involved in the two levels combined here. Features a randomised ending that is much more complex than the one found in Fog.
cards.note:
about to fall from #100, will prolly lose its Epic'ness

- cduking

cards.name: Trickshot
cards.creator: vonic
cards.description: Vonic's participation for Twister's #DemonTime event, where participants each made a demon of any difficulty by a certain due date. A solo top 75 that took the creator 25 days to make start to finish and only 3 days to verify. Contains energetic and high-cps gameplay with difficulty spikes in its first half while resembling a decoration seemingly inspired by TamaN's style.

cards.name: Midnight
cards.creator: MadisonYuko
cards.description: An extremely flashy, fast-paced and high cps sequel to Twilight. Consists of a vague space theme and brief misaligned dual section. Supposedly a collage of Yuko's older levels.

cards.name: Doppler (Solo)
cards.creator: At424
cards.description: Splitscreen two player level with a distinct red and blue scheme in reference to the Doppler Effect. Created and verified by At424 & Latezk in two weeks! Memorable for its tech theme and satisfying clicksync.

cards.name: Cimmerian Shade
cards.creator: spcreat
cards.description: Extremely early 2.1 former impossible level that got rated completely out of the blue. Consists of unusual gameplay and a completely invisible section at 90%.

cards.name: PSYCHOPATH (DeniPol)
cards.creator: DeniPol
cards.description: Extremely unique extreme with a vague asylum and hallucination theme. The level's concept has supposedly been floating around since 2019. Caused controversy by being unrated after the verification was found to be using click between frames.

cards.name: arcturus
cards.creator: maxfs.
cards.description: Dark hell-themed level with a song straight out of a horror movie. Recognizable for its iconic fast-paced wave sections and 16% of the level being a black screen. Formerly an impossible level, and was part of the triple top 1 rate alongside Slaughterhouse and Firework.

cards.name: BEELINE (Solo)
cards.creator: galaxxyss
cards.description: Very vibrant splitscreen 2 player level with the parts being references to various games. Includes some tricky and fast-paced gameplay, with the beginning being the hardest one.

cards.name: Sonic Wave Infinity
cards.creator: APTeamOfficial
cards.description: Superbuffed Sonic Wave remake hosted by APTeam and Riot. 5 verifiers were involved and the level was briefly unrated because of its infamous 69% crash trigger that could corrupt save data. Supposedly, Riot hosted this megacollab because he felt the original Sonic Wave was "boring".

cards.name: Tartarus
cards.description: Infamous 1.9 styled megacollab with a long history of verifiers, a revamp, and controversies. A remake of the impossible level Silent Akbar. Reigned as an overwhelmingly intimidating top 1 for more than 17 months.

cards.name: Waterfall
cards.creator: cherryteam
cards.description: Legendary long awaited high-octane icy megacollab by CherryTeam. Known for its intense song and extremely high-effort and realistic art created by the likes of Bli, CuLuc and kivvvi. Originally was meant to be a Firework sequel.

cards.name: Jigsaw
cards.creator: NEKONGAMES
cards.description: Learny high-cps level themed around the Saw movie series. Features a stacked cast of realism and effect creators with an overwhelming amount of sharp objects and edgy text throughout. Particularly memorable for it's clean transitions and background effects.

cards.name: Delta
cards.creator: Drakosa
cards.description: Intensely colorful and very sleek design megacollab hosted by Drakosa and Artsiburn. High-cps spinoff of the greek letter series (Gamma, Sigma & Omega) and memorable for its flashy effects and incredible colors. Also features a very satisfying drop-down out of the section at 67% into a new one to the song's key change.

cards.name: BPATA MPAKA
cards.creator: Inex
cards.description: A 2.2 Russian Mega-collab originally made to be a top 1, which was later changed. The level is based on the novel Master and Margarita.

cards.name: Natural Disaster
cards.creator: Laysah
cards.description: Formerly impossible flashy green extreme with a vague nature/jungle theme. Features incredibly fast-paced wave sections and fast-paced gameplay. Stolen assets were found in the original version of the level, leading to the level getting unrated and getting a redecoration. Respect the Planet.

cards.name: The Wonder of You
cards.creator: HangerLord
cards.description: Claustrophobic monochrome extreme with subtle blue/purple accents. Uses a memorably strange industrial song matching the unconventional name and detailed mechanical designs. Initially, it was supposed to be top 10, but was nerfed to roughly top 25 to prioritize playability.

cards.name: Sanctity
cards.creator: Amplitron
cards.description: An Amplitron solo with a distinct red, city theme featuring a song from Bôa's hit album, Twilight. It focuses on small wave chokepoints and ship control gameplay. The level is known to be second half heavy with the city-like ending being most of the difficulty; the ending is also regarded as Amplitron's best gameplay in a level according to him.

cards.name: The Golden
cards.description: Legendary green and yellow jungle themed extreme that reigned as top 1 for over 100 days. Known for its extremely difficult wave sections and dark atmosphere. A remake of LMAnubis' El Dorado that very nearly didn't exist. I verified the golden lets go

cards.name: Oblivion
cards.creator: dice88
cards.description: Claustrophobic and colourful sequel to the equally claustrophobic Cognition. Loses the old fashioned style song for a more upbeat Creo song, similar to Carcano. Surprisingly one of the most dropped extreme verifications, going through 6 verifiers.

cards.name: Viprin UFO
cards.creator: nothawkyre
cards.description: Retro 1.9 styled extreme that only uses the UFO gamemode. Gameplay is much harder than it looks due to the unpredictable click-patterns and sketchy routes. Includes an upbeat Waterflame song and references to Pacman and Flappy Bird levels.

cards.name: NETWORK (Agat3)
cards.creator: Agat3
cards.description: Fast-paced greyscale neo-design collab acting as a sequel to the easier Framework. Contains a memorably tricky spider at 55%

cards.name: ATOMIC CANNON Mk III
cards.creator: LIEB
cards.description: The third installment of the ATOMIC CANNON series and the first to include features from the 2.2 update. The level follows gameplay elements from the first level compared to the second, with the cps not being as high; however, a wave part is included instead of a ship. Similar to the first installment, the last ball is a homage to Lieb's very first solo level, "Relativo," by featuring several designs from it.

cards.name: Terminal Rampancy
cards.creator: Xyriak
cards.description: Xyriak's magnum opus that was worked on for over 3 years. It is extremely frantic with its gameplay and consists complicated usage of the dual mode, making it difficult to approach and learn. Unfortunately does not use the robot game mode.

cards.name: Verdant Landscape
cards.creator: Sandrone
cards.description: A pure solo level built and verified over the course of two years. Taking heavy inspiration from Windy Landscape, it features a green colour scheme, fast-paced, flowy gameplay and mesmerising Woogi-style symmetrical duals. Highly praised amongst the community for its fun gameplay and charming visual style.

cards.name: Checked Steam
cards.creator: gruzy
cards.description: Landscape themed and visually cozy level with a really large infamous reputation due to it's brutal gameplay, which is generally carried by very awkward sections and absurd spammy parts like the blue spam at the beginning, the majority of the wave (including the also mega infamous mini wave coin spam) and the last part, containing a spammy dual with a ufo and a ship and a last 120fps frame perfect quadruple jump. This level polarizes most of the victors, while there's a lot of people who barely enjoyed it, there's a lot who almost fully enjoyed it.

cards.name: Heavenly Sakupen
cards.creator: YouknowwhoGD
cards.description: 1.9 GDPS extreme demon top 5 that is absurdbly unbalanced, featuring 2 extremely short wave parts where 90% of the difficulty lies in there, the first one being miles harder than the second one, and also containing a chokeable cube and ship parts between those 2 wave sections, being the rest of the level extremely easy. Has nothing to do with other "Sakupen" levels.

cards.name: UNKNOWN
cards.creator: NineDice
cards.description: Redecoration of the 1.9 styled level of the same name. The completely greyscale decoration and unnerving song makes for a generally unsettling experience. Also one of the shorter extremes on the list, being less than 45 seconds.

cards.name: azure blast
cards.creator: AlbinoSnail
cards.description: An entirely Korean megacollab with a blue colour scheme and very difficult flow gameplay. Each part is distinctive with various decoration and gameplay styles as with many Korean collabs, with chokepoints found towards the middle third of the level. The first list level to use a song from the game's built-in NCS music library.

cards.name: Shukketsu
cards.creator: MadisonYuko
cards.description: Learny Kowareta inspired "art-core" level with a groovy breakbeat song and colorful desaturated visuals. Features a slight garden theme and is flooded with community inside jokes and memes. The gameplay itself is clicksync and fast paced, with many chokepoints throughout the level.

cards.name: Critical Heat
cards.creator: Zeniux
cards.description: Fast-paced extreme themed around escaping a burning facility. Contains a lot of scaled up animated fire objects and high octane gameplay, along with a difficult dual. The hardest PEACEFUL! level in the game.

cards.name: WOBBLING MACHINE (Solo)
cards.creator: Smarted
cards.description: 2 player extreme where one player has to perform standard gameplay as the other player clicks in a repetitive pattern, matching the rhythm of the 'wobbling' technique in Smash Bros. Melee. Originally hack verified and unrated, but later nerfed and re-verified after which it took over two years to get re-rated.

cards.name: Crystal Crusher (Solo)
cards.creator: Zeniux
cards.description: Simplistic crystal cave themed extreme. Majority of the level features convoluted and long misaligned duals.

cards.name: limbo but uwu ig idk
cards.creator: akunakun
cards.description: Really bright and blinding rainbow level with a crazy wave teleporting maze at the end of it.

cards.name: paranoia (amplitron)
cards.creator: Amplitron
cards.description: An Amplitron solo with a floral theme that features a PinkPantheress song. It focuses primarily on high CPS with an abundance of triple clicks and difficult wave bursts. Contains a notable ship at 16% and is widely considered to be second half heavy.

cards.name: Starlit Stroll
cards.creator: Enfur
cards.description: Simplistic atmospheric level that gets more visually complex as it continues, eventually developing into a fast-paced psychedelic and starry swirl with a slower ending. Memorable for its few gamemodes but incredibly difficult ships, waves and swing sections.

cards.name: The Paroxysm of Rage
cards.creator: Zacanaii
cards.description: Superbuffed remake of Paroxysm to the point of almost copying. Slightly upgrades the visuals, and adds an extension with some glitchy effects.

cards.name: Aerial Gleam
cards.creator: Endlevel
cards.description: Bright blue storm themed circles level that gradually gets more decorated and flashy as it continues. Known for spawning the "CuLuC lightning" trend and for its difficult wave sections. Official sequel to Aquatic Auroras and the third level in the Weather Trilogy with 4+ verifiers.

cards.name: VOID
cards.creator: nikoberry
cards.description: A blue space themed extreme demon that took nearly a year and a half to get rated. Its song and decoration make for a cozy atmosphere, with the intensity picking up in a brutal ship section that spans over half the levels length, and also considered to be the hardest ship part in any rated level.

cards.name: Henken
cards.creator: PLoLek
cards.description: A megacollab with an entirely Polish creator roster notable for its muted colours, timing-based gameplay and difficult wave sections near the end. Much of the difficulty also lies in the first half, and contains the occasional fixed hitbox here and there.

cards.name: Starlight Summit
cards.creator: hazelmrow
cards.description: A pure solo extreme using only the robot gamemode where the player traverses through treacherous alpine terrain. It combines traditional pixel style decoration, editor particles and a C418 song to create a cozy atmosphere. Don't let its short length fool you, it is filled to the brim with brutal robot timings, spike corner jumps and double clicks, especially in its middle section.

cards.name: Trueffet
cards.creator: SyQual
cards.description: Memorable blue and pink SyQual extreme with extremely difficult ship, wave, and spam sections. Originally was top 3 (even technically being top 1) and features numerous iconic high-cps wave sections. Named after Trueffet Square from Maple Story.

cards.name: Kenos
cards.creator: npesta
cards.description: 2019 buffed and extended remake of Sakupen Hell. Formerly top 2 and has some terrible hitboxes and 4+ verifiers. Received unparalleled attention at the time for the verifier npesta's insane reaction became a meme across the internet.

cards.name: Fragile
cards.creator: Endlevel
cards.description: Megacollab and superbuffed combination of kowareta and unrated extreme Shibireta. Many community members on Twitter were advocating for Fragile to get rated, starting the popular #RateFragile hashtag.

cards.name: chrome hearts
cards.creator: Roadbose
cards.description: Roadbose's sendoff to the ICE Carbon series; a core-styled level built in the 1.9GDPS with symmetrical structuring, abstract shapes and highly detailed designs. Its 2m 30s runtime consists of difficult ship and wave sections, separated in the middle by a minute-long guitar solo interlude with easier gameplay.

cards.name: Esfera
cards.creator: SyQual
cards.description: Fast-paced Korean megacollab using a primarily blue and pink color scheme. Over 4 minutes long and memorable for its inconsistent style and bubbly song, as well as its fast-paced gameplay and chokepoints.

cards.name: Silent Lunch
cards.creator: DreamTide
cards.description: XXXL 70-person megacollab hosted by DreamTide. Originally was intended to be a joke level, but ended up being higher quality than expected. Consists of loosely 2.0 design styled decoration with relentlessly high energy gameplay and limited breaks. Notably uses the entirety of its song while taking pride in its inclusivity and well-playtested gameplay. Reportedly captures the difficulty of trying not to laugh during a Silent Lunch.

cards.name: NEUTRA
cards.creator: Jenkins
cards.description: Extremely frantic and high-energy level with incredibly flashy effects and designs. Contains a memorable dual wave at 23% along with other quirky click-sync gameplay gimmicks and a very hard ending. The music collective 'siximpala' created the song and significantly helped plan the level's visuals.

cards.name: ROCKBOTTOM
cards.creator: bims
cards.description: A more brighter and colorful SUPERHATEMEWORLD remake, intended to be mainlist upon the time of its release. Contains many tight timings, randomized portal patterns seen in the UFO at 24%, and an extremely tough wave section at 37%. The ending of the level contains very tight ball and ship parts, forcing the player to do many awkward timings.

cards.name: Dark Dimension
cards.creator: ThePurgatory115
cards.description: A controversial superbuffed redecoration of Black Blizzard. It had a lengthy multi-year creation process with several parts being upgraded or completely revamped in 2.2. The level faced heavy criticism from the community for its quality and originality.

cards.name: Swing Swing
cards.creator: Kaza
cards.description: A swing-only extreme demon with a super creative name hosted by Kaza. Went unrated for a really really long time

cards.name: Guideless Goobering
cards.creator: Enfur
cards.description: Colorful rainbow memory level acting as the finale in the Enfur's Entourage trilogy. Features lots of bright and cluttered decoration and unique effects. Memorable for its tricky misaligned dual at 77%

cards.name: Hard Machine
cards.creator: Komp
cards.description: Iconic design level with unchanged gameplay originally made in 1.8 in an effort to be harder than ICE Carbon Diablo X. Infamous for its 46% "shalom" mini-ufo spam among other difficult sections.

cards.name: DISSONANCE
cards.creator: ivyteal
cards.description: A solo effect level created to match its dissonant song, standing out amongst other levels around its difficulty with its slow, precision-based gameplay and bizarre effects. Received a legendary rating from RobTop.

cards.name: Crackhead Circles
cards.creator: AlrexX
cards.description: Extremely bright and flashy rainbow circles level by AlrexX. Represents the ridiculous mumble trap-metal song with psychedelic visuals and high-energy timings. Don't do drugs

cards.name: Zodiac
cards.creator: BIANOX
cards.description: Legendary former top 1 that was hack verified by xander556 before being verified legitimately by Technical. Features a classic Creo song, bright but simplistic visuals, and infamous chokepoints.

cards.name: Lotus Flower
cards.creator: StarkytheSalad
cards.description: Beloved gimmicky neo-design level by duo zzzgecko and StarkyTheSalad. Known for its insanely difficult to control duals and Radiohead song, as well as its washed out and laid-back visuals.

cards.name: Scream Machine
cards.creator: TMco
cards.description: 3-minute-long horror themed megacollab with great immersion and various creepy pop culture references. Features unique gameplay and decoration heavily inspired by 2.0.

cards.name: Axinie
cards.creator: SaturMan
cards.description: Semi-generic early 2.2 extreme using a flashy bright pink and blue color loop throughout the level. Consists of high-cps timings and multiple swing sections.

cards.name: GLUNGUS ADVENTURES
cards.creator: bims
cards.description: Extremely serious level based off of the infamous Glungus. From randomized minigames and an evil pong battle to multiple bossfights against Glungus himself, GLUNGUS ADVENTURES truly does whatever it wants. "All i know is that Glungus Adventures is a MOVIE!" - Conix

cards.name: IRIS
cards.creator: Kaza
cards.description: A rapid-paced extreme collab which contains mainly vibrant blue, purple and pink coloring and a variety of eye-catching effects that capture the intensity of the level's song. The gameplay is very well-regarded despite the challenge it provides. The wave parts are considered to be the most difficult, and the level requires a high amount of CPS.

cards.name: Judgement Knights
cards.creator: HangerLord
cards.description: The sequel to Knights of Thunder, featuring flashy colors and an extremely intense song. Memorable for its unique colors and futuristic city-themed visuals. Often abbreviated to JKOT.

cards.name: Goober Rage Stage
cards.creator: bonscarrot
cards.description: Medium length, Robot-only memory level with lots of trolls that have to be memorised and subsequently avoided. Well known and quite well received.

cards.name: Widestep
cards.creator: Demishio
cards.description: Blue and purple design level with early 2.1 adjacent designs. Features incredibly fast-paced gamemode switches and difficult timings. Apparently one of the hardest solo-created and verified levels of its time. The Lucky Potion Has No Effects On Gameplay.

cards.name: Lithium
cards.creator: l4tezk
cards.description: Sleek memory-based extreme with gimmicky gameplay and classic desaturated designs. The gameplay is note-worthy for its incredible amount of learniness and unique structuring.

cards.name: ConClusion
cards.creator: DreamZoneGD
cards.description: The final and hardest level of the ConTrilogy. This level holds nothing back and utilizes memory to its fullest while including flashbacks from both ConTroller and ConFusion. The wave part is known for being very intimidating to approach and can be considered one of the most intense parts of a memory level. Now, can you escape your mind and conclude this nightmare once and for all?

cards.name: Keres
cards.creator: ItsHybrid
cards.description: Extended and buffed Erebus remake with a large roster of creators. Primarily timings-based with complex and awkward gameplay throughout.

cards.name: Frost Spirit
cards.creator: Quaybus
cards.description: XL 1.9 styled extreme excellently capturing an icy cold environment within it's restrictions. The levels difficulty is primarily in its difficult cube and ship sections. Level name and song are from Tower Defense Simulator on Roblox.

cards.name: Ascent
cards.creator: Rimexon
cards.description: Short neon-green glow megacollab with flashy pulses and difficult ship and wave sections. Features an incredibly laggy realistic endscreen and a very loose forest theme.

cards.name: Cold Sweat
cards.creator: para
cards.description: Legendary but ultimately aged effect level with an incredibly memorable spam ufo and high-cps wave part at 61%. Previously was top 7 and was one of the best top levels of its time, also being heavily memed by the community for years.

cards.name: Promethean
cards.creator: Endlevel
cards.description: Medium length orange hell level with an intense metal song and a multitude of clubstep monsters. Notorously ship-carried and has a note-worthily difficult ending. Took over 115,000 attempts to verify.

cards.name: Renevant
cards.creator: nikroplays
cards.description: Allegiance sequel with a darker aesthetic than its predecessor. Features flowy muscle-memory gameplay and a surprising amount of quick UFO sections, along with occasional chokepoints throughout. They also misspelled the name
cards.note: wanted because of rori

cards.name: Thinking Space
cards.creator: Atomic
cards.description: Former impossible level known for its extreme difficulty spike in the final third. Incredibly unique in terms of both its gameplay and decoration, featuring absolutely absurd chokepoints and a backwards-moving wave part, a clear product of early 2.0.

cards.name: Dry Out Copyable 2
cards.creator: tenzk
cards.description: Very long and colorful reddit extreme memorable for its unique effects and many pop-culture and GD references. Features a general rainbow color scheme and lots of variation in its designs. The ending copies Dry Out's gameplay and turns it into memory. Unfortunately is not a copyable version of Dry Out.

cards.name: Calculator Core
cards.creator: Walroose
cards.description: Classic 2019 megacollab remaking and extending TeamN2's Artificial Ideology. Extremely difficult for its time, and stays true to the original while upgrading the decoration and doubling the length. Primarily greyscale with fast-paced gameplay very reminiscent of early 2.1.

cards.name: We Are Not The Same (Solo)
cards.creator: mbed
cards.description: 2-player duo collab where player 2's part is extreme and player 1's is significantly easier to the point of non-demon gameplay, hence the name. Consists of themeless and pretty low-key visuals, including a review about the mario movie at end. I don't think we're alike at all Mr. White...

cards.name: Trotil
cards.creator: cherryteam
cards.description: Glass themed megacollab often mistaken for a winter theme, as the difference is pretty much impossible to differentiate. Memorable for its unique decoration style and realistic endscreen. Creators are mostly unknown because the gameplay and decoration were made by participants/subscribers in Russian youtuber Ani's creator contest.

cards.name: Disconnected Descent
cards.creator: TheSkeletonGMD
cards.description: Joke Digital Descent remake originally conceived by NLW to successfully prank AREDL. It was then made into a full level filled with intentionally silly gameplay and decoration, including jumpscares, 2 player mode for no reason other than to prevent double clicking, and a random Bloodlust part..

cards.name: shimmer (amplitron)
cards.creator: Amplitron
cards.description: Incredibly fast-paced green and pink extreme for Zeroniums 2023 creator contest. Made entirely solo and features dream-like neo-design and effect decoration with a reoccuring flower motif in the first half. Most recognizable for its learny space themed ending and atmospheric breakcore song.

cards.name: Instinct (Krazyman50)
cards.creator: Krazyman50
cards.description: Unofficial part of the Pokemon Go series (Valor & Mystic) and features yellow and black electric designs, remaining somewhat simplistic throughout. Memorable for its charm and inconsistent style. Generally more experimental than ItsHybrids' Instinct.

cards.name: Sky Shredder
cards.creator: dorvict
cards.description: Formerly the hardest 1.9GDPS extreme. Mostly monochromatic and remains high-energy through most of the level, with difficult ship and wave parts. The name comes from a Bloons TD 6 Monkey Ace upgrade. "The bloons will wish they had never come..."

cards.name: Crimson Planet
cards.creator: TrueOmega
cards.description: Legendary former top 1 with an intense dubstep song and a loose otherworldly theme. Incredibly reminiscent of early 2.1, being started only months after 2.1's release. Includes Terron's iconic part repurposed from Yatagarasu and a modern endscreen. Took too long to get rated. Do not abbreviate on Discord (seriously).

cards.name: DIRECTIONS
cards.creator: riley
cards.description: Unique XL level with a loose northern lights theme in the beginning, turning into a fast-paced and more modern-esque flurry of color. Memorable for the 2nd half being mirrored, making the gameplay significantly more difficult to learn. Includes a floaty progressive breakbeat song to match its unique visuals.

cards.name: Axiom Asterism
cards.creator: fil
cards.description: The captivating chromatic sequel to Infinite Inversion, this former list demon is centered around high CPS flow gameplay, with vivid inspiration from The Hallucination, with a high enjoyment rating contrasting with the former.

cards.name: Cycles X
cards.creator: vortrox
cards.description: The third and hardest level from Vortrox's series of superbuffed main levels, which was verified by it's own, that is also a megacollab with notable parts including the water themed at the end and the creator contest part at the beginning. The gameplay is extremely chokepoint carried and unbalanced, including a gimmicky ball at the drop, a random ship in the middle and the last ball replaced with a robot, which is also the hardest part.

cards.name: Cosmic Cyclone
cards.creator: APTeamOfficial
cards.description: APTeam's standout project, acting as the sequel to Sonic Wave. Consists of exceedingly bright effects and flashy space-themed designs similarly to Sonic Wave Infinity. Took 4 years to be created and verified, starting in 2017.

cards.name: Cognition
cards.creator: Endlevel
cards.description: Iconic claustrophobic former top 3 extreme with an old fashioned song featuring Charlie Chaplin's speech from The Great Dictator. Known for its incredibly precise gameplay, monochromatic visuals and dark atmosphere.

cards.name: Neon Skyline
cards.creator: reshiria
cards.description: City-themed extreme with a neon theme, hence the name. Notable for its timing-based gameplay, idiosyncratic structuring, and the fact that it was verified 3 years after it was originally finished.

cards.name: CORRODERE
cards.creator: Moosh
cards.description: Design megacollab by Moosh that mixes 1.9 with modern creating techniques such as moving objects and trigger orbs. Famous for having a fat wave at 85%.

cards.name: ATOMIC CANNON Mk II
cards.creator: LIEB
cards.description: The second installment of the ATOMIC CANNON series made a year after the prequel. The level has higher cps gameplay and expands upon the original level by including new elements such as featuring the wave and briefly the spider and robot game modes. This is also the first in the series to have additional gameplay creators.

cards.name: qoUEO
cards.creator: GhostVandalf
cards.description: Foggy neo-design-esque level memorable for its balancing, all the difficulty being in the first 26% in the form of an ultra-precise challenge-like wave part. Often referred to as "an extended challenge list level".

cards.name: SARY NEVER CLEAR
cards.creator: Kugelblitz
cards.description: Incredibly un-serious remake of the 1.6 formerly-impossible level by Optic Sunflow under the same name with altered gameplay. The level's silly text and charming early 2.1-esque decoration enabled it to get heavily memed by the community. HOW ARE YOU CLEAR MY MAP???

cards.name: Rigel
cards.creator: Dan2D
cards.description: Solo created and verified, space-themed Nine Circles level in tech style. The waves are constantly 4x speed, with the first one being far harder than the second. Has a very chokable ending.

cards.name: Scrubbabingo force
cards.creator: akunakun
cards.description: A memory extreme which started off as a buffed version of Hexagon Force by Shubhy before being decorated and polished into a full level by Akunakun 3 years later. It showcases a wide array of quirky gameplay gimmicks such as horizontally desynced duals and a wave double click. Its decoration takes heavy inspiration from Creeper Force such as the black-and-white ending.

cards.name: Call Me Maybe
cards.creator: hawkyre
cards.description: A pink extreme demon with many designs reflecting the simpler, traditional side of Geometry Dash, paired with an early 2010s pop song. Its gameplay is very clicksync based and relies on player movements to sync with the song, alongside especially brutal chokepoints in the ending and the predrop.

cards.name: ta1LSD0ll
cards.creator: ta1LSD0ll
cards.description: Extremely short and hyper-flashy effect level with incredibly learny wave sections. Constructed to be as psychedelic and otherworldly as possible greatly assisted by 2.2 shader spam. Unique endscreen by the mysterious 2003Devin.

cards.name: RUST
cards.creator: neigefeu
cards.description: A solo timing-based extreme formerly in the Top 20 which became highly popular among demonlist players for its accessibility. It combines sharp movements, non-blending glow and a washed-out colour scheme to create a gritty atmosphere, hence its name. Its gameplay takes heavy inspiration from KrmaL and crohn44, and is notable for its usage of double clicks and a long stress test at the end.

cards.name: SAND SAILOR
cards.creator: Custi
cards.description: Psychedelic-themed dual and timing level by Custi. Predrop consists of mostly triple spikes and dash orbs, and almost the entire last third of the level consists of an asymmetrical dual. Inspired by loltad and skywalker14's works, and Black Blizzard.

cards.name: Gloxinia
cards.creator: solarion
cards.description: A mostly Korean Mega-collab started in late 2022 by  Aeidux and later finished by Solarion. Gloxinia feature early 2.1 style deco  similar to Zodiac and Esfera. The level contains flow gameplay and is an XL spanning just over 2 minutes.

cards.name: meow hard
cards.creator: meowdead
cards.description: Hexagon force themed level with plenty of cats around, with very hard timing gameplay that concludes in a pretty creative wave at the ending.

cards.name: Lucid Nightmares
cards.creator: CairoX
cards.description: 2.1 rainbow design collab by CairoX and DonutTV, was the second hardest verified level at the time. First level in a trilogy, the others being Lucid Chaos and Infinite Chaos. Official version was heavily nerfed due to CairoX's requests, unnerfed version is approximately top 50.

cards.name: NYUTOPIA
cards.creator: Tornabro
cards.description: Fast-paced glowy design level that wears its hazy, Icedcave-inspired atmosphere on its sleeve. Contains an incredibly difficult first half with brutal waves and well-liked flowy clicksync gameplay throughout.

cards.name: Cobwebs
cards.creator: NineDice
cards.description: The shortest extreme in the game. Notable for its Halloween-esque theme and challenge-like gameplay. Was originally unrated for around 3 years, and received a bugfix when it got rated.

cards.name: RUTHLESS
cards.creator: SurJaco
cards.description: A highly decorated XL level with a slow pre-drop that makes up around 60% of the gameplay. The current version of the level was nerfed from the original to remove chokepoints; however, a lot of the difficulty still comes from the chokepoints that remain!

cards.name: Omega Interface
cards.creator: Platnuu
cards.description: The final entry in Platnuu's "Interface" level trilogy, featuring dense, grayscale design decoration with flashes of bright red. Contains claustrophobic gameplay that emphasizes the intensity of the song.

cards.name: Coral Cave
cards.creator: AWESOMEME360
cards.description: A unique 2.1 level themed around a stage from the game Sonic Rush Adventure that goes by the same name. Features a memorable deco style, generally well received yet quirky gameplay involving double clicks, and a ring collecting and monster killing gimmick to obtain the coins.

cards.name: DOUBLE DYNAMO (Solo)
cards.creator: spark
cards.description: A gimmicky 2 players level featuring unique parts like the beginning, where the screen moves like an elevator, revealing parts you're about to enter, a symmetrical and asymmetrical ship, a "tax evasion" swing copter (one after another) and a "the prohibited meat" inspired ending (tight ship and wave gameplay with the same path). Considered the easiest extreme demon on the list if you play it with someone, since playing it solo rises the difficulty by a lot.

cards.name: Launchpad Labyrinth
cards.creator: Moffe
cards.description: A fully half-speed level based on a level in the game “Wario Land: Shake It!” with the same name. The gameplay is intended to be annoying, being similar to the game's level. The level was originally hack verified.

cards.name: obsession
cards.creator: jbooster
cards.description: An insanely cool-looking jbooster solo that contains wonky, but enjoyable gameplay. Most notably known for surviving only 48 hours on the Demon List before being moved to legacy.

cards.name: ULTRA dimension
cards.creator: handsomeorange
cards.description: Almost 6 minutes of non stop memory gameplay. Be very afraid...

cards.name: SUPERHATEMEWORLD
cards.creator: icedcave
cards.description: Redecorated version of a 1.9GDPS impossible level by Icedcave which uses the main theme to Resident Evil. Generic hell-themed extreme but memorable due to its awkward, slow and precise gameplay. The majority of the difficulty lies in the ship and ball sections. Designed intentionally to make the player hate it.

cards.name: Porridge Factory
cards.creator: pootys1337
cards.description: 1.9PS Oblivion inspired megacollab with medium length clicksync gameplay, using Red Haze by Creo. Had a planned nerfdate that never ended up coming out.

cards.name: Akashic Records
cards.creator: VoTcHi
cards.description: Korean space-themed megacollab by Zeta, known for its variety in part theming. Its name (according to the verifier's YouTube description) is 'a compendium of everything related to human history and [its] future'. Took 1 1/2 years to get rated, and was rated when RobTop entered a RicoLP stream and was told about the level.

cards.name: Sides Of My Mind (Solo)
cards.creator: MaxxoRMeN
cards.description: A 2-player level that splits apart and then recombines together in the end. Visuals contain a lot of contrasting effects and feature rainbow and monochrome palette. Very first half carried for solo play.

cards.name: Horros (Solo)
cards.creator: Shrc
cards.description: A 2-player level that has no consistent theme, as there is "no sense of continuity in dreams". For solo play, it is infamous for the difficulty of the first and third dual, namely because of the 2p ship control.

cards.name: Ykds1479ymdppr
cards.creator: Kapycta999
cards.description: A former list extreme themed around sleep paralysis. Its uncanny SFX and shader usage compliment its theme really well. The gameplay is mostly clicksync based with it culminating to a brutal ending wave part, followed by a nerve wracking final click.

cards.name: Ragnarok
cards.creator: knobbelboy
cards.description: An XXL megacollab 3 years in the making. The level doesn't follow a consistent theme, but it stands out with a darker color palette and design, with its intensity picking up in the second half. Its balancing didn't age very well, with the second half being notably harder, specially Enlex's part.

cards.name: me when machine gang (Solo)
cards.creator: akunakun
cards.description: A 2-player memory level by akunakun that was made in one sitting, with mostly path-based memory other than the splitscreen dual. For solo play, 88-100 is a major chokepoint.

cards.name: The Art of the Blade
cards.creator: mbed
cards.description: The winner of MatMart's GD Civilization Contest thanks to its ludicrous gimmick of a randomized maze where the correct path is determined by the colour of three subtle details throughout the level. Even outside of its gimmick, the level features very unorthodox gameplay structuring and frontloaded balancing.

cards.name: Descent Into Exile
cards.creator: GrenadeofTacos
cards.description: A black and white extreme demon collab that it's acronym means "DIE". The level has some claustrophobic sections, making it very timing oriented, as well as some hard ship parts, where it is said that most of the difficulty lies in the second half, with some awkward timings and a dual part at the end.

cards.name: Deep Bass
cards.creator: Wesp
cards.description: An official sequel to Down Bass, with extremely challenging wave segments — most notably at 48% and 56% — followed by a significantly easier second half.

cards.name: Jupiter My Favourite
cards.creator: akunakun
cards.description: A blue and yellow solo memory extreme with many doodle-like designs and a lot of wacky gameplay structures and gimmicks, most notably the 24% wave.

cards.name: Silent Club
cards.creator: Luqualizer
cards.description: Former impossible level hack verified all the way back in 1.6, and reverified nearly 7 years later. Its best known for its brutal spam sections sprinkled through the first half. Not to be confused with Silent Clubstep.

cards.name: Bloom
cards.creator: zodycoder
cards.description: A minimalist atmospheric XXL solo extreme that won $300 in KrmaL's Contest 3. Consists of slow paced, experimental gameplay, a terrifying learning curve, and some randomization. Its style takes great inspiration from a level of the same name by KrmaL in Soundodger+

cards.name: LD50
cards.creator: StarkytheSalad
cards.description: An incredibly learny level featuring fast click patterns and complex gameplay mechanics, such as the ending where the player must avoid breaking breakable blocks so they form a bridge over a pit of saws. Starts off slow and easy, with the CPS, complexity and the difficulty increasing as the level progresses.

cards.name: the ocean of fish
cards.creator: shmigels
cards.description: Solo XXL extreme containing many fish and other sea creatures made of spikes and other basic gd blocks. All interactable objects in the level are fully incorporated into the decoration and fit the level's theme. The gameplay itself is slow paced, memory heavy, contains a very complex dual, and has a tough first wave.

cards.name: DsinK
cards.creator: stanstanmansan
cards.description: A sink themed level that was originally started by crohn44, but then finished by Nightning and stanstansmansan. The gameplay is unconventional and gimmicky, with a desynced dual part and tricky timings throughout. Drop to the ending is mostly synced with the song.

cards.name: Nabil Let Go
cards.creator: nab
cards.description: A 1.9 GDPS level which fittingly uses the main level song Can't Let Go. Initially starting out as a joke level, it has gone through many buffs and nerfs during its creation and consists of several wave chokepoints and a significant focus on timings. Contains a Jeff the Killer cameo.

cards.name: BarbarosFinaleFinale
cards.creator: AWESOMEME360
cards.description: A 2.2 solo joke remake of Barbaros Finale by Moffe, with similar, albeit harder and less straightforward gameplay compared to its predecessor, while being notorious for its brutal consistency CPS wave at 75%. Contains a short segment of "miss you" by shmigels.

cards.name: Sank
cards.creator: Water
cards.description: The hardest rated cube-only level at the time of its release. Takes major inspiration from Dump and DsinK. Has precise orb timings, and some silly Spongebob characters near the end.

cards.name: Asterios
cards.creator: Exen
cards.description: An old dual-heavy level hosted by Exen with an underlying space theme. Was initially built to be Top 1, but was heavily nerfed to be Top 20 at the time. Currently Exen's most well-received level thanks to its satisfying dual gameplay, though it being slightly held back by its predrop and bugs is a common sentiment amongst victors.

cards.name: Bloodlust
cards.creator: knobbelboy
cards.description: Legendary former Top 1 and remake of Bloodbath, expanding on its predecessor with a minute-long extension of fast-paced gameplay as well as many changes to existing gameplay and an overhauled visual style. Had a monumental verification taking Knobbelboy over 1.5 years, 120k attempts and 1000 hours of playtime, which for its time was completely unheard of.

cards.name: Moving Forward
cards.creator: crohn44
cards.description: The sequel to Glide and crohn44's final level, made over the course of two years. Has a more artistic aesthetic than his other works, with inspiration from Knots and Subwoofer, and features striking song representation in gameplay and visuals. Its gameplay is structured very unconventionally, and thus community reception has been very mixed.

cards.name: Shardscapes
cards.creator: ItzKiba
cards.description: Minimalist-style timing-based extreme using only the robot gamemode. Its gameplay is notable for its usage of spike corner jumps and multi-activated orbs, and its decoration combines parallax, enter/exit effects and a calm Creo song to create a dream-like atmosphere.

cards.name: no jokes
cards.creator: TheParadoxTeam
cards.description: Short and very serious level with no silliness allowed. Known for its extremely concentrated difficulty and chokepoints. Are you brave enough?

cards.name: Excruciation Chamber
cards.creator: spcreat
cards.description: spcreat's (nearly) all wave level inspired by UFWM's challenge level, Torture Chamber. Decoration features a changing fire/frost theme.

cards.name: Terminux
cards.creator: Aerae
cards.description: The sequel to Eternal Moment, adopting a similar gameplay and visual style though more polished and modern in many ways. Its base gameplay is mostly well-received, though there are numerous ship and wave chokepoints throughout. Made almost entirely by Korean creators, though Inex is here too for some reason.

cards.name: CITRA
cards.creator: VARSE
cards.description: One of the shortest rated extremes in the game at only 39 seconds. It has flashy effects and very intense fast paced gameplay based around difficult timings and tight wave sections. It is pretty popular and generally well received, even though there are quite a lot of bugs.

cards.name: Awedsy
cards.creator: sink
cards.description: A 1.9 GDPS collaboration between SleyGD and Sink. Contains fast overall gameplay, awkward structuring and a chokeable last wave resulting in relatively mixed reception. Named after the similarly named level Sink by Awedsy.

cards.name: Nhelv
cards.creator: guillester
cards.description: The decoration in this level uses a black, white, and red color scheme to mimic the music video for the song the level uses, Nhelv. It's a technical level, which starts the player off with cube and ship gameplay, then shoots them directly into a intimidating wave section that makes use of D blocks. It also features a intense mix of ball, robot, UFO, wave, and cube gameplay, proceeding to send the player into a daunting drop section at 38%, with memory and timing skillsets needed to clear the level. The level ends with the climactic "mountain part," which many praise for its intensity. Notably, it is also a winner of the "Best Extreme Demon" category from the 2021 GD Awards.

cards.name: Gustavo Fring
cards.creator: Renn241
cards.description: The second level in the Breaking Bad series. Primarily focused on tight ship, cube and flowy gameplay. It has somewhat inconsistent gameplay, and a very difficult first 30%. To avoid seeming racist, Renn didn't make a caricature like in the other Breaking Bad levels.

cards.name: Deimos (EndLevel)
cards.creator: Endlevel
cards.description: A redecorated, buffed remake of the unnerfed version of Phobos. There is a different endscreen if you jump right before the last dual.

cards.name: Jesse Pinkman
cards.creator: Renn241
cards.description: The first installment of the Breaking Bad Series, featuring typical fast-paced gameplay and an early 2.1 style aesthetic. It's one of Renn's more unserious projects which was built during two off-school days, and hence it momentarily became a meme in the community for placing above Bloodlust when it first came out.

cards.name: Congregation
cards.creator: Presta
cards.description: A 3 minute long timing-based level with a long, slow-paced buildup and an intense, fast-paced climax whilst also having the lowest object density of any 2.1 extreme at the time. Due to its progression-based approach and its required skillsets, it became very devisive both in deco and difficulty opinions. Its sudden drop at 42% is extremely well known in the community and has made the level one of the most recognizable extremes of all time.

cards.name: Pootis Engage XTREME
cards.creator: AAAAAlex
cards.description: 1.9 styled memory extreme leaning towards timing skillset. 14-19 and 59-100 (particularly 59-70) are often considered major chokepoints. Sequel to "Pootis Engage" by the same creator.

cards.name: Knights of Thunder
cards.creator: HangerLord
cards.description: Space-themed extreme created by Hangerlord known for fast paced consistent gameplay and rapid transitions highlighting wave and ship. This level was inspired by Trueffet and Cosmic Cyclone.

cards.name: X84
cards.creator: Xav
cards.description: Extremely fast-paced & high cps extreme with an intense Camellia song. Memorable for its relentlessly learny but renowned gameplay, paired with jittery effects and flashes. Could be described as "Xronier's distant cousin."

cards.name: ATOMIC CANNON
cards.creator: LIEB
cards.description: The first installment of the ATOMIC CANNON series and Lieb's first solo level after eight years. The level is inspired by Intercept by Viprin and features fast-paced and high cps gameplay. The final ball also references 8 levels Lieb collaborated on back in the 1.9 era.

cards.name: Fog
cards.creator: notes
cards.description: Very well received foggy level with fast muscle memory based gameplay and a simple randomiser at the end

cards.name: Ploink
cards.creator: Goobfrudla
cards.description: Short, unserious level with a rainbow colour scheme and many jokes and references sprinkled throughout. Its gameplay is somewhat learny with its difficulty primarily coming from timing-based cube sections.

cards.name: kowareta
cards.creator: Gablor
cards.description: Extremely short level which to some can feel impossible. The first green orb is maybe a little bit hard. The level that birthed the reta styled levels. Inspired by Plasma Pulse Finale.

cards.name: FRIDAY
cards.creator: Metalface221
cards.description: A very underground and niche former list demon with 1.9 styled decoration. Heavily inspired from WOOGI1411's style, and is primarily based on Colorful OverNight with similar colour palettes, dual structures and clicksync gameplay.

cards.name: End of the Universe
cards.creator: fusion425
cards.description: Edge of the World remake hosted by Fusion425, taking almost 2 years to complete. Retains EOTW's upbeat song, gameplay, and flashy blue/purple space-themed visuals. Gameplay is very well-received!

cards.name: CONNECT
cards.creator: MCres
cards.description: A deeply emotional and symbolic level originally intended to be a suicide note, portraying the creator's struggle with depression and suicidal ideation. Each part has direct references to the creator's feelings and experiences, and eventual recovery.

cards.name: Visible Ray
cards.creator: Krampux
cards.description: A 2.1 Korean megacollab that doesn't follow a specific decoration style. The gameplay is heavily unoptimized, with some questionable chokepoints, such as 59%. Surprisingly good for the time it was made in. The level's difficulty predominantly relies on the first half, with there also being a difficult part in the middle.

cards.name: the wiener
cards.creator: Rynoxious
cards.description: Goofy 2.1 pseudo-joke level that was made in a week. The level is generally not received very well, and the wave near the end is seen as one of the worst of all time. Features a two-block-long CDMusic part.

cards.name: Apotheosis
cards.creator: Xav
cards.description: Fast-paced glow extreme with flashy visuals throughout. Contains claustrophobic high-cps gameplay and contrasts dark details with saturated effects.

cards.name: EGO KILLING
cards.creator: ExactTeam
cards.description: A megacollab that was originally hacked, unrated, and reverified with no gameplay changes. This level is flooded with chokepoints and is infamous for the 78% 4x speed mini wave click. Don’t expect the greatest experience.

cards.name: Frozen Cave
cards.creator: TheParadoxTeam
cards.description: One of the hardest art-style extremes of its time, where the player must escape a collapsing cave high up in the frozen mountains. It's gameplay is especially notable for its wide array of gimmicks and structuring quirks, such as double clicks throughout, the final wave and the iconic toggle orb ship at 64%.

cards.name: Dump
cards.creator: GiggsRH
cards.description: A level made by GiggsRH and Koopazu. This level used to be the hardest cube-only level, featuring precise cube timings, chokepoints and an unforgiving second half. The song is made by the popular indie pop band Kero Kero Bonito. Anyone going for this will certainly have their cube skills put to test!

cards.name: The Yandere
cards.creator: Dorami
cards.description: Iconic former top 10 Dorami megacollab. Extremely unbalanced and quirky with many inconsistencies in both design and gameplay, with JonathanGD and Spectex’s parts infamous for being major difficulty spikes.

cards.name: 2 Comme le vent
cards.creator: Astrala
cards.description: Remake of an obscure 1.9 level '1 Comme le vent', with more two player gameplay and an incredibly hard wave at 78%. Intended for solo play.

cards.name: Death Corridor Z
cards.creator: Sunix
cards.description: Robbed Top 1 verified way back in 2017 that took nearly 9 years to get rated. Features several incredibly difficult wave chokepoints and a black and white colour scheme.

cards.name: Arctic Lights
cards.creator: Metalface221
cards.description: A notoriously difficult nine circles level that was the top 1 hardest nine circles level when it was verified. This was a remake to Hyper Paracosm and is themed after the color pale blue. For a long time, this was known as the list demon many would beat first, like Cobwebs and Cognition. Best known for its awkward wave gameplay and some difficult chokepoints, especially at 36-48% and 58-69%.

cards.name: PROTON LAUNCHER
cards.creator: Multiverse55
cards.description: An ATOMIC CANNON styled level which started out as an entry for Lieb's ATOMIC CANNON Style Gameplay Creator Contest. Just like the level it is based on, it features very fast-paced high CPS gameplay with a heavy lean towards timings and a very nerve-wracking ending.

cards.name: ROCKY ROAD
cards.creator: arclight
cards.description: Fast paced, well-received timing extreme created by arclight & cdyzz.

cards.name: Plasma Pulse Finale
cards.creator: Smokes
cards.description: The finale of the Plasma Pulse series and a former Top 1, making it by far the hardest. It takes everything you’ve learned from the previous levels with various precise timings (some may be chokepoints), a complicated robot + cube dual, and a nerve-wracking ending that contains robot micro clicks. This level truly tests your raw skill to its fullest.

cards.name: Spectrum Cyclone
cards.creator: Temp
cards.description: A fast-paced level with a lot of asymmetrical duals and sync-based click patterns, taking nearly 2 years to build and verify. Very well-received by the community with many deeming it as one of the most fun extreme demons in the game to this day.

cards.name: Storming Summit
cards.creator: Nimbus
cards.description: XL Celeste-themed megacollab featuring a variety of stages, references, and gimmicks from the original game. Very well-received decoration and learny gameplay, including a crazy dual at 70%. Just breathe.

cards.name: Specthys (Solo)
