cards.creator: gBen
cards.description: Solo 2p level made and verified by gBen, themed around astronomy with a mostly yellow scheme. Built with the intention to be played solo, and features a lot of ship control.

cards.name: Alpha
cards.creator: SirWafel
cards.description: A traditional-styled level which has faced over 6 years of on-and-off building and countless buffs, nerfs and rebalances. Despite everything it went through it managed to become highly enjoyed amongst its victors. Very timing-based with the main highlight being the 39% dual, though it has several short bursts of more skill-based gameplay throughout.

cards.name: Fever Dream (icedcave)
cards.creator: icedcave
cards.description: A 2.1 Devil Vortex inspired solo-created extreme demon known for its intimidating yet satisfying gameplay. Features ridiculous high cps wave corridors and hard timings. Due to this, the level has a very wide range of difficulty opinions. Has been redecorated and buffed several times.

cards.name: Shutdown
cards.creator: OliSW
cards.description: This level has a hot/cold theme and is based around a map from Flood Escape 2. Has a brutal ship/wave at the drop and a difficult swing-copter near the middle of the level. There is also a memory part based on a previous level by OliSW, Ulon.

cards.name: Retention Redux
cards.creator: gdNitrox
cards.description: Faithful retention remake passion project aimed to capture the essence of the original. Inspired from the creator's experience beating Retention as a first extreme. Gameplay takes light inspiration from the original while being very well-received, and the decoration boosts the object density and vibrancy. Built entirely on mobile!

cards.name: Calamity
cards.creator: Awedsy
cards.description: Formerly the second hardest 1.9 GDPS level. The gameplay is skill based and it's difficulty is carried by the two wave sections, as well as the hard dual at the end. The level was updated by Royen to be more forgiving.

cards.name: Cersia Madness
cards.creator: Cersia
cards.description: 1.9 extreme using Stereo Madness with an incredibly learny dual at the drop and very skill based gameplay in the ending and predrop. It was the least enjoyed extreme on EDEL before it was raised after a mass group completion by around 20 people. It has many skips that make the level significantly more doable.

cards.name: Piano Woman
cards.creator: Pukklez
cards.description: The sequel to Piano Man. A true solo, with pukklez making the song, the level, and being the verifier. Every input is 2.5 frames on 60fps.

cards.name: RAM
cards.creator: James
cards.description: Extremely high-quality design megacollab themed around computer parts with wacky gameplay and cameos from notable creators like Smokes, para, and Giron. Has some questionable balancing and an alignment bug at 80%. Watch out for LIEB's red orb of doom.

cards.name: WORSTBRAINMAP
cards.creator: bims
cards.description: Quirky silly memory extreme with very gimmicky parts, such as a The Art Of The Blade styled randomised wave maze, a ship part with bouncing orbs, a cutscene where you have to click to the music, and a DIRECTIONS esque slope cube. Are you a thinker?

cards.name: of Ambrosia
cards.creator: Renn241
cards.description: An almost two-minute 2.1 level that—much like M A N I X and GO bird—requires you to play the level completely blindly. It heavily relies on decorative/song-related cues in order to complete the level, requiring you to straightfly at the beginning and hold/click precisely at certain wave, spider, UFO, and cube parts. Submissions for this level require liveplay!

cards.name: Iris of a Puppeteer
cards.creator: Eternaswip
cards.description: A dark and slower paced level featuring some very tight gameplay, with a focus on waves. More learny than expected, partly due to jank, and also features a blind frame perfect at 49%.

cards.name: Requiem
cards.description: The official sequel to the famous memory level “Killbot” and the most object dense rated level in GD. The level follows Killbot's story, following the mental state of the victim after encountering the Killbot virus. The creator of this level was also telling his own friend's, David's story, who unfortunately committed suicide. RIP David.

cards.name: Dance of the Violins
cards.creator: DrayTM
cards.description: An old megacollab that was only recently completed and verified, still containing parts from old creators like Funnygame and Cyclic. The decoration is in the design style popular at the time, and the gameplay is infamous especially for the ridiculously hard wave by Cyclic at 14%.

cards.name: Edge of the World
cards.creator: l4tezk
cards.description: Atmospheric cosmic-themed extreme consisting of high-cps clicksync gameplay and clean designs/effects. Memorable for Flaxy's slanted part at 35% as well as the fantastic song choice.

cards.name: Ghoul
cards.creator: Xav
cards.description: One of XavT's solo extremes. Features intense and learny gameplay, with entirely grayscale decoration. This was formerly the hardest AREDL monthly extreme.

cards.name: ConTroller
cards.creator: DreamZoneGD
cards.description: DreamZone's first solo level and the first of the ConTrilogy. This factory themed level contains heavy amounts of memory with tons of fakes similar to some levels from the 1.9 era. The factory heats up during the drop and becomes very dynamic, so try not to get too controlled with the level's fast movements.

cards.name: SHIP
cards.creator: Cersia
cards.description: The second rated ship-only extreme not afraid to throw evil swoops in every corner you look. Since it’s a Cersia level, it’s from the 1.9 GDPS. Also technically the shortest XL extreme. Beware of the Ship Swing Copter of doom.

cards.name: Golden Club
cards.creator: Zenmuron
cards.description: A solo extreme demon made over 1.5 years, and the last level made by Zenmuron before he stepped down from the game. The level involves the player entering and exiting a golden factory.

cards.name: network (VanDerVals)
cards.creator: VanDerVals
cards.description: Incredibly fast-paced medium length extreme featuring multiple different environments throughout its short playtime. Features difficult cube gameplay and 0 time for breaks

cards.name: Molten Gear
cards.creator: knobbelboy
cards.description: A continuation of Fusion Z. This level underwent major changes after Manix648 requested its cancellation, causing several creators to withdraw. Knobbelboy then hosted a creator contest to fill all the gaps of the older parts which couldn’t be used, hence the vast difference in quality between many parts.

cards.name: Hyper Paracosm
cards.creator: iIiViRuZiIi
cards.description: An early 2.1 collab between ViRuZ and TheRealSneaky. It's a Nine Circles level with purple and blue theming. It's known for its chokepoint heavy and awkward gameplay, especially at the beginning of the drop. Also contains a difficult ending.

cards.name: Collect All Pets
cards.creator: Rynoxious
cards.description: A design level by Rynoxious and Alrexx, named after the Roblox game of the same name. The gameplay is timing-based, without focusing on a specific gamemode.

cards.name: Time Extreme
cards.creator: vortrox
cards.description: The second part of Vortrox's superbuffed Robtop levels series. The level mainly follows the layout of Time Machine with much harder gameplay. Similarly to Stereo Extremeness, it also contains a difficult robot part in the second half.

cards.name: Wasureta
cards.creator: Helpegasus
cards.description: A purple "reta-styled" level recognisable for its flow gameplay style, difficult wave sections and extremely high-CPS click patterns. Its emphasis on muscle memory has made it relatively accessible for its difficulty and hence its popularity among extreme demon players.

cards.name: OVERKILL
cards.creator: Jinnans
cards.description: An extreme made by Hawkyre and Jinnans, with the first half being entirely fast wave sections requiring excruciatingly demanding levels of consistency, and the second half serving as a laughably-easier "don't choke" section, containing a slow ship and end cube, and is as chokeable as it is flukeable. In terms of decoration, this level is absolutely "OVERKILL" with its flashing lights and camera movements.

cards.name: Cybernetic Crescent
cards.description: The third and final level of the Tech Trilogy. It bears a more modern spin to its decoration compared to its two predecessors, which is especially apparent in how creating styles have evolved since the trilogy's last instalment and a much newer Creo song. Its middle third is especially difficult, with click-pattern-based ship sections bearing the forefront of its difficulty.

cards.name: Sink (Awedsy)
cards.creator: Awedsy
cards.description: A purple and orange extreme demon combining modern creating techniques and ideas with 1.9 editor limitations in the 1.9GDPS. Its gameplay mostly revolves around clicksync with the first two sections bearing a big chunk of the level's difficulty.

cards.name: FIFTY THREE
cards.creator: Vlacc
cards.description: A fast-paced, visually simple level, where the drop's gameplay is in mirror mode and cycles through all the gamemodes in chronological order (though skipping the robot). Due to a lot of effort put into balancing, it has become very enjoyed amongst its victors. One of the two Vlacc levels starting out as "layout53", the other being Cloud Nine.

cards.name: SisuSonic
cards.creator: RpgRaketti
cards.description: Finnish megacollab inspired by the sonic series, started in 2018 and finished in 2024. The hardest but also possibly the most obscure sonic series spinoff.

cards.name: ASHES
cards.creator: xHeiDax
cards.description: A level reflecting the creator’s struggle with mental health. Starts off extremely difficult and becomes easier as it progresses. Features an exceptionally high cps.

cards.name: Necromancer
cards.creator: TGI
cards.description: A superbuffed remake of Necropolis that has very similar structuring and color scheme to the original. The gameplay has received criticism for its forced difficulty.

cards.name: Honeycrisp
cards.creator: pyro
cards.description: A 1.9-inspired solo extreme featuring first half-heavy gameplay, difficult fast-paced wave sections and many chokepoints.

cards.name: P a P a P
cards.creator: KiiwiStrawberry
cards.description: Pen apple Pineapple apple Pen
cards.note: Very overpriced like all the new cards I have seen this go for epics

cards.name: Shirakami
cards.creator: Zentraa
cards.description: A Kowareta styled level megacollab.  The level has an open-world botanical style that separates it from the traditional Kowareta style. Sequel to the unrated level “Shiranai” made by the same host.

cards.name: Rage
cards.creator: nSwish
cards.description: A high-CPS level with 7 sections, one for each gamemode. The colour scheme for each section is based on the gamemode’s portal.

cards.name: ADOMANIA
cards.creator: Swib
cards.description: Well received sequel to Ellipsism with a satisfying click pattern and very bright drop sections. The waves in the first drop are notably unbalanced, and the last click is a major chokepoint. Despite this, the level remains very well received.

cards.name: Sonic Wave Rebirth
cards.creator: Serponge
cards.description: 2.0 remake of Sonic Wave with near identical gameplay and effects that have aged to varying degrees. Despite being extremely similar it is notably less enjoyable on average.

cards.name: Sonic Wave
cards.creator: Sunix
cards.description: One of the most famous extreme demons of all time, with a rich history and many remakes. An iconic blue circles level with three separate wave parts and a hard ball part in the predrop. Member of the first RGB trilogy.

cards.name: LUMINA
cards.creator: hechie
cards.description: A timing-based level which takes heavy inspiration from Congregation, with similar progression style, structuring, and the same gamemodes. However, this level is more bright and much more fast-paced. Initially very first-half heavy before getting a nerfdate which made it more balanced.

cards.name: In the Generator
cards.creator: Gelforce
cards.description: A solo extreme made in the 2.0GDPS. Has an upbeat electricity/factory theme with a very faithful 2.0 aesthetic. The gameplay is mainly skill based, with some very tight precision ship sections.

cards.name: Yatagarasu
cards.creator: TrusTa
cards.description: One of the most iconic 2.0 megacollabs, and one of the most memorable Top 1s of all time despite only dethroning Sonic Wave for a short time.  Contains 3 minutes of stressful gameplay from start to finish, including an incredibly difficult predrop, and chokepoints throughout, including Michigun's famous "bird click". Member of the first RGB trilogy.

cards.name: The Fog
cards.creator: hechie
cards.description: An atmospheric megacollab where the player traverses through ancient ruins whilst shrouded by dense fog. The gameplay is cube only and is heavily timing-based without using any spikes. It progressively gets more fast-paced and colourful until the ending where the sun breaks through and the fog clears as you leave the ruins behind.

cards.name: Cobalt hell
cards.creator: rubrum
cards.description: Superbuffed glow-styled remake of the classic Easy Demon, Blue Hell. Contains hard timings, tight ship & wave gameplay and was originally much harder before the level received a balance update.

cards.name: Infinite Iniquity
cards.creator: Flukester
cards.description: Nearly 4-minute long sequel to Twisted Tranquility. It shares some similarities such as the beginning and the “Jetpack Mode” cube. The level is fast-paced throughout, testing the player’s nerve control.

cards.name: Devotion
cards.creator: domi
cards.description: This 2.1 extreme is the second level in the Rededication Series, which is inspired by Nikrodox's Dedication series. This level has been in the works since 2018, initially being known as "Paradox".

cards.name: Kuzureta
cards.creator: Teno
cards.description: A "reta-style" megacollab using Yoru ni Kakeru by YOASOBI that has a notably lower CPS than its predecessors. Features a solid amount of clicksync, numerous wave chokepoints, and two blind transitions.

cards.name: Icotact
cards.creator: icedcave
cards.description: A 48 second level started by ozpectro and finished by Icedcave and Nobody. It features a lot of fast paced gameplay and ends in an infamously difficult wave.

cards.name: Sunset Sandstorm
cards.creator: crohn44
cards.description: Iconic crohn44 extreme which takes heavy inspiration from Black Blizzard. Known for the infamous click pattern at the beginning of the level.

cards.name: Twisted Titanium
cards.creator: ItsHybrid
cards.description: Third and final level of the Tempered Steel trilogy. Verified by spcreat. (Video set as verification is a showcase)

cards.name: Edge of the Blade
cards.creator: kiseta
cards.description: Vaguely themed around the Legend of Zelda game series. Features all-around gameplay with balancing skewed towards the first half, along with a handful of difficult waves and some awkward gameplay throughout.

cards.name: Silentium Clavas
cards.creator: Xolarzz
cards.description: Remake of Silent Club that aims to balance the gameplay by nerfing spams and buffing most of the other clicks. Its deco highly depends on the player's colors. Currently remaining as one of the least played legacy list demons.

cards.name: Golden Flare
cards.creator: krakow
cards.description: XL memory + circles extreme heavily inspired by Golden Paracosm & Bausha Vortex. Features cluttered structuring and a consistent bright yellow palette, as well as a randomised ending. Its also Krakow's first rate!

cards.name: xo
cards.creator: KrmaL
cards.description: A simplistic, 1.0 style KrmaL level with minimalistic effects. Known for its first half difficulty, as well as the infamous 3% dash orb, and some particularly good sync! Because of the minimalistic decoration, this level sparked some controversy over whether it deserves to be rated.

cards.name: Controlled Chaos
cards.creator: Zipixbox
cards.description: Vibrant red & green 2.0-esque masterpiece. Memorable for its incredibly well-executed gameplay gimmicks and consistent, high-quality designs. Includes numerous instances of creatively moving and interactive gameplay as well as immersive technology-inspired backgrounds.

cards.name: Altered Ascent
cards.creator: Prism
cards.description: A buffed and redecorated version of Artifical Ascent with altered, harder gameplay whilst nerfing the original chokepoints from its predecessor. Features a mysterious creator named Gs Craig in Michigun's part who still remains anonymous...

cards.name: Perfect Purgatory
cards.creator: TheBigCheese69
cards.description: A slaughterhouse remake by TheBigCheese and Shizusss using a song that was trending on social media for a while.

cards.name: super probably level
cards.creator: Alkali
cards.description: A flashy, colorful memory level, once regarded as the hardest memory extreme demon and Alkali's first. Notable for messing with the player and being raised countless times on Pointercrate.

cards.name: agg challenge 18
cards.creator: erzor
cards.description: Lofi art extreme made for their friend agg's birthday. Contains many birds!

cards.name: Friday Vortex
cards.creator: Cersia
cards.description: A 1.9GDPS Nine Circles level that was later uploaded on the 2.1 servers with some visual changes. Has also some similarities to the other "vortex" Nine Circles levels like the wave structuration and sync, feeling like if it was a sequel. It features a Rukkus' remixed version of "Last Friday Night". As a fun fact, it got rated in a Friday Night.

cards.name: GONER
cards.creator: Nightning
cards.description: Nightning's magnum opus, serving as a collection of his thoughts and feelings during his creation process and taking inspiration from the "Blurryface" album by twenty one pilots. The decoration is entirely red, black and white, and the level builds up to a near-incomprehensible yet incredibly cathartic wave section at the song's climax. The only extreme to have its own ARG.

cards.name: Celestial Force
cards.creator: MindCap
cards.description: A mid 2018 megacollab that mainly focuses on asymmetrical duals. The gameplay is incredibly learny and fast paced with the duals requiring complex timings and learning.

cards.name: NULLGATE
cards.creator: Antiprime
cards.description: Solo extreme demon that is visually inspired by "Kyouki". It's gameplay is full based on buffer inputs except for some waves and 3 diagonal cube spams with blue orbs in the drop section, with also containing an asymmetrical dual in the second half, where one player is behind the other. The level is not as intimidating as it seems.

cards.name: Freedom08
cards.creator: Pennutoh
cards.description: An intense four-minute megacollab featuring some very iconic names from early 2.1. It uses its iconic song to the maximum with very high-speed gameplay through the whole level. Its the first extreme to use Freedom Dive as a song, and has been remade in multiple different updates of the game.

cards.name: Nunri
cards.creator: Szilu
cards.description: Szilu's hardest solo level, a purple design level which is well balanced and uses most gamemodes.

cards.name: Loochiverse
cards.creator: Nerhy
cards.description: Made for the MatMart Civilization event with a bossfight against one of the creators (EpicLooch) made through image2gd, although he can't actually damage you. Got a nerfdate later on to make it more timing based and to fix the balancing issues while still keeping it predrop heavy.

cards.name: Atmos
cards.creator: Marwec
cards.description: A second-half heavy Marwec level decorated by a multitude of art-style creators that went through several balancing updates. Features a randomized path at 35% before ramping up in difficulty for the rest of the level with mainly wave-focused asymmetrical duals and chokepoints.

cards.name: Erebus (BoldStep)
cards.creator: Bold
cards.description: Member of the RGB, themed around radioactivity. While it's shorter in length than the other two levels of the trilogy, it makes up for it by having some of the most difficult raw gameplay for its time. Its gameplay is very skill-based with many difficult ship and wave sections sprinkled throughout such as the iconic 85% slope corridor, alongside a distinctive memory cube maze right before the drop.

cards.name: Echoes of Neon
cards.creator: iMinaY
cards.description: A remake of Forsaken Neon and MinAY's proudest megacollab project. It has the original level's colour scheme, slope-oriented structures, large orb clusters and speed portals, while overhauling the decoration with modern tech-based designs and an extension which nearly doubles its length.

cards.name: Nightshade
cards.creator: YakobNugget
cards.description: A very long and colorful memory megacollab that many famous creators have parts in. Was kept completely secret by everyone involved until its release in 2022. Considered one of the best list demons of its time, and was nominated for Best Extreme Demon in the GD Awards.

cards.name: Dark Flare
cards.creator: KeiAs
cards.description: The final and hardest level by Lightning Collab Team, this megacollaboration has no defined decorative theme. It is best known for the part by Dotory that was significantly buffed by the verifier, Plusxenon.

cards.name: Luminosity
cards.creator: Enfur
cards.description: Atmospheric light themed extreme creatively using pads, portals & jump-rings as decoration. Contains difficult swing sections and flowy orb-based gameplay with bright particle-based backgrounds.

cards.name: Chromatic Haze
cards.description: The official sequel to Prismatic Haze, containing even more hard waves, fast-paced and tightier gameplay, clicksync and an even longer and more nerve-racking ending than it's prequel. It also features a very scary-looking last ship containing a black orb as the last click followed by a kinda tight gap as the final release. Despite all of that, it's generally just as well received as Prismatic Haze.

cards.name: The Mainframe
cards.creator: notlsa
cards.description: Notoriously learny memory level filled with creative gimmicks and gameplay tropes. Initially was inspired by the Ultimate Chicken Horse level of the same name.

cards.name: Timor
cards.creator: Colorbolt
cards.description: A horror-themed level with gameplay by Colorbolt and decoration by Maxie25. It started as a top 1 layout which was later nerfed to a top 30 during its verification process. The gameplay is very brief and wave-focused.

cards.name: Tapwreck
cards.creator: MrLorenzo
cards.description: A claustrophobic timings-focused level with corridor gameplay, UFO spam, an infamous first wave with fixed hitboxes and an ending cube with near-blind timings.

cards.name: Ascension
cards.creator: Kolros716
cards.description: A four minute long rainbow level to the tune of Abracadavre from Call of Duty: Black Ops Zombies. A passion project seven years in the making with detailed rainbow designs, interesting line art, and hard gameplay throughout. One of the rawest extremes in the game.

cards.name: Glory
cards.creator: HD Entique
cards.description: A Christian megacollab hosted by Entique, intended to remind everyone of God's love and glory. The level itself is a purple glow-flow with an upbeat Colbreakz song.

cards.name: Jamboree
cards.creator: JustJohn
cards.description: Extremon which takes heavy inspiration from Spectrum Cyclone. Like its predecessor, it features learny asymmetrical dual gameplay and a very hard wave at the end.

cards.name: Ddiamond
cards.description: Colourful wave-based demon featuring Lfritz' trademark rainbow decoration and tight wave corridor gameplay similar to Diamond Blade, as well as some timings and ship gameplay.

cards.name: Devil Vortex
cards.creator: Rustam
cards.description: A level that came from a denied part for Yatagarasu, which Rustam expanded on to make a full level. The decoration uses a hell theme with recognizable artworks. ToshDeluxe superbuffed and hack-verified the level, which later became one of the most infamous hacker exposals.

cards.name: Dole Damos
cards.creator: Jeyzor
cards.description: Quirky Jeyzor level known for its unique designs and fancy transitions. The gameplay is entirely made of duals besides one transition.

cards.name: Factory Realm X
cards.creator: Helpegasus
cards.description: Very old 2.1 grayscale level featuring learny duals, a chokeable last swingcopter and a bossfight (with some inconsistent layering). Generally well-received despite its age.

cards.name: DubKore X
cards.creator: Loogiah
cards.description: A faithful remake of DubCore by MaJackO and Crack, which is one of the hardest 8* levels. This level follows the conventions of MaJackO’s “Core” series, featuring 1.9-style decoration and primarily slow paced gameplay.

cards.name: Next Stage
cards.creator: Zipixbox
cards.description: Zipixbox and TMco collab that is the successor to Heavens Door. Inspired by the Stage 4 boss from I Wanna Kill The Kamilia 3, and a 2.0 level of the same name. Features flashbacks to various older levels in reference to the IWKTK3 bossfight, as well as fully randomized bullet hell styled parts.

cards.name: ConFusion
cards.creator: DreamZoneGD
cards.description: The second and easiest level of the ConTrilogy. Despite not being as fast as the original, this fusion laboratory still contains a hectic amount of movements. With the amount of flashing pulses and fakes featured, your learning experience may be too confusing to handle.

cards.name: Jump Down
cards.creator: TrashThrasher
cards.description: Difficult memory map with authentic 1.3 gameplay

cards.name: Retention Rush
cards.creator: TheBlackHell
cards.description: Very purple memory extreme that mostly consists of fake structures, orbs and portals. The ending requires hitting certain coins after the "listen closely" text. Otherwise, you get geometrically dominated.

cards.name: Tenochtitlan
cards.creator: Alpha rainbow
cards.description: Acropolis-styled level with a theme centered around the ancient Aztec city of the same name. It's very timing based, featuring a lot of hard cube and ball parts, as well as a kind of chokeable wave at the end. Rumoured to not be well placed due to lack of victors.

cards.name: FIREPOWER (Sillow)
cards.creator: Sillow
cards.description: One of the longest nine circles extremes with a highly diverse skillset range. Has a high quality orange design style with a lot of character, featuring many creatures and monsters, and even has a snake that you fly through. Gets gradually harder and faster paced as the level progresses, and features hard asymmetrical duals.

cards.name: 0 Techno
cards.creator: cherryteam
cards.description: Cherryteam collab hosted by MinAY, 'designed to make your eyes bleed'. Verification video is a placeholder showcase

cards.name: lacy
cards.creator: Enfur
cards.description: Calm pink XL megacollab to the tune of Lacy by Olivia Rodrigo. Has an asymmetrical dual in the middle where your icon can land on your ship.

cards.name: bell
cards.creator: rozengerj
cards.description: Solo extreme with faithful, highly detailed core-styled decoration.

cards.name: POW
cards.creator: deactive
cards.description: Super spammy level that is the sequel to WOW

cards.name: Death
cards.creator: AleeXhey
cards.description: A nine minute long emotionally powerful level that took over six years to complete. The first third is noticeably harder, but there is still tough gameplay very far into the level. A tribute to TSGuy, may he rest in peace.

cards.name: Apollo 11
cards.creator: nasgubb
cards.description: The finale to Nasgubb's Space Trilogy that took over two years to create. A very long moon themed extreme with mostly simple consistency based gameplay, though it does feature a few memory/gimmicky sections. Known for being very stressful but enjoyable.

cards.name: TheCinnyBun
cards.creator: cinnamon
cards.description: A joke level Renn241 created for the player Cinny. The gameplay is made up of super fast flow gameplay and extremely difficult wave sections.

cards.name: Cadrega City
cards.creator: Pennutoh
cards.description: Extreme demon remake of Kurumi City that is also loosely inspired by Necropolis. It uses mostly muted colors and contains highly unorthodox yet satisfying clicksync gameplay and asymmetrical duals, with the non-dual sections being overall harder and some notable difficulty spikes being present at 54% and 65%-70%.

cards.name: Digital Descent
cards.description: A former Top 1 which was originally easier than its predecessor until it got a buffdate. The decoration follows a similar theme to Artifical Ascent with 2.1 elements sprinkled throughout, and its difficulty notably spikes in the middle third of the level.

cards.name: Stalemate Redux
cards.creator: TehTactiq
cards.description: A remake of the insane demon Stalemate, which was falsely placed at #1 as the verifier insisted upon it being harder than Yatagarasu. The level features early 2.1 decoration, often dark and obscuring, with the 76–100% section being picked through a creator contest.

cards.name: ZAPHKIEL
cards.creator: Darwin
cards.description: A former top level from early 2.1 notable for its extremely difficult wave parts, an iconic and climactic lava-themed section in the second half, and overall its awkward yet oddly satisfying gameplay. Initially hack-verified by Noctafly.

cards.name: RGB
cards.creator: SleyGD
cards.description: A solo 2.1 extreme demon made by SleyGD themed after the colors red, green, and blue. The level contains many different flashy background effects and a interesting mix of learny and skill-based gameplay. The level is notorious for its very laggy full detail mode and very difficult asymmetrical dual from 76-100.

cards.name: Omicron
cards.creator: Team Proxima
cards.description: Unofficial greek letter mega collab hosted by Team Proxima. Has a cool minigame at the end for a coin.

cards.name: Adelucid
cards.creator: Arraegen
cards.description: A gimmicky and fast-paced Extreme Demon utilizing Passable blocks, orb-based gameplay and uniquely ethereal decoration. Its a "true solo"  with the creator having finished the entire song, gameplay, decoration and verification by himself.

cards.name: SOLEIL
cards.creator: luhlamar ☀️
cards.description: Well received solo design-art-effect level centered around the sun, moon, and stars. Known to progressively get more difficult, and also have chokepoints in the break part at 44%.

cards.name: lovel
cards.creator: Eveteer
cards.description: Love themed memory & design level with a mostly hot pink colour scheme. The hardest part is the drop with an incredibly difficult mini wave dual. It was made for valentines day, but was a few days late with its release.

cards.name: Tempered Steel
cards.creator: ItsHybrid
cards.description: Originally an impossible top 1, which was later nerfed to top 50 after being hosted by ItsHybrid. It is the first level in the Metal trilogy. The decoration is themed around steel and heat, with a gray and yellow theme.

cards.name: Killbot
cards.creator: Bold
cards.description: A memory level heavily inspired by the 1.9 level “Chaotic Machine.” The level is themed around a virus installing itself on the player's computer, visually obstructing the gameplay through flashes on the screen on top of a lot of fake routes. Also has an infamous UFO chokepoint at the end.

cards.name: vaenstep
cards.creator: vaen
cards.description: A typical Renn241 extreme named after the player vaen, who verified and published the level. It is especially skill-based with the slow yet nerve-wracking 72% section being a main highlight. Its decoration uses a diverse colour palette and becomes a colourful mess during the drop despite the level's overall simplicity.

cards.name: Delta Interface
cards.creator: Platnuu
cards.description: The first installment of the Interface series. Has a lengthy predrop, followed by a difficult fast-paced drop, continued with a nerve-racking ending.  One of the first rated extreme demons to use a NONG, albeit the song has since been added to the GD Music Library.

cards.name: The Moon Below
cards.creator: Onvil
cards.description: The first of two levels in the Beneath - Upward: Perfume EP by Onvil, preceding The Garden Above. It is the harder of the two by far, featuring a cube section with near-invisible timings and a ship section demanding a lot of ship control, separated by a 20 second-long dash orb. The level uses glow objects, cold colours, and is entirely in slow speed to create a tranquil, melancholic atmosphere.

cards.name: Video
cards.creator: MaxxoRMeN
cards.description: An 8 minute long level themed around MaxxoRMeN's experiences with internet addiction. It has a randomised minigame section where you have to look out for Mr. Wireless and is accompanied by nearly a minute of difficult fast-paced gameplay in the intro and a high-energy drop with a learny dual 6 minutes in. Extremely well-received for its progression and song representation.

cards.name: find the answer
cards.creator: qalli
cards.description: A solo extreme demon made by qalli, which uses a follow trigger setup to make unusual offset dual gameplay, along with other gimmicky gameplay throughout.

cards.name: Artificial Ascent
cards.description: An extremely popular former top 1 megacollab made in 2.0, initially hosted by LmAnubis and finished by Viprin. The level contains a variety of fast-paced gameplay parts made by 18 different creators, spanning almost 2 and a half minutes. It went on to have multiple remakes and sequels, becoming the first installment of the Technology Trilogy.

cards.name: Budding Roses
cards.creator: Zeronium
cards.description: A decently slow-paced megacollab hosted by Zeronium based on his old ship challenge "Vera Lynn." Because of this, the level has many hard ship parts, most notably the ship at 31%-42%, which is the same section of the song used within the original challenge.

cards.name: TURN THE LIGHTS OFF
cards.creator: nikoberry
cards.description: Zeronium CC entry that uses a Tally Hall song about puberty. The predrop and intermission are shrouded in darkness to match the name (someone turned the lights off). Said parts are also the hardest.

cards.name: Power Grid
cards.creator: Zyraa
cards.description: Fast-paced design extreme with a timings-based first half and a more memory-based second half. Originally was verified by Zeronium before being slightly nerfed and bugfixed by Lucidium.

cards.name: Stereo Extremeness
cards.creator: vortrox
cards.description: A popular superbuff of Stereo Madness with gameplay made by Vortrox. The level contains very precise timing gameplay, mostly following the layout of Stereo Madness with a difficult robot section in the second half. Was initially made for a youtube video and was later decorated following the layout's initial success.

cards.name: Low Death
cards.creator: KrmaL
cards.description: A superbuffed remake of High Life by Migueword featuring KrmaL's signature unorthodox gameplay with difficult wave and ship sections. There are many easter eggs and ancient memes scattered around the level.

cards.name: I Cry
cards.creator: GrenadeofTacos
cards.description: The first level in Tacos' 1.9 GDPS Earth Circles series. Features unique Frutiger Aero decoration and includes a 'choose your path section' in the second half as well as a memory part.

cards.name: Bete Noire
cards.creator: ThePurgatory115
cards.description: The unofficial sequel to the Nine Circles level Fear Me, this extremon is space/electric themed and is very reminiscent of levels like Cosmic Cyclone. Has an endscreen which lasts over 30% of the level.

cards.name: Belloq
cards.description: A desert-themed level based on Pennutoh’s “Spicy Layout #10.” The gameplay emphasizes clicksync, with decoration themed around Egyptian culture.

cards.name: Crystal
cards.creator: Zeronium
cards.description: A solo extreme demon by Zeronium featuring a crystal cave theme. Its gameplay focuses on overall clicksync flowy gameplay with a slight emphasis on ship and wave. Contains a difficult last ship and has a very satisfying dash orb at 53%.

cards.name: Diamond Disco
cards.creator: Zeronium
cards.description: A pure solo extreme one year in the making, notable for its high-CPS clicksync gameplay, an incredibly mesmerising dual and its colour bass-complextro hybrid song. It focuses heavily on song representation, and uses editor particles, bright flashes, screen effects, complementary colours and player movements to create the vibe of a loud EDM disco party.

cards.creator: guillester
cards.description: Well known old level that was abandoned after one of its creators quit the game in 2016, but was revived and verified seemingly out of nowhere in 2020. The gameplay is generally well received, but it's very first half heavy. It's well known for its effecty background, with simple silhouette structures. The level is exactly 2 minutes and 11 seconds long, matching the level's name.

cards.name: Xronier
cards.creator: (じの) JinoBeats ♫
cards.description: A short, red and blue, pure solo extreme made and verified by now-music artist JinoBeats. Matching the song's chaotic, high-tempo energy its visuals are extremely flashy and its gameplay features many high-CPS bursts and is fast-paced all around. Very well-received amongst victors for getting extremely consistent after some practice, in part thanks to the update it received in 2.2.

cards.name: Night Rider
cards.creator: lmAnubis
cards.description: Legendary futuristic cyberpunk-themed XL extreme developed by some of the most distinguished community figures over the course of 5 years. Utilizing an upbeat glitch-hop track, its blend of intricate art and glow-design style decoration creates a unique and immersive metropolis atmosphere. The level consists of mostly learny gameplay across its 3-minute runtime, with the first third of the level being significantly more difficult than the rest.

cards.name: Funnyname Funnygame
cards.creator: idleunam
cards.description: A three minute long 1.9 effect style solo level that took over two years to create, with parts very reminiscent of Lightwave. The difficulty increases as the level progresses, and the second half features some beautifully janky duals and the infamous Lightwave wave. Has become an insider meme in Aredl for its 1.9 fever dream-like style and low victor count.

cards.name: Edelweiss
cards.creator: hexitine
cards.description: Ridiculously high CPS and fast-paced mountain themed extreme demon with super learny and middle-carried gameplay and a complex click pattern. Many of the hitboxes are extra lenient, and despite some people experiencing bugs and chokepoints, the level is very well received and highly enjoyed, and many people do it as a hardest. Pronounced ay-dull-vice.

cards.name: Polygonal Paradox
cards.creator: Hypno
cards.description: Black Blizzard inspired timing-based extreme utilizing complementary colors throughout, with a tricky dual in the second half. The gameplay is praised among victors despite being a relatively niche level.

cards.name: Floating Outskirts
cards.creator: YoReid
cards.description: Technically impressive Pre-platformer platformer level made completely in 2.1. Contains 10 unique sections, each with their own gimmick and environment. Notoriously difficult to control, but satisfying to pull off.

cards.name: Black Flag
cards.creator: NEKONGAMES
cards.description: Click-heavy pirate-themed level with an oddly long predrop and tricky muscle memory-based UFO sections. Known to be incredibly unoptimized and object dense. LDM may be required.

cards.name: Missing Benefits
cards.creator: TGI
cards.description: The first and only megacollaboration by Team Caliber, with gimmicky gameplay and dark, greyscale decoration. Known for the last 20%, which is significantly harder than the rest of the level.

cards.name: Bass Cave
cards.creator: Bloodshot
cards.description: This level was originally a hard demon, which then got superbuffed and hack-verified. The level later got another update and a legitimate verification by nSwish. Known for its chokepoint heavy gameplay and the goofy looking demon face at 14%.

cards.name: Agony
cards.creator: Vizitek
cards.description: A Congregation-inspired solo extreme which, as the name suggests, is themed around agony with its bright flashes, flesh-like designs and an appropriately-chosen song. Its decoration is made mostly out of the 2.2 pixel objects, and hence it has a surprisingly low object count despite its level of detail and its length.

cards.name: Auroral Ascent
cards.creator: Nexel
cards.description: Well-received clicksync solo extreme aimed to be a more accessible level in Nexel's catalogue. Consists of a subdued color palette and an intense dual in the second half.

cards.name: Quantum Processing
cards.creator: Riot
cards.description: A superbuffed remake of the main level Blast Processing, with gameplay by Riot and Hinds and a short section by Zobros.

cards.name: Dualies
cards.creator: Gablor
cards.description: 1-minute layout by Gablor which was decoed by multiple creators. Visually inspired from 2.0 levels and Plasma Pulse Finale. Features mirror portal gameplay in an unorthodox manner.

cards.name: VIPER
cards.creator: Joswhay
cards.description: Green-themed glow-design megacollab named after the F-777 song it uses. The level features chokepoint-heavy flow gameplay including various short bursts of difficult wave inputs, with 78% being the most commonly criticized among victors.

cards.name: Black Blizzard
cards.creator: KrmaL
cards.description: Former top 10 solo level by KrmaL. Initially this level was harder and being verified in secret, but after the level was leaked through a hack, KrmaL verified and released a nerfed version. This level got Creo well known within the community. The gameplay is gimmicky and extremely predrop carried.

cards.name: Neurostasis
cards.creator: KiwiPenguin
cards.description: The long standing former top 1 level on the enjoyments list. This level has gimmicky memory gameplay throughout, and most of it is in the ship gamemode with a lot of orbs.

cards.name: Ethereal Artifice
cards.creator: Zeroya
cards.description: Generally well recieved 2.1 megacollab with a red and green color scheme. It's a fast-paced XL level spanning just over two minutes in length.

cards.name: DESOLATE
cards.creator: Billzer
cards.description: Cube-based extreme themed around a stormy city. Somewhat gradually increases in intensity, but retains a dark and lonely atmosphere throughout.

cards.name: REDEEMER
cards.creator: surveyor23
cards.description: A 7 minute long extreme where giant humanoid spirits are released from their tombs, destroying the earth as they ascend. Widely praised for its atmosphere, storytelling, and song representation. The gameplay is very gimmicky, and features a very hard central section and an asymmetrical ship dual at the end.

cards.name: Astral Divinity
cards.creator: knobbelboy
cards.description: One of Knobbelboy's most iconic and controversial solo levels. Formerly named God Eater, the level had to be taken down for copyright infringement, eventually re-releasing with a new name and new decoration. The gameplay is rather skill based, with very difficult ship and wave parts. Was relatively unoptimized before getting an update that cut its object count by nearly half.

cards.name: Glowy
cards.creator: Rob Buck
cards.description: A level with gameplay by Sunnett and decoration by Rob Buck. The decoration gradually becomes more object-heavy throughout the level, making it harder to see as the level goes on. The level was meant to mock other glow-heavy levels at the time.

cards.name: Glitched Memories
cards.creator: TCTeam
cards.description: A early 2.1 mega-collab semi-memory level that remixes many clubstep inspired levels. (ie Clubstep, Ice Carbon Diablo X, Tartarus, Red World, 9Step, and Clubstep Nightmares)

cards.name: Static Ignition
cards.creator: Maple 🍁
cards.description: A solo remake of Electroman Adventures meant to rival Funnyman Adventures. Originally started as mid tier extreme for its time but was buffed in the decoration process. Received a small nerfdate in January of 2023 to nerf some of the highly controversial cube choke points.

cards.name: MISFIRE
cards.creator: galaxxyss
cards.description: Pawsome furry themed extweme using an infamously difficult to listen to furry rap song because someone insulted Galaxxyss' music taste. Contains well-recieved flow gameplay with some notable chokepoints like the 52% ship and the "seven inches wave". Used to be harder but received HRT shortly after falling of pointercwate :3

cards.name: Faded Dream
cards.creator: DreamTide
cards.description: Sequel to Endless Dream, created and verified solo, on mobile. Memorable for its atmosphere-focused visuals and climatic drop. Contains learny but very consistent gameplay and a difficult dual at 57%.

cards.name: BuTiTi III
cards.creator: JonathanGD
cards.description: Jonathan's nearly-cancelled threequel to his infamous Butiti series. The level is XL, featuring rainbow styled deco and a flashy and laggy pixelated background at the duals. It's also very second half-heavy, with hard and learny duals and a very chokeable ending, it also has interesting and complex coin routes.

cards.name: Lovestruck
cards.creator: Tuna310
cards.description: Love-themed sequel to Voltage featuring unconventional, heart filled decoration. Built among close friends including popular creators like Pocke, Loltad, & Shmigels. Memorable for its bubbly colors and impossibly memorization-heavy gameplay. Features a unique final ship in which all creators constructed blocky hearts to weave between.

cards.name: BBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBB
cards.creator: MikeWheelerFan
cards.description: 2.1 Megacollab hosted by MikeWheelerFan, formally known as Roimousti. It is the sequel to another MikeWheelerFan level called "AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA". Infamous for the 88% blue pad, and is generally rather negatively perceived.

cards.name: SHOWDOWN (berrytg)
cards.creator: berrytg
cards.description: Flow megacollab using xKore - Showdown that is extremely reminiscent of Saul Goodman, even having the infamous upwards wave corridor at the end. As such, it is very learny with many moving objects and has many tough wave sections.

cards.name: Visurient
cards.creator: fitatfi
cards.description: Really old 2.1 level that was made for their friend Visurient. Took a few years to get rated.

cards.name: The Hell Zone
cards.creator: Stormfly
cards.description: Former top 1 and first level in Sohn0924's hell series created back in 2014. It was later redecorated by Cyclic and TeamN2 members in 2016. This level is a robbed top 1, being the hardest legitimate completion until Sonic Wave got verified a couple months later. Features obscured gameplay with hard timings, blind clicks and mirror portals, but it recieved a update for enjoyment reasons by Stormfly in 2023.

cards.name: Magnificent Gaps
cards.creator: JohnNwaogu
cards.description: A magnificent remake of Impossible Gaps with a lot of finicky gimmicks and a short 2 player part. The level is fully ship gamemode with simple cute designs and visuals. The lord of chokepoints and raw skill gameplay, johnnwaogus magnificent masterpiece

cards.name: Hyperliminal
cards.creator: Andromity
cards.description: Vibrant solo extreme making good use of shaders and 2.2 triggers. Consists of bright flashes, unique designs and complex color schemes. With an enjoyment rating of over 90, the 12 playtesters clearly did their job well!

cards.name: The Sulphur Sea
cards.creator: YoReid
cards.description: A very fast-paced, mini-only solo extreme themed around the Sulphurous Sea from Terraria's Calamity Mod, with a blocky visual style and progressing through the layers of the Abyss, ending off on a randomised bossfight against the Primordial Wyrm. Praised in the community for its well-flowing gameplay and stunning level of detail.

cards.name: Bordon Factory
cards.creator: Bordonn
cards.description: Minimalistic factory themed level that uses gameplay to its fullest potential. Contains multiple gimmicky sections and a randomised bossfight.

cards.name: Hatred
cards.creator: AZuLer4
cards.description: 2.0 demon made up of extremely difficult timing gameplay, an infamous ship gravity portal corridor at 70%, and to top it all off, a memory based mini cube section towards the end. Often draws comparisons to Acropolis due to its similar gameplay and theming.

cards.name: Io
cards.creator: l4tezk
cards.description: Warm-toned 1.9 extreme loosely themed around the highly volcanically active moon Io. Hardest level in Latezk's moons-of-Jupiter series. Features a very gnarly dual at 80%.

cards.name: MUSKY MOLD
cards.creator: wabug
cards.description: Short and unsettling mold/swamp themed extreme, built by the creator while they were in a mental hospital. Has a unique cube-copter part and some extremely precise timings.

cards.name: Voyager 1
cards.creator: oliverbum
cards.description: A 2.0 styled megacollab one year in the making, encapsulating a variety of decoration styles and gameplay tropes from that era. Throughout its 2 and a half minute runtime it features raw decoration, moving objects and bizarre duals galore, and paired with an old Bossfight song makes for a charming and authentic experience.

cards.name: Gateway
cards.creator: Eveteer
cards.description: Solo extreme with unconventional but intuitive well-received gameplay. Surprisingly Eveteer's first finished level! Notable for its creative effects, good music representation and unique atmosphere.

cards.name: Auditory Breaker
cards.creator: LazerBlitz
cards.description: Nerfed remake of Sonic Wave made by Lazerblitz and Manix featuring early 2.1 tech style decoration.

cards.name: lodin da fish washer
cards.creator: koko43
cards.description: 🐟 A surreal modern style cube/robot timing level with very little spike usage. Features a unique and particularly hard timing (known locally as a 'fish washer') that is repeated multiple times, as well as lots more unusual timing gameplay. 🐟

cards.name: Nostalgia
cards.creator: WT80
cards.description: One of the more obscure KrmaL Contest 3 levels. Having a white & gold effect style featuring shape-shifting spikes that turn into blocks. Known for its slower paced gameplay, a Shardscapes inspired robot part at around the halfway mark and having a blind final orb at the end. Has gone through many bug-fixes.

cards.name: Voltage (Hypno)
cards.creator: Hypno
cards.description: Contrary to ThePurgatory's "Voltage," Hypno's memory megacollab consists of incredibly unique gameplay and visuals. Specifically, it combines traditional design with extremely unorthodox symmetrical-ish gameplay and structuring, making for a particularly learny and satisfying experience.

cards.name: Necrocide
cards.description: Semi-forgotten extreme demon that went unrated for almost 7 years, which is also very memorable for its hyper-detailed factory style and surprising edginess for the time. Gameplay wise features an absurdbly high CPS beginning, followed by a floating ball and spider and a nerve control ship part at the end.

cards.name: Hyper Paradox
cards.creator: ItsHybrid
cards.description: A nerfed remake of Hyper Paracosm featuring a modernized 2.1 style rather than raw Nine Circles decoration. The difficulty is concentrated in the latter parts of the drop rather than the beginning and, much like the original, it contains a lengthy ending from 65% onwards that serves as a massive nerve check. Used to be notorious for a misaligned dual section at 37% that still remains without a complete fix.

cards.name: Carmine Cascade
cards.creator: AAAAAlex
cards.description: Scarlet Surge remake with the signature deep red flashy pulses. Features much more memory heavy gameplay than the original, in AAAAAlex's signature style. Extremely well received despite technically being a superbuffed 7 star.

cards.name: The Hell World
cards.creator: Stormfly
cards.description: A redecorated version of the former top 1 demon of the same name created by Sohn0924 back in 2014, the level is one of the last 2.0 extreme demons to be uploaded, with its rate causing the rate of Hate War and The Hell Zone. Updated due to enjoyability reasons by Stormfly in 2023.

cards.name: SubSonic
cards.description: The 4th official entry of the sonic series, and the hardest one. It was generally considered anticlimactic when it first came out, but nowadays it's gameplay is considered balanced and consistent throughout the entire level. Features an intimidating dual by Jeyzor at the ending.

cards.name: MONSTROSITY
cards.creator: Snarlax523
cards.description: A level that was hack-verified, and as such has a lot of chokepoints, such as many parts in the pre-drop and the section around 42%. The gameplay is timing-based and gimmicky, with a repeated ship control section in the last 25%.

cards.name: Khorne
cards.creator: Stilluetto
cards.description: Legendary extreme demon with a very rich history. The original version created by Hota1991 had around a million objects, the most out of any level of its time. Because of how laggy the level was for most people, Stilluetto created an nerfed optimized version, cutting the object count in half. The original version was rated twice on accident, once in 2023 and again in 2026 right before the optimized version got rated. The level is split into nine parts, each exploring a different part of hell.

cards.name: Crippled Depression
cards.creator: NateFH
cards.description: A buffed & decorated re-imagining of "Conical Depression" by KrmaL. It sticks true with Conical Depression's unconventional timing-based gameplay, additionally adding different mechanics of its own. At 50%, the level leads into a neon fast-paced ball part from then on to 85%, leading to a classic 1.0-esque UFO section at the end. It has since been poorly received as reflected by its EDEL ranking.

cards.name: Supreme Demon Mix
cards.creator: TwisterDude161
cards.description: A reimagining of Zobros' "Ultimate Demon Mix", often containing fast-paced gameplay requiring a variety of skillsets. Each part of the level is styled after one of 23 different demons.

cards.name: Kinetic Bypass
cards.description: Kinetic Bypass is a fast, skill-based 2.1 design level by Sminx and verified by Luqualizer. Despite its shorter length, it uses a wide variety of gameplay styles; featuring a slow predrop, wave, robot, a long dual, and flow gameplay.

cards.name: Endless Dream
cards.creator: DreamTide
cards.description: A well-received solo level made entirely and verified on mobile. Known for its simple yet pleasing designs, and for being quite enjoyable especially once you get past the learning process.

cards.name: aether (ZeroSR)
cards.creator: ZeroSR
cards.description: Atmospheric design level known for being the first extreme to really go all out with 2.2 features. Contains simplistic monochrome decoration experimenting with gradient triggers and shaders, paired with fast-paced and gimmicky gameplay. Notably has a very scary wave at ~46%.

cards.name: Mujigae
cards.creator: TheShadowRealm
cards.description: Rainbow colored nine circles extreme which can be very hard on the eyes to some without the LDM. It features very difficult chokepoints, most notably the wave gap at 68%. One of two extremes to be featured on the account TheShadowRealm after its creator was exposed.

cards.name: Betrayal of Destiny
cards.creator: Splash
cards.description: A lesser-known 2.1 extreme based on WeoWeoTeo's Betrayal of Fate. Features skill based gameplay in the first half before transitioning to more memory based gameplay.

cards.name: Worse Trip
cards.creator: Loltad
cards.description: Loltad level with very unique deco, paired with very unique (and fun) gameplay.

cards.name: Cheyenne
cards.creator: josi
cards.description: The sequel to the Insane Demon Apache, featuring blinding decoration with an extremely intense song. Started in 2018 and was reworked multiple times.

cards.name: Rate Demon
cards.creator: MikeWheelerFan
cards.description: Early 2.1 recent tab themed joke extreme, with unorthodox decoration and many default blocks. The gameplay is entirely cube, robot, and ship, with a long robot part at the drop and an infamous last ship.

cards.name: Dolos
cards.creator: Enzeux
cards.description: 2.1 click sync megacollab, known for its low CPS. Much of the level is a dual, and the ending is difficult and nerve-wracking. Named after the Greek god of deception.

cards.name: Ithacropolis
cards.creator: BIGMAC77
cards.description: Purple Necropolis remake with a city theme throughout that was made during the transition between 2.0 and 2.1. Just like Necropolis, this level features heavy unbalanced gameplay, like the wave at 31% or the ending corridor, as well as very awkward gameplay and chokepoints. Generally not well recieved and also known for it's text right before the drop "Enter the CITY".

cards.name: milo
cards.creator: xSlendy
cards.description: A Classic styled xSlendy level seemingly inspired by Saul Goodman. Startpos: 120275555

cards.name: RASH
cards.creator: Loltad
cards.description: Solo extreme themed around diseased and decomposing flesh, with fast paced and generally well received gameplay, and strong music representation. Most notably has a very confusing and unusually structured timing based predrop. The previous description was way too funny so I'm leaving it in: "Loltad level with a very unique and interesting theme, paired with very unique and interesting gameplay."

cards.name: ErebuS (Platnuu)
cards.creator: Platnuu
cards.description: Nerfed and redecorated remake of Erebus made by Platnuu. This level leans into a more biohazard and toxic style theme instead of the generic green theming that the original has. The gameplay is pretty much the same as Erebus except it's easier, but it notably lacks the iconic last click of the original.

cards.name: kuiper belt
cards.creator: Nordgeez
cards.description: A 2.2 remake of the wave-only level Kuiper by Quasar and TMNGaming. Made to be as faithful to the original as possible, down to even the balancing. Has a high CPS part at 50% that may be difficult for some.

cards.name: Athanatos
cards.creator: Exenity
cards.description: Hack-verified level from 2016 which includes very difficult wave chokepoints, including an infamously difficult dual wave at 70%. It is one of the many hell-themed top 1s, surpassing Sakupen Hell when it was placed.

cards.name: Loose Screws
cards.creator: Aeyooo
cards.description: Incredibly creative and unpolished extreme with alternative memory gameplay and extremely chaotic decoration, both of which inspired by Toxin Lab III. Features a difficult wave maze and an intimidating predrop. Despite its quirks, the gameplay is very highly regarded among victors!

cards.name: Carnage Mode
cards.creator: Findexi
cards.description: Early 2.1 timing and nerve control level notable due to numerous chokepoints throughout the level, most noteworthy being the 'pants-shittingly' difficult ending segment by Lemons.

cards.name: Gentlemens Clique (Solo)
cards.creator: Alph
cards.description: A 2-player level, a part of the gang trilogy. The level's name is meant to be a British version of Based Gang. Has a key you can collect to turn the bossfight icons into the Bass Cave demon.

cards.name: Wild Rose
cards.creator: galaxxyss
cards.description: Vibrant flower-themed design level dedicated to the musician and VTuber Mori Calliope. It features a strong contrast where its slow-paced and tranquil build-up breaks into a flowy and dazzling fast-paced drop lasting until the end.

cards.name: miss you
cards.creator: shmigels
cards.description: Shmigels solo level featuring intentionally wacky gameplay. Has an infamous last ship, and the asymmetrical dual is featured in BarbarosFinaleFinale with added camera effects.

cards.name: New Record
cards.creator: Temp
cards.description: A highly click-sync based megacollab. While the gameplay aligns with the music, its gimmicky nature still requires memorization and practice. The decoration is colorful and energetic, reflecting the fast-paced song. The layout showcase, "highscore w/ clicks", managed to get over 3M views.

cards.name: project girlboss
cards.creator: koko43
cards.description: The self-described "most confusing level" in the game, and it's pretty easy to see why. Made by Koko43, this level contains some of the most unconventional (albeit satisfying) gameplay out of any level, with the dual spider section in the final third being particularly unorthodox. The level has a blue and white color palette and a liminal atmosphere that works exceptionally well with the song choice. The cube click at 91% is notoriously difficult.

cards.name: reset your mind
cards.creator: Fursona
cards.description: Glitchy & hyper-dense solo 1.9 styled level about what the level's name suggests. Memorable for its fun, unconventional memory gameplay and claustrophobic structuring that might appear as object spam at first.

cards.name: Twilight Coexistence
cards.creator: NesiaL
cards.description: Relatively unknown Korean duo level notable for its extremely fast-paced dual gameplay. Contains neo-design adjacent decoration with an inconsistent pink and blue palette.

cards.name: Removed Submission
cards.creator: WHErwin
cards.description: Newgrounds-themed level with a gray and orange color scheme, and uses elements of the site such as bits of text, a big angry emoji, and tankmen to compliment the Newgrounds style. Known for its iconic song which disses BrokenDeck, and the drop parts using unique spider timings.

cards.name: Cryothorn Hell
cards.creator: TwisterDude161
cards.description: An  ice-themed remaster of Sakupen Hell, containing the same gameplay with some alterations, including the addition of a difficult wave extension and a chokable cube section near the end.

cards.name: Tunnel
cards.creator: akunakun
cards.description: An extremely large megacollab of 193 people, hosted by Akunakun, where each creator has a 3 block long part. The gameplay is corridor based.

cards.name: Phobos
cards.creator: KrmaL
cards.description: 1.9/2.0 megacollab that was initially hack-verified in a much harder state, but was reverified in an easier form by KrmaL. The level doesn't have a very high enjoyment, and contains a lot of difficulty spikes.

cards.name: WcropoliX
cards.creator: BlassCFB
cards.description: Known for being a robbed top 1 and taking nearly 9 years to finally get rated. Infamous for its wave at around halfway through the level.

cards.name: TeaM Z
cards.creator: 99percent
cards.description: Early 2.1 design Extreme Demon famous for having an incorrectly layered "bossfight" by Xyriak. Supposedly the final level in a series. It is also notorious for having unconventional gameplay.

cards.name: dance (Solo)
cards.creator: MysteryMan
cards.description: Solo created and verified 2-player level made for Lia's and Gecko's 2P Creator Contest, using a song from a Persona 4 spin-off game. The gameplay is entirely clicksync and very learny. The drop, from 33%-42%, is by far the hardest part.

cards.name: Infernal Abyss
cards.creator: GgB0y
cards.description: Forgotten sequel to Cataclysm. Hack verified like its predecessor. Infamous for a really difficult UFO at 65%, and a difficult coin at the last ship.

cards.name: Masterpiece
cards.creator: vRidge
cards.description: An open ended solo level that is intended to run alongside vRidge's other extreme To The Blue Moon.

cards.name: The Old Trail
cards.creator: Bram4Real
cards.description: Solo intended XL 2p level by Bram4Real, inspired by his own experience in trail hiking. The level has hard timing gameplay for the predrop and drop, and then turns into a 2p dual for the rest.

cards.name: WOBBLING MACHINE (2P)
cards.creator: Smarted
cards.description: 2 player extreme where one player has to perform standard gameplay as the other player clicks in a repetitive pattern, matching the rhythm of the 'wobbling' technique in Smash Bros. Melee. Originally hack verified and unrated, but later nerfed and re-verified after which it took over two years to get re-rated.

cards.name: hot rod
cards.creator: stcubing
cards.description: stcubing's first megacollab, birthed from a Cognition/Oblivion spinoff layout created out of spite for Carcano. It features bright colours and decoration with an upbeat song, and is one of the more accessible levels of this genre.

cards.name: Based Gang (Solo)
cards.creator: Alph
cards.description: A 2-player level that takes inspiration from Bang Gang. In order to make it more feasible to do solo, the final 20% can be nerfed in exchange for not getting the coin. Despite this, it's still the hardest part of the level when done solo.

cards.name: MadMansion
cards.creator: GunnerBones
cards.description: A remake of the 1.9 level MadHouse, with a grayscale color palette and subtle hints of other hues. Like the original, it is heavily memory-based and uses the same song.

cards.name: S3NT1M3NT
cards.creator: Shyne
cards.description: A short and fast paced ATOMIC CANNON inspired solo level by AREDL list leader Shyne! Features names of many AREDL members throughout, a horizontal spider orb, and has an infamously hard wave near the end. Has become a large insider meme in AREDL, and additionally took 6 months and 33 opinions to place on NLW...

cards.name: Summer Sky
cards.creator: Luvery
cards.description: Extremely well-polished XL sky themed extreme memorable for its clean, glass-like block designs and very very well-received clicksync gameplay. Notably uses a special time warp trigger mechanic to keep sync as consistent and quality as possible.

cards.name: EnvY
cards.creator: DanZmeN
cards.description: DanZmeN level with a goated song, overall is extremely fun, but can feel frustrating due to balancing issues, with waves being the primary difficulty of the level. The ending is terrifying.

cards.name: Bang Gang (Solo)
cards.creator: DanZmeN
cards.description: The first 2-player extreme in Geometry Dash. Was verified by four different people swapping positions mid-completion. The decoration is in DanZmeN's typicial 2019 style. Features learny segments and a bossfight with arrows that are not entirely accurate. The first victor, Grey479 is also the verifier for the level's solo completion, with them being awarded $3,000 AUD for it.

cards.name: OneAttempt
cards.creator: X Future
cards.description: A fast-paced level themed around OneShot, containing sections that represent the original areas of the game. Features timings in various gamemodes throughout the level, as well as a choice on how the level ends likewise to the source material and an alternate ending/coin route through using practice mode that changes the decoration noticeably.

cards.name: Coolie Mazie Paloozi
cards.creator: akunakun
cards.description: Dense & colorful memory "insane demon" created by the feared memory creator Akunakun and verified by the beloved youtuber Tride. Includes 12 large, distinct, and extremely confusing mazes.

cards.name: Poltergeist Reborn
cards.creator: ThePrimeEvil
cards.description: 2.1 remake of Andromeda's infamous insane demon. While generally better received than the original, this level remains quite chokepoint heavy. Also features a short extension with a tough memory last wave.

cards.name: Falcon16
cards.creator: LIEB
cards.description: 2.1 megacollab hosted by LIEB with a prevalent sky theme throughout, infamous for Tob's steampunk themed part and the tight waves at the beginning of the drop. Despite being considered quite first-half heavy and having several blind clicks, it's still received positively by its victors

cards.name: Blade of Justice
cards.creator: Manix648
cards.description: An extremely high quality 2.0 level by two of the most talented creators at the time. Features multiple iconic parts such as the black hole UFO and asymmetrical dual, and is generally harder at the start and end. Formerly an upcoming top 1 before receiving a large nerfdate making it more accessible and enjoyable. Go up in the ship at 55% to avoid the transition bug!

cards.name: Nautilus
cards.creator: Tabgnid
cards.description: Tabgnid's first solo level, a 1.9-style extreme with flow gameplay inspired by Prismatic Haze.

cards.name: Paranoid Android
cards.creator: Alass
cards.description: A 5 and a half minute level to the tune of the Radiohead song of the same name. It takes on a very progression-based approach to represent its song - the level spends its first half building up to its climax with fast-paced gameplay and flashy visuals before ending off on a much slower 2 minute-long timing-based ending.

cards.name: Vertigo (notLevo)
cards.creator: notLevo
cards.description: An early 2.1 extreme demon that took 8 years to be rated. The gameplay has scattered chokepoints, with the middle of the level being much harder than the rest of the level.

cards.name: AUTONOMICA
cards.creator: xTet
cards.description: Solo XXL greyscale level themed around exploring a mechanical city, and utilising a vocaloid song to good effect. The gameplay incorporates a lot of moving objects, and has a dual heavy second half

cards.name: Absolute Solver
cards.creator: BroZzy3
cards.description: Murder Drones themed level with a nightcore-metal song from the final episode. Involves numerous references from the show and many flashy, tech themed effects. Although incredibly learny, the gameplay is highly praised.

cards.name: THE PRINCE
cards.creator: JustWaaf
cards.description: Repetition-based memory extreme using a Madeon song and only cube, robot and ball for its gamemodes. It's reminiscent of the Sunset Sandstorm predrop, with deviations between the same repeated pattern to match the song. The 2nd half is a nerve wracking ball section that is very chokable.

cards.name: Silentium Gradas
cards.creator: Stormfly
cards.description: A Stormfly megacollab remake of Silent clubstep, containing almost identical gameplay, albeit heavily nerfed.

cards.name: EXPLICIT
cards.creator: saturn
cards.description: A short, extremely fast-paced level made up of highly compressed difficulty in its total runtime of 41 seconds. Has very tight wave parts that require precise control, as well as generally high CPS gameplay chockfull with timings galore.

cards.name: overlook
cards.creator: androgyny
cards.description: An extremely atmospheric timing-focused extreme with it's decoration inspired by the game Rain World, where also, there's no music at all. It's gameplay is considered unbalanced since it contains in the first two thirds a slow-paced ball and cube with very low CPS and tight timings, while the last third contains a difficult last ship with a lot of precise gaps.

cards.name: Infinite Inversion
cards.creator: fil
cards.description: Significantly easier predecessor to Axiom Asterism, featuring electric purple space-themed visuals and fast-paced circles gameplay. Interestingly, the predrop uses only blue pads, orbs & gravity portals.

cards.name: Sakupen Hell
cards.creator: TrusTa
cards.description: Famous for being the level to take the #1 spot away from Bloodbath. Known to be very imbalanced, with the majority of the difficulty coming from the waves. It's also the shortest former top 1 in terms of level length, with the gameplay lasting under 50 seconds.

cards.name: Delicious Dogs
cards.creator: SupaCLUCK
cards.description: A megacollab themed around early 2.1 levels, containing stereotypical decoration and gameplay elements inspired by its reference time period. It took nearly a year for the level to finally get rated.

cards.name: ACHROMATISM
cards.creator: CirclezGD
cards.description: 2.2 Prismatic Haze remake that also doubles as the first Turkish solo extreme demon ever!

cards.name: Betrayal of Fate
cards.creator: weoweoteo
cards.description: A somewhat lesser known 2.0 extreme with skill based gameplay in the first half, which features a relatively difficult mini ball and dual wave section. The second half introduces memory sections including a cube maze that turns invisible towards the end.

cards.name: Chromatic
cards.creator: orangutang
cards.description: The official sequel to Prismatic by CatGeo made by a different creator. The gameplay differs with its faster gameplay and difficult ship parts. The decoration has much more variation in it including a complete tone shift at 64%. The level makes several references to poocubed, another level that uses the same song as Chromatic.

cards.name: Advent Aurora
cards.creator: Ultimxte
cards.description: The last Extreme Demon uploaded in 2.1; A colorful, glowy, and vaguely aurora-themed level, described by the creator as a "floating world under the moonlight."

cards.name: Revelations
cards.creator: vRidge
cards.description: A loose mashup of all of vRidges levels. Decorated with a solid design style and utilizing minimal effects. Pair upped with fast paced clicksync and wave burst gameplay. Containing meaningful text scattered around the level.

cards.name: help
cards.creator: llertt
cards.description: A-

cards.name: UnveiL
cards.creator: Kr4t
cards.description: Shiver me timbers, be that an XXL pirate themed megacollab! Yahar matey! (full creator list will be added soon)

cards.name: Fusion Z
cards.creator: PlebKingdom
cards.description: The final installment in the Fusion series. An extremely long and intense level with well rounded but stressful gameplay. Has a very long, complex, and controversial history.

cards.name: Revolution 1993
cards.creator: Bemq
cards.description: Solo XXL+ extreme to the tune of Revolution 1993 by Jamiroquai. Features many dual sections over its 10 minute runtime. Come on, fight the power!

cards.name: Carcano
cards.creator: Asuith
cards.description: A popular Cognition-style corridor level built by two Polish creators, with high CPS and timing-based gameplay. Despite receiving a nerfdate in early 2022, community opinions are still quite mixed, which wasn't helped by the slope interaction changes in 2.2.

cards.name: Carbon Fiber
cards.creator: xSlendy
cards.description: Speedy grey & yellow design solo with very high-cps gameplay, clocking in at only 50 seconds long. Contains very difficult wave bursts paired with flowy timings. Notably suffered from a "horrendous case of forced difficulty" before it was re-playtested and verified, allowing it to become pretty well-received now!

cards.name: OPSM1
cards.creator: VARSE
cards.description: A VARSE level with bright and modern decoration. A good majority of the difficulty comes from the wave sections in the first half, with other small chokepoints scattered throughout the level.

cards.name: Le Midd Mapperoonies
cards.creator: akunakun
cards.description: A three minute long non stop memory level. Gets gradually harder as the level progresses, with a very hard wave near the end. Received a balance update in late 2024 which both buffed the first half and nerfed the second half, easing the difficulty increase through the level.

cards.name: Astrophobia
cards.creator: Jakalope
cards.description: 1.9gdps nine circles extreme demon collab made by Jakalope, royen, and valentine that focuses on detail and intense nine circles effects reflecting the song. The gameplay and design is generally praised by most people who've played it.

cards.name: Omorfia
cards.creator: HHyper
cards.description: Effect layout by HHyper, with an iconic bossfight at the end. The gameplay is gimmicky and learny.

cards.name: Game Over
cards.creator: guillester
cards.description: A very unorthodox level featuring an abundance of difficult timings in the first section, becoming a high-CPS wave consistency challenge in the second section that tests the player's stamina and spam skill.

cards.name: Project Nexus
cards.creator: NEKONGAMES
cards.description: The official sequel to the list extreme Jigsaw, featuring similarly flowy gameplay and polished tech-themed designs. Originally was gonna be verified by Nexus, but it was passed to LordVaderCraft instead. Generally flew under the radar significantly more than its predecessor.

cards.name: GewErbiX
cards.creator: Wintter
cards.description: A bright and colourful flow level with a lot of orb focused gameplay.

cards.name: Glacial Torrent
cards.creator: Nell
cards.description: Early 2.1 XXL ice-themed megacollab completely created and verified by mobile players. Generally pretty incohesive but charming visually, with part quality varying very significantly throughout. Its gameplay is high-cps and mildly janky, reflecting its time period pretty well.

cards.name: water demon
cards.creator: hexitine
cards.description: Very complex hexitine level that plays like a puzzle, and includes a difficult mirror section in the middle. The structuring and effects are unique and well-made, but the level is generally poorly received. Contains invisible hitboxes.

cards.name: Untitled
cards.creator: iiLuna
cards.description: Turqoise and cyan colored level with somewhat high cps sync gameplay. The main difficulty comes from the drop. Resembles one of the 'reta' levels to some extent.

cards.name: Inside
cards.creator: Hypno
cards.description: Hypno's second solo Extreme Demon project, inspired by the rhythm game Sayonara Wild Hearts. It showcases Hypno's signature gameplay style: learny yet intuitive, focused on unique structuring. Noteworthy for its difficult duals, exceptional song representation and simplistic neon designs.

cards.name: moment
cards.creator: Lexycat
cards.description: Highly popular and well received flowy extreme with a simplistic yet pleasing design. Very chokeable, particularly in the wave sections. Features an immediate ship click at the start.

cards.name: maddening
cards.creator: shmigels
cards.description: geometry dash map that shmigels created using the level editor

cards.name: Ecstasy (SleyGD)
cards.creator: SleyGD
cards.description: Very flashy solo extreme you'll regret opening the editor on due to the sheer amount of triggers. The difficulty features varied gameplay, with a dual lasting from 65 all the way to the end giving it an easy but chokeable ending.

cards.name: gravity
cards.creator: Kaza
cards.description: Official sequel to Moment, arguably improving on the original. Incorporates a green and pink color scheme while retaining a difficulty very similar to its predecessor. Notably was verified in 2021 and rated in late 2025.

cards.name: Bloodbath
cards.creator: Riot
cards.description: One of the most popular extreme demons in the game, and the second level of the Apocalyptic trilogy. This level was known for being the hardest of its time, due to the ship parts being near impossible at the time. Nowadays a pretty tough level, with Michigun's part being arguably the most difficult.

cards.name: Eon
cards.creator: Renn241
cards.description: A 55-minute level that features mostly 6-7 star gameplay over its extremely long runtime, with decoration built using 2.2 effects and triggers to avoid a high object count. It changes themes and energy a lot throughout to represent the song, and increases in difficulty during the final 12%.

cards.name: OUTPUT SPRING
cards.creator: X Future
cards.description: A generally well-received 2.2 Lit Fuse-esque extreme demon themed around the aesthetics of computation, featuring a range of gimmick and clicksync gameplay. The coin requires you to read mock code in order to understand how to obtain it.

cards.name: Idols
cards.creator: Zafkiel7
