cards.description: A megacollaboration by 21 creators serving as a mini-tribute to 1.9, featuring multiple callbacks to older levels. The level is fast-paced with glow-style decoration, and is nearly 4 minutes long.

cards.name: Pale Machine
cards.creator: Blueskii
cards.description: A faithful OMORI-themed megacollab hosted by Blueskii featuring tons of personality and references galore, including hidden cutscenes and a secret epilogue. The player traverses through various environments from the game, meeting friends and foes along the way. Contains spoilers for OMORI.

cards.name: Siniristi
cards.creator: Leksitoo
cards.description: XXL hypercollab made to celebrate Finland's 100th birthday! Named after the Finnish flag (Blue Cross), it shares its blue and white colour scheme and features many cultural references throughout its runtime. Was one of the largest megacollabs in the game when rated.

cards.name: Azure Fiesta
cards.creator: Dorami
cards.description: Prequel to Snowfall Fiesta. The level features a summer-like song with somewhat inconsistent decoration.

cards.name: Motorbreath
cards.creator: TwisterDude161
cards.description: Colorful skill-based extreme using a Metallica song with very high-cps clicksync gameplay. Contains a difficult predrop and an intimidating cube maze at 84%.

cards.name: Doppler (2P)
cards.creator: At424
cards.description: Splitscreen two player level with a distinct red and blue scheme in reference to the Doppler Effect. Created and verified by At424 & Latezk in two weeks! Memorable for its tech theme and satisfying clicksync. Currently the most enjoyed two player level.

cards.name: Blue Suns Zenith
cards.creator: IceboxOG
cards.description: Incredibly creative extreme inspired by Magic The Gathering, using Blue Zenith by xi as its song. Memorable for its difficult sideways wave among other unique gameplay gimmicks. Glory to Phyrexia

cards.name: Crystal Crusher (2P)
cards.creator: Zeniux
cards.description: Simplistic crystal cave themed extreme. Majority of the level features convoluted and long misaligned duals.

cards.name: Down Bass
cards.creator: Spectruh
cards.description: Originally an easier Nine Circles level created in 1.9. Went through a number of different versions and updates throughout 2.0 until it was superbuffed. Seen as rather unpopular due to the buffs made and less-than-desirable appearance. Has some serious chokepoints throughout the wave.

cards.name: PROTOFLICKER
cards.creator: ewop
cards.description: An extreme demon collab with a sparkly & glowy effect style throughout. Has a few memory parts and mostly clicksync gameplay scattered around the second half. Received a nerf-date especially for the first wave section.

cards.name: Grind District
cards.creator: Airz
cards.description: A 1.9 style memory extreme made by Airz while they were working on Skeletal Shenanigans. Features a very difficult second half.

cards.name: Blueprint
cards.creator: Water
cards.description: Another Waterbound solo that now utilizes more gimmicks like the Beach Ball and the Shwave. It includes a randomized Minesweeper pattern at the end that you have to solve in order to hit the right toggle orb at the end. Also has one of the most evil last clicks in any extreme demon in this range.

cards.name: OUCH
cards.creator: AWESOMEME360
cards.description: Fire themed megacollab with a variety of well known creators, using a buffed Shmigels layout. This level also has randomised memory gimmick where a number at 28% tells you how many times to jump at 33%.

cards.name: angel
cards.creator: Insxne97
cards.description: The creator's "magnum opus" taking 2 years to be finished; a chaotic flashy blue-green level featuring, you guessed it, angels. This level has strict, fast and flowy gameplay all throughout its entirety leading up to a slower, more tranquil ending that serves as a chokepoint for some (notably the last ship). This level was started after a relative of the creator passed away, and the overall theme of the level is overcoming the distortions of life, much like the drop, to "reach the clouds", much like the ending.

cards.name: Barbaros Finale
cards.creator: Moffe
cards.description: A pirate themed level with very raw gameplay and a bossfight at the end. Has a generally mixed reception due to the nature of its gameplay along with some transparent objects near the end.

cards.name: Dyad
cards.creator: AWESOMEME360
cards.description: A solo XXL extreme where you race your friend to the moon! Created for the Zeronium creator contest, this level features four contrasting sections, repetitive sync gameplay, and a lot of character and personality.

cards.name: i just wish i could
cards.creator: Snoozzzing
cards.description: Solo intended 2p extreme by Snoozzzing. This level was made as three separate levels, eventually combined into one. The level is about their experience with suicidal ideation and perseverance. The decoration was inspired by sink and 5ta1ker.

cards.name: Prismatic Haze
cards.description: An extremely well known and influential clicksync wave/timing level. Has some very narrow but well synced wave parts, and a slow but very hard ending. Beware of the fish...

cards.name: Sakupen Joy
cards.creator: spark
cards.description: A joyous remake of the famous extreme demon Sakupen Hell with a brighter color palette, a different song, and a boss fight!

cards.name: SLAM
cards.creator: Darwin
cards.description: Timing extreme in Darwin's classic bright design/effect style. Zoink's easiest level

cards.name: Heavens Door
cards.creator: TMco
cards.description: TMco collab themed around the I Wanna Be The Guy needle games. Mostly black and white with small amounts of rainbow coloration and a heaven theme. The gameplay is very learny and increases in intensity throughout the level.

cards.name: A Bizarre Phantasm
cards.creator: TeamN2
cards.description: A classic 2.0 level with challenging, diverse gameplay and icy blue theming. Has an infamous memory part near the end requiring the player to collect 21 keys in a specific order.

cards.name: SUPERCONDUCTOR
cards.creator: At424
cards.description: Extremely high cps solo level by At424. The spider and wave are very high cps, demanding a lot of stamina.

cards.name: Conical Depression
cards.creator: KrmaL
cards.description: Originally made as a joke by KrmaL in 2.0 and rated due to a bet with RobTop over the verification, this level is entirely decorated with 1.0 blocks and is extremely imbalanced. What did you expect?

cards.name: Marathon (weoweoteo)
cards.creator: weoweoteo
cards.description: A four and a half minute long, cube only memory level built to be the ultimate endurance test at the time. Features old style decoration and gameplay, and is notable for its insane nerve buildup potential and some harsh chokepoints. The level has 26 distinct sections, one for each mile of the marathon.

cards.name: Triple Six
cards.description: A truly hell-themed memory extreme with artistic yet gory designs. Consists of a flashy 2nd drop with heavy usage of teleportals, and an orbless mini cube maze with ship and wave sections in between.

cards.name: Distortion
cards.creator: iamfinley
cards.description: Colorful maymory memory map created by finley and friends.

cards.name: EKO
cards.creator: PureDinoMight
cards.description: Faithful Acu spinoff that is almost twice the length of the original. Features many of the same gameplay quirks found in Acu, similar modern deco, and a very hard ending.

cards.name: Stressed Out
cards.creator: meph
cards.description: A Three and a half minute long 1.9 GDPS extreme that pays tribute to many 1.9 levels and Twenty One Pilots. Features lots of tricky duals, UFO sections, and even a nine circles part.

cards.name: Wayback Array
cards.creator: royen
cards.description: Fast, upbeat and fun megacollab started 'way back' in 2019. Took 4 years to complete and another 2 years to get rated.

cards.name: One5Seven
cards.creator: Sdslayer
cards.description: Fully solo made level by List Helper and YouTuber Sdslayer that changes decoration style every couple parts. Gameplay is mostly carried by click-sync but has a few notable chokepoints scattered throughout.

cards.name: SL8O
cards.creator: mbedsun
cards.description: 8o remake uploaded to SleyGD's alt account, most well known as being the only disliked extreme on the servers

cards.name: Cluttered Confusion
cards.creator: Enfur
cards.description: Sequel to "Miscellaneous Memory" by the same creator, being much more polished and well-decorated. The gameplay is incredibly learny yet consistent with a pretty hard last dual. Refer to the creator's tutorial video for easier learning.

cards.name: Tron
cards.creator: Funnygame
cards.description: The first Extreme Demon made by the legendary creator FunnyGame, themed around the sci-fi series of the same name. The gameplay is often considered to be of poor quality, and the level contains a long cutscene at the beginning.

cards.name: Frozen
cards.creator: RatQuesadilla
cards.description: A very chill and icy themed extreme demon that contains disorienting effects at 69% which can make a bit difficult to read. The gameplay is full based on weird timings, such as orbs with slopes at start, a ton of double clicks at the drop and dash orbs pauses mid air.

cards.name: Callisto
cards.creator: l4tezk
cards.description: 1.9 style extreme memorable for its incredibly satisfying and well-received gameplay. One of the four levels by Latezk named after Jupiter's four largest moons.

cards.name: burn to dust
cards.creator: crazyllama
cards.description: Chaotic design styled learny level with unconventional and super fast paced gameplay. Features very unorthodox structuring and an endscreen where you avoid the text.

cards.name: shattered lens
cards.creator: XDjoa
cards.description: A collab between XDjoa and SoggyDash for the Zeronium CC2! Features stinking greyscale effects and fast paced, dual heavy gameplay throughout.

cards.name: GO bird
cards.creator: AWESOMEME360
cards.description: A long invisible level that follows a group of birds through a forest as the days pass by. The gameplay consist of mostly clicksync timings with some high cps parts present at the drops. Features visual indicators such as trigger orbs to guide the player in some parts.

cards.name: Disentombed
cards.creator: YakobNugget
cards.description: Sequel to YakobNugget's previous megacollab Unearthed, containing similarly glowy decoration themed around exploring an underground tomb. Recieved a balance update 2 years after release, and is generally decently aged and well-received.

cards.name: Scattered n Lost
cards.creator: TheBlackHell
cards.description: Chaotic rainbow memory extreme using enter & exit effects to the fullest. Contains an intimidating cube maze at 70% with distracting visuals and effects throughout the level.

cards.name: CLOWNS
cards.creator: Nehemia / Avanna
cards.description: Bright and colourful circus themed solo extreme that took 2 years to get rated.

cards.name: Techno Disco
cards.creator: M4th3oGames
cards.description: Sequel of Techno Flashes that uses the same song. Upgrades the its predecessors decoration by incorporating more complex neon designs and by increasing the energy. The second half features a rainbow color palette and the Flashback Zone™ incase you forgot its a sequel to Techno Flashes.

cards.name: Fever Dream (ElirpscalionPC)
cards.creator: Elirpscalion
cards.description: Unique design extreme created and verified solo, gradually becoming messier and more dreamlike. Contains high-cps gameplay and difficult straight fly sections.

cards.name: same old
cards.creator: Eveteer
cards.description: Simple & effective design extreme with a distinct RGBY color scheme. Has many repetitive memory sections that pair well with the song, and also has a highly chaotic QuazeryIceCube style maze at the end with hundreds of possible routes.

cards.name: Karma
cards.creator: Artu
cards.description: XL Effect layout made by Artu and Marwec. Stays high energy with its intense song and atmosphere paired with its hard dual sections and flow gameplay. Relatively learny and has some chokepoints dotted around the level. (Song ID for Mobile Users that cant use the NONG on the main copy: 127940696)

cards.name: Koantaoh
cards.creator: Szilu
cards.description: Szilu solo extreme with very unusual gameplay, consisting of mostly UFO and swing. The UFOs are defined by their long portal worm consistency tests and fast paced click patterns; and the swings test your control of the gamemode with randomised gravity portals. The final UFO gap is also in a random position.

cards.name: Karasu
cards.creator: Zalgaryth
cards.description: A collection of rejected Yatagarasu parts that took 6 years to get rated. It is the second level to feature Terron's bird. The level heavily relies on chokepoints and nerves.

cards.name: INNARDS
cards.creator: Kaito
cards.description: Grayscale with red level, with a lot of blood details. This was initially a nearly-impossible top 1, before being extremely nerfed. While everything's mostly balanced, the wave sections can be quite the difficulty spikes.

cards.name: Antonymph
cards.creator: Pncsr
cards.description: An upbeat and colourful extreme set to ANTONYMPH by VyletPony

cards.name: 6LACKLIGHT
cards.creator: mby
cards.description: *Epilepsy Warning*

cards.name: WaveBreaker
cards.creator: Lemons
cards.description: Old collab level with a lot of familiar faces such as Dorami, Danzmen, and our most popular, Chlorines. Overall its a pretty fun, fast paced level, with a hard predrop.

cards.name: ETERNAL
cards.creator: ivyteal
cards.description: Solo layout-styled flow level by with a deep blue and black color scheme. Contains difficult duals and timings, and keeps a constant fast pace throughout. Is generally well received.

cards.name: Treatment Facility
cards.creator: MMANH
cards.description: 1.9 styled design level inspired by Toxic Sewers, themed around escaping an underground wastewater facility. Includes lots of subtle effects and movements to build immersion. References the infamous Rupture wave at 40%.

cards.name: Lovers Sadness
cards.creator: Insidee
cards.description: Minimalist solo extreme telling an abstract story about grief. Features creative dual-based gameplay, representing two separate individuals. Garnered controversy for being rated despite its simplicity, though it is extremely well received among victors.

cards.name: super kontik
cards.creator: varikoz
cards.description: Russian duo level featuring a flashy rainbow color scheme and fast-paced clicksync gameplay. Memorably contains a randomized robot section where you have to collect Super Kontik cookies. "best sandwich cookie you have probably ever seen in your life."

cards.name: Empyrean
cards.creator: kivvvi
cards.description: Kivvvi's magnum opus; a well-enjoyed solo extreme 7 months in the making featuring highly detailed designs and artwork with fast-paced clicksync-based flow gameplay. Much of the level's difficulty comes from the first section of the drop, especially in the short wave segments, creating a bit of a stress test for the latter half of the level.

cards.name: Penultimate Phase
cards.creator: nwolc
cards.description: Quirky 2.1 level that doesn’t actually bear any resemblance to The Ultimate Phase other than using a later part of the same song. Contains a fair share of unique dual parts and a long Going Up cutscene at 32%.

cards.name: GrizzlyWare
cards.creator: TwisterDude161
cards.description: Code themed solo extreme with a predominantly green and red colour scheme, inspired by Toxic Sewers, Rupture, and Controlled Chaos. The drop is mostly comprised of mirrored gameplay.

cards.name: FTW
cards.creator: Blaster
cards.description: A 2.0 styled extreme demon with distinct wave sections, tricky ship parts, and diverse click patterns that resembles old styled gameplay, along with appealing yet somewhat simplistic decoration elements.

cards.name: BEELINE (2P)
cards.creator: galaxxyss
cards.description: Very vibrant splitscreen 2 player level with the parts being references to various games. Includes some tricky and fast-paced gameplay, with the beginning being the hardest one.

cards.name: Zenith (Lan IIVX)
cards.creator: Lan IIVX
cards.description: Solo XXL extreme with a variety of styles, themed around finding forgiveness for mistakes.

cards.name: All In
cards.creator: l4tezk
cards.description: Flowy clicksync extreme themed around gambling, featuring a consistent red and black color scheme with many references to cards and casinos.

cards.name: PISTON
cards.creator: danielsbadkarma
cards.description: Solo extreme inspired by the piston from Minecraft! The pistons move the blocks in the level around, making for some interesting moving object heavy gameplay.

cards.name: laranja azul rosa
cards.creator: shmigels
cards.description: Translating to “Orange Blue Pink,” this level uses a strict 3-color palette. The gameplay is unorthodox, with learny duals and memory-based gimmicks. The community seems determined to keep the level at exactly 0 likes on the servers for reasons unknown.

cards.name: plunq
cards.creator: Criko
cards.description: Heavily Sink by Awedsy inspired level that uses a Project Sekai song. Formerly one of the worst received levels on the entirety of the EDEL, until it received a heavy nerfdate that improved the reception of the level by a lot.

cards.name: gardening map
cards.creator: kalculus19
cards.description: Silly 2.1 memory collab with unorthodox gameplay and structuring and tons of tiny jokes and references. Beware the creature at 21%.

cards.name: wires
cards.creator: korviid
cards.description: Atmospheric & monochromatic robot-only extreme with a gloomy song by The Neighborhood. Takes subtle inspiration from Zylenox, featuring a fast-paced climax.

cards.name: Sigma Interface
cards.creator: Platnuu
cards.description: The second level in Platnuu's Interface trilogy. Has a very chill atmosphere and gameplay that is mostly timings, wave, and ship. Was supposed to have an extension but was released early.

cards.name: aftermath
cards.creator: Exenity
cards.description: The third and final level of the Apocalyptic trilogy, featuring very similar gameplay to Cataclysm, but harder.

cards.name: I Wanted To Sleep
cards.creator: Hidden
cards.description: A pure solo extreme heavily inspired by Eon clocking in at 20 minutes long. Many concepts from Eon are present here, and it takes advantage of its shorter length to experiment more with structures, designs and song representation without inflating its object count. Its gameplay is notable for 3 distinct fast-paced segments starting at 17.2%, 45.8% and 79%, separated by slower, easier gameplay.

cards.name: We Are Not The Same (2P)
cards.creator: mbed
cards.description: 2-player duo collab where player 2's part is extreme and player 1's is significantly easier to the point of non-demon gameplay, hence the name. Consists of themeless and pretty low-key visuals, including a review about the mario movie at end. I don't think we're alike at all Mr. White...

cards.name: love0
cards.creator: AWESOMEME360
cards.description: Unconventional breakup themed design level with unorthodox orb combinations and psychedelic visuals. Unfortunately the platformer checkpoint at 88% does not let you respawn...

cards.name: Perfect in Place
cards.creator: Jemma
cards.description: Solo intended 2p level, created for someseal's solo 2p creator contest. The gameplay is high cps, frequently switching between 2p and 1p sections. It's grayscale and effect heavy decoration is based off of both an older unrated level by Jemma, and the Undertale "Disbelief" animation.

cards.name: Cat Planet
cards.creator: icedcave
cards.description: A joke cat themed remake of both Aquamarine and Planet Circles. Features a long and easy predrop followed by an extremely hard wave. Has an SC66P inspired part and the PG Clubstep cat.

cards.name: Godspeed
cards.creator: Rynoxious
cards.description: A fast paced megacollab co-hosted by MrFreckles and Rynoxious that has been in development since 2021!

cards.name: PanaSonic
cards.creator: TheShadowRealm
cards.description: Early 2.1 megacollab with a lot of varying decoration styles and incredibly poorly received gameplay. Became the first Extreme Demon moved to TheShadowRealm after the host/verifier was exposed for incredibly inappropriate acts.

cards.name: F3XMAXXING
cards.creator: Slick
cards.description: A fast-paced, flashy, timing-oriented level which utilizes black, white and red checker designs inspired by the skin "Devesto" from the Roblox game Die of Death. It is also the first rated solo extreme made by a Lithuanian.

cards.name: Rift
cards.creator: HazelSZL
cards.description: 1.6 Extreme demon megacollab that features vibrant colours, several tricky ship sections and a difficult predrop. The gameplay still manages to feel modern and polished despite its limitations. Generally considered to be the most well received 1.6 extreme.

cards.name: Niflheim
cards.creator: Vismuth
cards.description: An old 2.0 pseudo-memory level featuring unique designs and moving objects, very hard ball timings, and lots of text portals. LDM ball cube ball big cube ball next...

cards.name: SINK (OwOPink)
cards.creator: Pink
cards.description: A solo extreme demon created by OwOPink. Features an underwater theme which incorporates glow style decoration and some experimental gimmicky gameplay inspired by RUST and Gaggatrondra. Harbours a total of 169 fish throughout the level including 5 in the endscreen representing the first 5 victors of the level. Don't drown.

cards.name: KINGSLAYER
cards.creator: MothEye
cards.description: We are experiencing technical difficulties displaying this level's video, due to Sony Music Entertainment blocking it. Please replace or mute the song in your record if you plan on beating this level, as we can't look at your record if we can't see the video.

cards.name: Maybe Possibly Thing
cards.creator: iNubble
cards.description: Memory level known for being goofy and having a funny bossfight. Is skewed towards mainly ship gameplay.

cards.name: Manic Machine
cards.creator: TwisterDude161
cards.description: Generally well-received timing and memory-based extreme demon with a green and red corrupted technological decoration that was made in 2.1. It was inspired by the 1.9 insane demon Chaotic Machine and is similar to Killbot although it contains less flashes. Has a very difficult ending.

cards.name: FURY TECH
cards.creator: PikachuFan
cards.description: FRANK

cards.name: Momentary Affection
cards.creator: TheBlackHell
cards.description: The sequel to Lost Love that will really test your ability to memorize a path and ability to learn duals.

cards.name: Fingerdash v3
cards.creator: Noriega
cards.description: A super-buffed remake of the main level "Fingerdash," including learny dual parts, multiple trigger orb timings, gimmicky parts with moving and on and off obstacles and a final bossfight part. Even though it contains this variety of parts, the spider is the main gamemode in the level, appearing in most of the duals. It also sticks relatively well to the original style of Fingerdash.

cards.name: Libertas
cards.creator: WOOGI1411
cards.description: Energetic Korean collab with decoration combining design elements of 1.9, 2.0, and early 2.1. It received a significant nerfdate awhile after its release but still maintained its quirky fast-paced gameplay. Spent 2.5 years in development hell, beginning in ~2017.

cards.name: Audio Extraction
cards.creator: GoodSmile
cards.description: Originally created in 2.0 and got a bugfix and decoration update in 2.1. It had one of the earliest uses of the dual wave gimmick where both waves share the same gravity.

cards.name: BROWNOIX
cards.creator: ArtaxFerSarh
cards.description: Well-received dual-based megacollab featuring a consistent green and yellow palette and great gameplay. Memorable for its flashy effects and learny duals

cards.name: Huellas En La Nieve
cards.creator: notlsa
cards.description: A peaceful but extremely hard to learn memory level. Features a part where you must break every block in order to progress which does not work in practice mode. Also features a terrifying vertical memory wave at the end.

cards.name: Redemption Arc
cards.creator: Wulzy
cards.description: Wulzy’s first created extreme taking a twenty-seven video long playlist and 678 days from start to finish. Features several parts with different effects and skillsets. Overall very well received.

cards.name: devins thorn zone
cards.creator: ItzJitterbug325
cards.description: Art styled extreme demon made by a controversial creator where it's balacing it's also very weird. Contains a really easy first half until you get to to the spider at 48%, which has some very inconsistent high CPS gameplay due to the part being very awkward and the spider gamemode sticking to the walls unintentionally. It ends with some confusing and learny duals, as well as an easy last cube part.

cards.name: No Ember
cards.creator: arplight
cards.description: A collage style fast paced level that switches style with each part. The difficulty is ending carried, and the level features many bursts of high cps gameplay.

cards.name: BRAINROT
cards.creator: InfernuZ
cards.description: Design style memory level using control: mind, and is somewhat reminiscent of Sleepless by ChaSe gameplay wise. Features some split path gameplay and a cube maze around the halfway point. Sadly has nothing to do with actual brainrot so do not expect to find Triple T or 67 kid.

cards.name: Synergy
cards.creator: Vlacc
cards.description: XL design megacollab between several well established creators. Has several fakes/learny parts and chokepoints scattered about, most notably a ridiculously high-cps spider part at 29%. Decoration varies in quality due to it being made over the course of 4 years.

cards.name: SorryForPartyRocking
cards.creator: AWESOMEME360
cards.description: A rainbow themed extreme demon that uses a cornandbeans and Sorry For Party Rocking mashup. Features plenty of fast paced gameplay broken up with slower memory & timing parts.

cards.name: Halberd
cards.creator: notlsa
cards.description: Visually amazing level with the art style of Kirby Super Star. It has a giant maze with multiple routes, a few chokepoints and a very difficult part at 33% where you need to click in-sync to the music.

cards.name: Warios Gold MinE
cards.creator: stanstanmansan
cards.description: Themed off of the Mario Kart Wii track by the same name, this gold mine themed level has many references to its source material, and is also generally very well received.

cards.name: Glide
cards.creator: crohn44
cards.description: A unique extreme demon featuring many double-clicks. The gameplay is learny and somewhat inconsistent but satisfying, reflected by its mixed reception. Most of the difficulty is condensed into the cubes at the beginning and 71%, which include fixed hitboxes.

cards.name: SLAY MOMENT
cards.creator: ItsMeGeoGD
cards.description: ItsMeGeoGD's latest modern extreme! Features sync gameplay and some very fabulous wave gaps.

cards.name: Heartbeat (KrmaL)
cards.creator: KrmaL
cards.description: An iconic 2.0 extreme featuring blood-red theming and unconventional gameplay, with infamous sections such as the 47% wave spam and the ending cube.

cards.name: Dumbest Girl Alive
cards.creator: Renn241
cards.description: Radical and techno themed level that is widely known for its NONG, that has the same title as the level. It features a brief memory part near the beginning, a tight wave section with lots of size changes, also considered to be the hardest part, and finishes off with a cube section with various chokepoints.

cards.name: Endurance
cards.creator: Bizaare
cards.description: A faithful remake of Marathon, rebalanced to remove chokepoints and emphasize nerve buildup and consistency. The decoration gets gradually more complex as the level progresses

cards.name: Weald
cards.creator: Cypherr
cards.description: Peaceful woodland themed solo extreme featuring slow paced gameplay and an asymmetrical dual.

cards.name: me when machine gang (2P)
cards.creator: akunakun
cards.description: A 2-player memory level by akunakun that was made in one sitting, with mostly path-based memory other than the splitscreen dual.

cards.name: Just A Bunch Of Idea
cards.creator: ovexra
cards.description: Short extreme consisting of various different "ideas" in terms of decoration ranging from a ship including album covers to a flower-themed robot, and a handful of camera effects are also present. It also contains a very difficult last wave.

cards.name: Avalanche (Filqh)
cards.creator: fil
cards.description: BLBL inspired extreme demon originally made 4 years ago, now fully updated and reverified by DaMeister.

cards.name: Warning
cards.creator: TwisterDude161
cards.description: Skill-based clicksync design solo utilizing lots of cool complementary colors and satisfying fast-paced timings. Leans towards being ship/wave carried, but it has some difficult cube timings as well. Unfortunately had to be reverified after the previous verifier was exposed.

cards.name: Sides Of My Mind (2P)
cards.creator: MaxxoRMeN
cards.description: A 2-player level that splits apart and then recombines together in the end. Visuals contain a lot of contrasting effects and feature rainbow and monochrome palette.

cards.name: Out of Chaos
cards.creator: Arraegen
cards.description: An extreme that's alike to Nhelv, even down to the song. The theming is of a struggle with mental health which is represented through its well-created, surreal effects in the decoration and its predominently black, white and red coloring which becomes very colorful nearing the end. Also features well-received, unorthodox gameplay with several dual sections, especially 83% - 86% due to the horizontally uneven ship gameplay.

cards.name: VIRTUE
cards.creator: VARSE
cards.description: VARSE's first public level renowned for it's atmospheric decoration and for the style switch at 44%. Contains a very creative wave part at 80%, with somewhat learny clicksync gameplay throughout.

cards.name: Myocardia
cards.creator: Toughfey
cards.description: A modern extreme themed around biomechanics and the circulatory system. It features artwork in both the background and the foreground, fusing the two themes. Mainly features D-block wave gameplay and vertical dash orbs throughout the level, and explores unconventional gameplay ideas for its runtime with the intention of encapsulating the energy of the song.

cards.name: The Ultimate Return
cards.creator: vit12
cards.description: Sequel to vit12's level ''The Ultimate Demon''. The decoration and gameplay take inspiration from several popular extreme demons, similar to The Ultimate Demon. It's also not very well recieved, due to containing some awkward and blind transitions, as well as very inconsistent gameplay. As the result of containing a lot of wave demons, this gamemode is the most used.

cards.name: Wacky McWhackface v2
cards.creator: Szilu
cards.description: Buffed Acu remake featuring a very similar click pattern and glow deco. Has an AI generated name.

cards.name: Ergonomic Chair
cards.creator: さきら 🌸
cards.description: A chair designed for efficiency and comfort. (Purple and yellow extreme mainly featuring ship and wave gameplay, but also features a swing dual and a multi-creator triple trial at the end.)

cards.name: Destinies
cards.creator: NinSam
cards.description: A very long solo art level inspired by many other XL art levels such as Emerald Realm and Well Rested. The gameplay gets progressively faster paced and intense towards the end, and it features a lot of spider/spider orb gameplay. One of the most enjoyed extremes.

cards.name: HyperHyperHyperHyper
cards.creator: Twandash
cards.description: Twan's first solo!!!

cards.name: Tenkai (2P)
cards.creator: HidekiX
cards.description: Hideki's two player level that went unrated for years; features solo gameplay for the first 40%, and a dual for the rest of the level.

cards.name: Spacious Senses
cards.creator: QuazeryIceCube
cards.description: Memory extreme with QuazeryIceCube's signature freeform gameplay with many possible routes, and simple but effective decoration. The first half contains most of the difficulty, and a handful of timing chokepoints.

cards.name: Welcome To GD News
cards.creator: vortrox
cards.description: An easy extreme demon megacollab hosted by Vortrox to celebrate the success of his “GD news” video series on Youtube. It contains unique well-rounded flow gameplay.

cards.name: 1330X
cards.creator: ewop
cards.description: A fast-paced extreme collab filled with brutal gameplay complemented with glow-style decoration. Notoriously has a very chokable last wave and ship.

cards.name: Hopping Over Puddles
cards.creator: J27Blaze
cards.description: Ruins themed level with calm deco and gameplay, mainly based in slow timings of cube and robot, it has surprisingly hard parts for its placement due to the duration of the level.

cards.name: Pumped Up Kicks
cards.creator: Quiken
cards.description: An early 2.1 XXL megacollab hosted by Quiken, infamous for having unbalanced gameplay and the 47% orange orb timing.

cards.name: recollection
cards.creator: AliceVee
cards.description: High energy memory megacollab verified by LordVadercraft with flashy effects and dense, rainbow filled decoration. Has a notoriously difficult last click.

cards.name: Recrystallize
cards.creator: GrenadeofTacos
cards.description: A four minute long 1.9GDPS megacollab featuring parts made by GrenadeofTacos' family members. Has mostly fast paced, learny and well rounded gameplay. Also has a Toyota

cards.name: Sleepwalking
cards.creator: Water
cards.description: Waterbound's second extreme demon, this time created in a minimal but atmospheric design in 24 hours. Uses only the cube gamemode once again.

cards.name: CRUEL
cards.creator: Denni
cards.description: Dark red castle themed Cherryteam collab, verified and published by Denni

cards.name: Thoughtless Space
cards.creator: KZLR
cards.description: Remake of Thinking Space II, rated as a low end extreme demon. It was created as a solo level by KZLR at the request of his friend Neeple, who wanted to verify an extreme demon level. Features fast paced cube and ship gameplay with an infamously difficult last jump.

cards.name: A2Marbl
cards.creator: Golden
cards.description: An easier but similarly fast paced clicksync sequel to ATMarbl. Features a hard last spider and Temp's insane wave part.

cards.name: 4Elements
cards.creator: royen
cards.description: A faithful remake of Eiken's famous 1.9 insane demon The Four Elements. Took over a year to create, and each part features detailed and well themed decoration using 1.9 limitations. The gameplay is similar to the original but much harder.

cards.name: Yeo Baek
cards.creator: aiden1204
cards.description: Modern solo extreme with a long and complex asymmetrical dual in the second half.

cards.name: Pound Town
cards.creator: Platnuu
cards.description: A 2.0 collab level that placed second in Sea1997's extreme demon creator contest, above other submissions like Erebus and Delta Interface. Was rebalanced and verified by Platnuu in 2018, but remained unrated for an additional five years.

cards.name: Hades
cards.creator: XZ
cards.description: BOIII WHAT U SAY ABOUT PHONK??

cards.name: RIVERS OF NAZARETH
cards.creator: AudieoVisual
cards.description: AudieoVisual's first created extreme demon, featuring a recognizable art-effect style with plenty of duals, ship & clicksync gameplay. Themed around the Nazar and cultures surrounding it whilst also having a unique quirk of having the player in the center of the screen at all times.

cards.name: Zen Blast
cards.creator: TwisterDude161
cards.description: Extremely colourful and upbeat XL megacollab made by a friend group. Features learny 2.2 feature heavy gameplay, with some unorthodox flow at the drop. The decoration and gameplay are highly varied between parts, creating a very diverse playing experience. "Imagine a place where people of all walks of life can come together and bro down."

cards.name: loop
cards.creator: Darmuth
cards.description: A slow-paced, progression-oriented solo memory extreme, with the gameplay being based on the same repeating structure cycling through the different orb types with each iteration and the path forward being almost invisible, taking many unexpected twists and turns. The visuals and structuring get more complex as the level progresses, though it stays simple with its limited use of gamemodes and being entirely slow-speed.

cards.name: Canneles au chocolat
cards.creator: AlaskaFX
cards.description: A modern mashup style level with 2.2 camera effects featuring a French dessert. The gameplay is mainly made up of click sync based timings with notably hard wave chokepoints.

cards.name: ONVIL FACTORY
cards.creator: cordeaux
cards.description: A solo extreme by Cordeaux dedicated to fellow creator Onvil for their birthday!

cards.name: PAINFUL PLAYLAND
cards.creator: TwisterDude161
cards.description: Old impossible level inspired extreme featuring difficult, learny gameplay restricted to update 1.2. Received a significant nerfdate moving it down 300 spots in mid-2024. Contains lighthearted rainbow decoration while using the entirety of Dry Out.

cards.name: Four (shoe42)
cards.creator: shoe
cards.description: Colorful clicksync extreme themed around the symbol "four" in Japanese, having a similar pronunciation as the symbol "death." Known for having hard wave sections and fast-paced timings.

cards.name: nowdead
cards.creator: meowdead
cards.description: A 1.9 GDPS solo extreme heavily comprised of learny sync gameplay and some quite difficult wave timings. There is a notable skip that can be performed at 76%. Also known for being one of the hardest levels to place on the IDL when it was a misrated insane demon, though it never made it to the top 1 spot due to Time Pulse also being insane demon at the time.

cards.name: I NEVER DREAM
cards.creator: skywalker14
cards.description: Level with a very unique and (ironically) dreamy style, sharing its name with the used song by Against All Logic. Features gameplay mainly focused on cube timings and ship.

cards.name: story 2
cards.creator: lazer
cards.description: Solo extreme by lazer that repeats sections of a small amount of gameplay, unlocking more sections when the time signature in the song changes. Difficulty spikes at the 60% wave.

cards.name: RTX ON
cards.creator: TypicalGMD
cards.description: Pretty level which is extremely front loaded, with the predrop carrying a good portion of the difficulty. Focuses on timings.

cards.name: Northern Essence
cards.creator: YouknowwhoGD
cards.description: 1.9 Christmas-themed megacollab hosted by Youknowwho.

cards.name: TUAPEKA
cards.creator: feijoaoa
cards.description: Short and atmospheric extreme named after a river in New Zealand, and has a unusual tech-savanna-with-black-hole theme. The gameplay is mostly ship and wave focused. Hawk

cards.name: gloss
cards.creator: shmigels
cards.description: Fast-paced design solo finished in 2019 that immediately throws you into the first drop. Contains pretty bizarre high-cps gameplay and very learny duals paired with vibrant 1.9-esque designs and a generally unserious feel. It was actually the first finished shmigels extreme, but was deleted a month after release and reuploaded 2 years later.

cards.name: Paranoid
cards.creator: Deppied
cards.description: Flowy & clean design collab using a not-so-garbage rock song by the band Garbage. Memorable for its dynamic effects and movements paired with engaging and well-received gameplay. Also features fantastic color work! Verified by Zeronium.

cards.name: Brave
cards.creator: Bronwyn
cards.description: Megacollab remake of Paladin by Asonicmen, and references Dragon Quest. Has faithful mid 2.1 design style decoration, and well rounded gameplay.

cards.name: Fair Morning
cards.creator: Shrympo
cards.description: Graphic design style collab and sequel to Unfair Evening. Notable for being extremely short at only 35 seconds long, and features a tough randomised angled wave spam at the end.

cards.name: Retention
cards.creator: WOOGI1411
cards.description: One of the first dual heavy extreme demons to exist. Overall pretty fun and very learny, especially the cube at 65%.

cards.name: Fexty
cards.creator: SkyJax
cards.description: Former hack verified top 1 by Ozpectro, later reverified legitimately by SkyJax after being unrated. Overall plays like a high end insane demon except for the iconic, extremely hard wave around 50%. Also has a gimmicky dual ship which some find awkward, and a handful of bugs to avoid. We love Fexty!

cards.name: SUBVERSIVE
cards.creator: Snowr33de
cards.description: The first Russian extreme demon megacollab. It doesn't have a consistent theme in either gameplay or decoration, aside from the general 2.0 aesthetic.

cards.name: Marlboro reds
cards.creator: xSlendy
cards.description: Highly skill based extreme with fast paced flow gameplay with an emphasis on wave. Smoking kills.

cards.name: Gentlemens Clique (2P)
cards.creator: Alph
cards.description: A 2-player level, a part of the gang trilogy. The level's name is meant to be a British version of Based Gang. Has a key you can collect to turn the bossfight icons into the Bass Cave demon.

cards.name: Violently X
cards.creator: Dorami
cards.description: An early 2.1 extreme demon that is infamous for its notorious balancing. Features outdated early 2.1 deco, a really easy beginning, a fast-paced drop with chokepoints scattered around, a short memory part, a bossfight section near the end and wacky and jank gameplay in general.

cards.name: Steel Terrors
cards.creator: DreamZoneGD
cards.description: Mechanical solo extreme highlighting DreamZone's classic dense and industrial design style. Features constant effects and movements, creating an incredibly dynamic atmosphere with fast-paced gameplay and well-received dual sections.

cards.name: Quadratic Function
cards.creator: TwisterDude161
cards.description: Remake of Quadraric Function by Megadere, an old impossible level that was made in 2014. Features portal-dominated ship gameplay, hard cube timings, a graffiti-wall UFO spam, and an infamous blue orb spam at the very end of the level.

cards.name: The Man With No Eyes
cards.creator: Plushiest
cards.description: Solo extreme inspired by World of Goo with a few Super Mario Maker references thrown in. Features a stylised art-design decoration with fairly chokepoint heavy gameplay, including a very difficult dual section in the middle of the level.

cards.name: In Circles
cards.creator: SomieStuff
cards.description: Nine Circles level which is inspired by Falling up and Black Blizzard. Legend has it, a mod played this level for 6% in practice mode, watched the showcase and didn’t send it because of the gameplay.

cards.name: squelch
cards.creator: whlt
cards.description: markus

cards.name: EXTREME MEMORY MIX
cards.creator: At424
cards.description: You wouldn't believe it, but this level's an extreme memory mix. Interestingly, it remixes beginner to main list memory extremes while maintaining engaging and well-received gameplay & balancing. Notably chooses nicher memory extremes than other levels to "be cooler," such as Santa Fe, GO bird and Hollow.

cards.name: Haircut
cards.creator: Metalface221
cards.description: Collab hosted by Metalface221. Very unique sync-based level with bright effect decoration and one of the longest straight-flies of any rated extreme demon.

cards.name: Semicolon 3
cards.creator: X Future
cards.description: ;3 Remake of XFuture's first level Colon 3. The decoration is themed around lights and glass, and features many dimly lit atmospheric sections with colourful lighting. The gameplay is dual based with near constant duals at the drop, and also has a hard slow wave in the predrop. ;3

cards.name: M A N I X
cards.creator: KrmaL
cards.description: A level built by Manix648 for KrmaL in response to an offhand joke made by RobTop, featuring completely invisible gameplay. In comparison to the visible version that came later, some aspects of the gameplay are much more difficult and unpredictable.

cards.name: Gaming 35
cards.creator: Zoink Doink
cards.description: A Zoink Doink collab that was in the works for more than 3 years, featuring extremely learny clicksync gameplay, with the first half being especially difficult.

cards.name: KUB
cards.creator: WaRiox
cards.description: A minimalistic style level that is reflected both in the deco and the fact the level only uses the cube gamemode. Features a long intro cutscene and some punishing custom hitboxes.

cards.name: headlock
cards.creator: pocke
cards.description: Solo-intended 2p level created and verified by Pocke. Uses a lot of gimmicks where the second player input does things like changing the player's size or the colour of an orb. Generally a good start for getting into solo 2p.

cards.name: The Ultimate Phase
cards.creator: Andromeda
cards.description: A 1.9 megacollab hosted by Andromeda, containing many different iconic creators like Cyclic and ViPriN. Originally hack-verified, it would be one of the few extreme demons created and verified in 1.9. Generally poorly received due to the inconsistent duals, awkward spam and poor balancing.

cards.name: BYE
cards.creator: AlrexX
cards.description: A remake of Hi by KrmaL. The level was poorly received, and the creator asked for it to be deleted off the servers but was denied by moderators. As it's a buffed version of the original, the gameplay is gimmicky, chokepoint heavy, and has a very hard second half.

cards.name: MAKE ME SAD
cards.creator: santiachu
cards.description: Solo extreme with light gradient decoration reminiscent of Rust. Has mainly timing based gameplay, and a ship at the end with a lot of orbs.

cards.name: Broken Signal
cards.description: High quality level themed around a computer breaking down. Features mainly sync based gameplay, some hard waves, and a mirrored section at the end.

cards.name: Volume
cards.creator: Metalface221
cards.description: Easy extreme demon most notable for the extremely hard wave in the mid points. The rest of the level is considerably easier except for a few hard ship gaps.

cards.name: reverence
cards.creator: Woom
cards.description: Influential red flow megacollab, inspiring many other levels and essentially acting as a blueprint for modern flow gameplay. Features quintessential flow gameplay: learny, fast paced, high cps, clicksync based gameplay with frequent gamemode switches and some tough short waves.

cards.name: On1y Cub3
cards.creator: DrCuber
cards.description: Solo level by DrCuber. As the name implies, this level is purely cube gameplay with various timing gimmicks. Has a notoriously hard first part, and two parts with an orb that follows the player.

cards.name: your brain on brain
cards.creator: sillymn
cards.description: Solo extreme with heavy rainbow decoration and a generally silly and playful theme. Features mostly timing based gameplay, with an emphasis on cube and robot. Was somehow insane demon for a week, causing it to place on the Insane Demon List as one of the hardest top 1s in its history. It was then promoted to extreme an hour later :trollface:

cards.name: PARANOIA (AAAAAlex)
cards.creator: AAAAAlex
cards.description: Originally an unfinished level named Tazz by Shocksidian, finished up and published by AAAAAlex

cards.name: Tech Manifestation
cards.creator: Pleoslim
cards.description: Has an overall horrible reputation, due to the beginning, and the infamous last third, having the 90% click of all time.

cards.name: Interstellar Entropy
cards.creator: LastPrismAlex
cards.description: Spanish megacollab hosted by Youtuber & streamer LastPrismAlex. Notably received an update almost 4 years later, halving the objects and generally improving the decoration while adding 2.2 effects. Features a consistent rainbow color scheme and designs still reminiscent of the original version verified in 2021.

cards.name: Our Fountain
cards.creator: LP44
cards.description: A slow and very atmospheric XL extreme using an equally atmospheric song to match. Features detailed block designs and some memory sections. Gets generally harder as the level progresses, ending with a short, slow, but very narrow nine circles style wave.

cards.name: STARBREAKER
cards.creator: ClingingBog
cards.description: The prequel to STARCRASH with gameplay made by SoggyCat and decorated by ClingingBog. Set in an abandoned city, where a star creation experiment is left unmaintained. The player must reach the top of the factory to stop this experiment, or the star will collapse. Notable for its high-CPS clicksync dual gameplay throughout the drop.

cards.name: Bored Walk
cards.creator: DracoZeon
cards.description: Very chill and slow paced timing extreme divided into 7 parts with a very simple decoration and use of every gamemode in order except for the swing copter. Every part has decently gimmicky timings with a couple chokepoint clicks scattered around, and the first cube being generally considered to be the hardest part. It also took a few years to get rated.

cards.name: ROW
cards.creator: ewop
cards.description: An intense, fast-paced level by ewop which has a lot of clicksync gameplay. Features a triple spike at the end which serves as a nerve control check.

cards.name: PLUS ULTRA
cards.creator: ILRELL
cards.description: Flamboyant My Hero Academia themed megacollab finished in 2019 hosted by ILRELL mixing art, modern, and design, in which every part is based off a quirk of a student. Memorable for its somewhat charming lack of cohesion and impressive roster of iconic early 2.1 creators. Gameplay is surprisingly high-quality and intuitive for its age.

cards.name: Last Station
cards.creator: PikaSempai
cards.description: A long and dark clicksync-based level, themed after trains in both it's deco and song. The gameplay is learny and heavy on timings, with some hard cube and ship gameplay.

cards.name: SHURIMA
cards.creator: stcubing
cards.description: A solo extreme that took 1 year to make. Has distinct parts in its art decoration and its timing-based gameplay leading up to the player's ascension at the end.

cards.name: four (Turtl123)
cards.creator: Turtl123
cards.description: Short and fairly learny level that was placed at #3 on IDL when it got rated. Features a fast paced rainbow first half and a monochrome ending with some tricky timings.

cards.name: Red World Rebirth
cards.creator: Riot
cards.description: Harder version of Red World, with most its difficulty being ship and swing copter gameplay.

cards.name: YIPPEE
cards.creator: Enfur
cards.description: Enfur's first 2.2 level which uses a rainbow theme and is much more accessible than their other levels. YIPPEE!!!

cards.name: 3ABNCNMOCT6
cards.creator: IIIGamBiTIII
cards.description: Russian for 'Addiction,' this level features unusual cube only gameplay and extremely bright and unsettling story-based decoration.

cards.name: Cybersonic
cards.creator: iMinaY
cards.description: A tribute to all sonic series levels hosted by MinAY! The gameplay, decoration, and song choice are all inspired by the old sonic series levels, with a particular emphasis on HyperSonic's early 2.1 style.

cards.name: XtC
cards.creator: jbooster
cards.description: Very High-CPS based easy extreme with repetitive clicksync gameplay and the second half having heavy resemblance to Game Over/PunchDrunk. Has flashy effects utilizing shaders making it bright and colourful throughout. Name is pronounced 'Ecstasy'.

cards.name: Diligence
cards.creator: Davphla
cards.description: Third and final level of the Ocular Miracle trilogy. Contains the hardest gameplay out of the three, consisting of mildly janky and very learny gameplay paired with somewhat well-aged glow deco.

cards.name: Zettabyte
cards.creator: Jenkins
cards.description: Jenkins level with very unique decoration at the time, and very unique yet awkward gameplay.

cards.name: Stasis
cards.creator: Arraegen
cards.description: Arraegen's entry in the Zeronium CC2 Creator Contest! Uses player colors for the colors of the decoration.

cards.name: doradura
cards.creator: IvashkaUA
cards.description: Cute love-themed level with amazing decoration and click-sync, flow based gameplay. Some transitions can be an issue for some.

cards.name: Deception Dive
cards.creator: Rustam
cards.description: Deceptively simple beginning until the difficulty spikes in the second half. Nerve wracking as a result.

cards.name: Reanimate
cards.creator: ilnm
cards.description: A modern reimagining of Reanimation by Terron. Has a wide variety of high quality glow design decoration styles and replaces the original 2.0 gameplay and bossfights with high energy flow clicksync gameplay. Fairly well received.

cards.name: Crowd Control
cards.creator: Deadlox
cards.description: Iconic for its challenging wave in the beginning, and very precise ship.

cards.name: OXI
cards.creator: Sycro
cards.description: Incredibly bouncy and erratic black & white solo extreme, with song representation focused visuals and very learny high-cps gameplay. Consists of ahead-of-its-time shader and camera controls as well as a very unique atmosphere. Surprisingly was Sycro's first level in 5 and a half years, beginning development pre-2.2.

cards.name: Air Tech
cards.creator: Elevens
cards.description: A remake of Sky Tech, containing updated decoration that is also quite colorful. This remake retains a similar gameplay style, though it buffs the wave segments of Sky Tech by quite a bit.

cards.name: Elite Z Rebirth
cards.creator: KrmaL
cards.description: Remake of the old impossible level Elite Z. Primarily known for the infamous two-player straight fly and the "So Pro?" UFO spam.

cards.name: CYCLONE
cards.creator: BIANOX
cards.description: Short level that's fairly chokepoints heavy, most notably Jenkins' extremely fast part.

cards.name: Soundwave
cards.creator: Polarbeahr
cards.description: A level inspired by volume and made as an attribute to Metalface. Boost a couple similarities to Volume, most notably having a pretty difficult wave section in the middle of the level.

cards.name: FanTasticLand
cards.creator: therealshun
cards.description: Strange, poorly received modern extreme from 2020 that has been described as a superbuffed 4 star.

cards.name: Polish Alphabet
cards.creator: AxolotlCamellia
cards.description: A remake of Alphabet X by a group of Polish creators. Known for a double blue orb timing that appears in the level multiple times.

cards.name: TROLLMACHINE
cards.creator: TROLLM4CHINE
cards.description: Red glow layout style clicksync level, based on phonk memes and as such featuring a lot of trollfaces. Very tightly synced, and known for it's hard duals.

cards.name: STRATUS
cards.creator: Woom
cards.description: The first Legendary rated extreme demon. An energetic, high quality megacollab with a signature green style. Gameplay is fast paced and engaging, and so learny at times that it borders on memory.

cards.name: night party
cards.creator: Rlol
cards.description: A 28 person megacollab made as the last level ever made by Rlol. The decoration is colorful and reminiscent of party lights. The gameplay and song reflect this, being fast-paced and energetic. Has a notable lack of cohesion between parts creating a chaotic but light hearted, fun atmosphere

cards.name: FinKor
cards.creator: Mulpan
cards.description: A very large megacollab featuring many Finnish and Korean creators. The decoration and gameplay vary a lot throughout the three minute runtime, but much of the difficulty is condensed into a few chokepoints.

cards.name: Duplication
cards.creator: Zeptoz
cards.description: A fast-paced, learny megacollab. The level is praised for its decoration, having detailed designs and effects, enhanced by the extremely vivid rainbow color scheme.

cards.name: UltraSans
cards.creator: PlebKingdom
cards.description: Surprisingly high quality joke remake of Ultrasonic, featuring an extension consisting of multiple other sonic series inspired parts. Every part in the level is made by Sans Undertale.

cards.name: UNG
cards.creator: An Gyung
cards.description: The hardest level in the An Gyung trilogy. It is mostly fast-paced with a slower predrop. The beginning is considered the hardest part, containing many awkward chokepoints.

cards.name: Obscura
cards.creator: eridani
cards.description: Cavern themed art megacollab featuring timing based gameplay in the first half of the level and fast paced click sync based gameplay in the second half. Used to be harder than Eternal Moment, but received a major nerfdate when it fell out of the top 150.

cards.name: CICADA3302
cards.creator: Darwin
cards.description: An effect layout masterpiece spanning over 7 minutes long. The gameplay is mostly comprised of learny clicksync, which intensifies as the level progresses. The level is themed around an unsolved internet ARG, Cicada 3301, with many easter eggs and QR codes scattered throughout the level referencing the puzzles. Received a bugfix update which made it become one of the most enjoyed extremes in the game.

cards.name: Color Beam
cards.creator: Bizaare
cards.description: Bizaare's ode to the simpler side of Geometry Dash. An xl memory level using deliberately simple designs and subtle effects, and prioritising song representation above all else.

cards.name: Explosion
cards.creator: Eternaswip
cards.description: A remake of Lit Fuse, in which the gameplay and decoration are practically identical to its predecessor. With the first half being much harder, this could be considered one of the most nerve-wracking entry extremes.

cards.name: Allegiance
cards.creator: nikroplays
cards.description: Colorful dark level and the second level of the Dedication Series, with most of its difficulty in the middle parts.

cards.name: The Gins II
cards.creator: Doggie
cards.description: A first-half heavy sequel that's based off of a comedy-horror film of the same name. Features a variety of different fast-paced gameplay types, including a bossfight at 70%.

cards.name: Vertigo (PAHC)
cards.creator: PAHC
cards.description: Most notable for its random offset gimmick, where the gameplay is offset from the visible decoration. Most of the difficulty comes from the gimmick, making this one of the most unique easy extremes. Due to the nature of the gimmick and how much easier this level is when fully visible, liveplay is required when submitting.

cards.name: Jail Break
cards.creator: RadScorpionGD
cards.description: Solo extreme with over 200 hours of editor work where you break out of prison and traverse through forests and cityscapes as you attempt to escape the police. Its gameplay is full of gamemode switches and has a few camera gimmicks, and the deco has many easter eggs.

cards.name: Existentia
cards.creator: namirashik
cards.description: "sorry for gameplay lol"

cards.name: HyperSonic
cards.description: Well known megacollab.  Consists of overall awkward gameplay, but can also be pretty fun.

cards.name: CITYFADE
cards.creator: MaxxoRMeN
cards.description: A city themed level with unusual dreamy landscapes and whimsical nature. Very chill but nerve racking gameplay with a vertical part and a fully randomised part in the middle of the level. Enjoy the walk before those beautiful cities get destroyed in the disaster!

cards.name: Just DANCE
cards.creator: Texic
cards.description: Was formerly way harder and poorly received, after the update its just poorly received now.

cards.name: geography dash
cards.creator: MWZN
cards.description: A four and a half minute long level, going through the countries of the world. Made and verified solo, on an ipad

cards.name: Light Travel
cards.creator: dongchi
cards.description: A nine minute long extreme with simple but very effective yellow decoration and great song representation. Contains mostly slow paced and easy gameplay, but has some difficult dual parts, a hard last wave, and lots of fixed hitboxes. A true test of endurance and nerve control.

cards.name: THE GLITCHTON (Solo)
cards.creator: RanOutOfUsers
cards.description: Solo-intended 2p extreme, solo created by ranoutofusers. The deco is extremely bright and colourful, with the gameplay being 2nd half carried. This was users' first rate after getting 95 sends in total.

cards.name: LOOSE ENDS
cards.creator: para
cards.description: The second half is a bit harder than the first

cards.name: Expedition
cards.creator: ClingingBog
cards.description: A cozy click sync timing extreme with a drop that has a good variety of gamemode choices as you go higher in the skies. The second half of the level has a tricky cube/robot break section, with the final part, including a swing copter section, that takes you to the stars.

cards.name: Melon River
cards.creator: ivyteal
cards.description: An upbeat and unique 2.2 collab themed entirely around watermelons, with many of the contributions within the level being made in a creator contest. Contains mostly gimmicky gameplay, and notably has a hooping part towards the middle of the level, with the middle third also happening to be the learniest section of the level.

cards.name: V O L L E Y
cards.creator: IcyWindy
cards.description: A colorful and upbeat minute-long extreme demon that uses only the ball gamemode for the entirety of the level. The level utilizes various game mechanics, such as turning the ball into a old-fashioned swingcopter in the middle half as well as using the move trigger to make a pink orb follow the player during the final part. Due to the ball gamemode's limitations, the gameplay is creative and unorthodox.

cards.name: My Own Funeral
cards.creator: //sayonar.
cards.description: A red effect solo extreme with an unsettling atmosphere. Contains a short memory section in the second half.

cards.name: Twilight Spire
cards.creator: Ice Rod
cards.description: An older Loltad layout decorated in 2.2 by Loltad and IceRod. Features complex memory gameplay and uses the second half of Theory of Everything 2. Perhaps most notable for receiving an incredible twelve 100s in a row on EDEL. One of the most enjoyed extremes.

cards.name: Matilda the Machine
cards.creator: Jeyzor
cards.description: Very raw Jeyzor level with extremely hard duals and a funny bossfight at the end.

cards.name: Doop
cards.creator: WormFodder
cards.description: Megacollab featuring a variety of skillsets, but has a major difficulty spike in the final wave and ship. Has some long UFO gravity portal worms and a rather goofy song.

cards.name: Virtual Collapse
cards.creator: TeamUprising
cards.description: A beginner extreme with fast-paced flowy and learny gameplay by TeamUprising that uses a mix of all gamemodes. The difficulty of the gameplay increases near the end. Its glow-style decoration is prominently pink, purple and blue in its coloring and has a technological theming. Has a high object count of 256k.

cards.name: Thunder Alphabet
cards.creator: AxolotlCamellia
cards.description: Very similar to polish alphabet, but more fun and learny duals.

cards.name: Redemption
cards.creator: Zest
cards.description: Beginner extreme Sonic Wave remake built by Zest as redemption for hacking Sonic Wave three years prior. Features significantly altered gameplay compared to the other remakes, including ship and UFO sections at the drop in reference to the original pre-update Sonic Wave. Generally the most well received extreme sonic wave remake.

cards.name: The Flawless
cards.creator: fin
cards.description: Very old hell level that predates Yatagarasu, with precise timings and some fast ship parts. May not quite live up to its name.

cards.name: Robi
cards.creator: robianny
cards.description: Slow placed medium length modern extreme demon that's paired with an equally slow and relaxing song. Incredibly easy to pick up and learn with it having lots of timings and ship control and is generally liked despite it being known for having chokepoints.

cards.name: SORRYNOTSORRY
cards.creator: culobTV
cards.description: Very pink level built as the creator's first finished deco project, a level where you must party without being caught by the eyeball police. Contains many different kinds of gameplay and is generally well received.

cards.name: Castling
cards.creator: Meroo
cards.description: A fast paced level with multiple insane chokepoints, most notably the 4% 240hz frame perfect, the 69% blind click, and the wave gaps at 63% and 74%. Was somehow formerly rated Insane Demon, and became an insider meme on the Insane Demon List.

cards.name: BROOKLYNBLOODPOP
cards.creator: StarkytheSalad
cards.description: Bright rainbow design extreme known for its iconic hyperpop song and easily recognizable party-like visuals by StarkyTheSalad. The gameplay is well-received, consisting of learny & well-synced cube sections and clever fakes.

cards.name: EdenCity
cards.creator: NateFH
cards.description: An electric and futuristic city-themed collaboration with distinct parts, bright colors and a mixture of detailed designs and effects. The gameplay is regarded as being rather learny thanks to the complex dual gameplay. There are also chokepoints throughout, notably the dual ship at the 60% mark.

cards.name: The Ultimate Demon
cards.creator: vit12
cards.description: A “demon mix” type of level with around 40 seconds of gameplay with a lot of popular extremes, such as Acheron, Firework and Bloodbath with clean but simple decoration made in 2.1 by the content creator Vit12. The level contains several chokepoints and is first-half carried. It’s also the prequel to The Ultimate Return.

cards.name: MELTDOWN
cards.creator: Darwin
cards.description: Darwin solo extreme from mid 2.1 reminiscent of Rupture, ToE2 and Blast Processing. Most well known for its absurd ship chokepoint at the drop, and the rest of the level plays more like an insane demon.

cards.name: Helios
cards.creator: Canonlaw
cards.description: Early 2.1 purple & yellow megacollab with memorably well-received gameplay for its time. Features typical glow decoration paired with a song from Terraria's Calamity Mod.

cards.name: POINTIERCRATE
cards.creator: Astrala
cards.description: A solo extreme using only spikes for decoration! Features unusual gameplay, including a diagonal asymmetrical ship.

cards.name: NEBULA
cards.creator: Lykoz
cards.description: Flashy pink & blue megacollab featuring incredibly learny and frantic gameplay and a nebulous space theme. Notably difficult to learn for an easy extreme but satisfying to complete.

cards.name: Liz
cards.creator: issanagay
cards.description: A skill based flow level with an outdoor theme featuring many asymmetrical duals and hard waves. Features some challenging wave chokepoints in the first half, difficult duals throughout, and ends with a challenging click consistency dual wave. Also features an Undertale remix, meaning you may have a bad time...

cards.name: Uprise
cards.creator: Blad3M
cards.description: 2.0 level which has chokepoints and bugs scattered through out, the most iconic of which is the extremely hard wave with a random UFO break in the middle of it.

cards.name: violetwall
cards.creator: kaacu
cards.description: 1.9 styled Flamewall inspired extreme, now in violet! Uses the final two minutes of the song, and features near non-stop fast paced gameplay, with a difficulty increase in the second half. Activating the LDM makes the decoration pure 1.9, while the full detail version has some 2.2 features. Enable shake at own risk...

cards.name: Realtered
cards.creator: Elevens
cards.description: A predominantly skill-based beginner extreme which was worked on for 8 months. Features colourful design decoration and a very upbeat song by Waterflame. Has all-around gameplay with the hardest part generally being considered the dual section from 58% to 70%.

cards.name: Clarity
cards.creator: Hypno
cards.description: An upbeat solo extreme taking inspiration from numerous design creators and featuring the popular pop song of the same name. Has some learny and unusual but well synced gameplay and a very complex dual at the end.

cards.name: Tung Tung Sahurcles
cards.creator: Arraegen
cards.description: A Nine Circles extreme themed of the AI-generated character Tung Tung Tung Sahur. Notable for having a bossfight where the Triple T tries to hit the player with his baseball bat, for the gameplay having repetitive click-sync based gameplay, and for the creator being known for composing the song and building the entire level all by himself.

cards.name: Dark Odyssey
cards.creator: JonathanGD
cards.description: A solo level originally made for the GDS Creator Contest, though it missed the submission deadline. As a remake of and sequel to Dark Travel, it has a similar structure while significantly improving on decoration in each section.

cards.name: Cosmorush 21
cards.creator: Pennutoh
cards.description: A very old 2.0 level with poorly aged decoration but better gameplay. Has a complex asymmetrical dual in the first half. One of the oldest sync focused extremes.

cards.name: Make It Drop
cards.creator: ryamu
cards.description: Very purple and green, and the gameplay consists of fast paced click sync, which can be pretty fun. Somehow its XL even though it doesnt feel that long.

cards.name: Stop Breathing
cards.creator: NikVer
cards.description: Intimidating beginner extreme using Stop Breathing by Playboy Carti as it's song. Features chokepointy ship gameplay while the decoration uses a Whole Lotta Red™

cards.name: Plasmatic
cards.creator: JumpingTheory
cards.description: Former IDL Top 1 before being promoted to extreme demon. It's decoration is a modern rainbow 1.9 styled with 2.1 elements. The gameplay is a bit unbalanced, containing a hard cube drop, a high CPS ball, a kind of mindblockable wave and a wacky dual at the end.

cards.name: Cerebral Torment
cards.creator: SirpotatOwO
cards.description: A solo extreme demon that has very bizarre, unconventional yet intriguing art decoration attached with a heavy amount of variety. The gameplay matches this decoration style by being heavily unorthodox.

cards.name: Place
cards.creator: Spu7Nix
cards.description: A massive community project started by Spu7Nix, inspired by r/place. Built by over 14,000 players, this is one of the largest Geometry Dash collabs to ever be made, with countless ways to get through the level.

cards.name: Reverie
cards.creator: GaidenHertuny
cards.description: The first part of the Ocular Miracle Trilogy, featuring stunning decoration for the time and fast paced gameplay. Has some janky sections in the mid parts and most notably entirely lacks a drop. A former misrated insane demon until 2024, it reigned as a formidable IDL top 5, including time at top 1, for many years before being finally promoted.

cards.name: 8o X
cards.creator: f3lixsram
cards.description: A harder remake of 8o, keeping the same formatting as the original level. The decoration features more glow and effects, while keeping the same simplistic block design.

cards.name: Ion
cards.creator: shmigels
cards.description: A 1.6 styled level started in early 2.1 and finished in 2.2. Known for being one of the best ship based beginner extremes. Has an asymmetrical dual in the middle and a hard Electrodynamix / 8o style ending ship.

cards.name: WHITE LIGHT
cards.creator: kreno
cards.description: Solo extreme by Kreno set to the Gorillaz song of the same name. Has a fully greyscale colour scheme and skill based gameplay.

cards.name: Cold Level Go BRRRR
cards.creator: MrSupremeGD
cards.description: An extreme demon with a light-hearted frosty theming, having vibrant and varied shades of blue as well as a mixture of effect and design decoration. The gameplay is fast-paced and features all-around learny gameplay.

cards.name: Final Round
cards.creator: SleyGD
cards.description: Extremely short extreme primarily inspired by Deadlocked. Known for having tough ship chokepoints and a brutal last wave, and also allows you to take multiple swag routes for increased aura points.

cards.name: Grand Eclipse
cards.creator: BloomOcean
cards.description: A high quality megacollab by the BloomOcean team themed around the solar eclipse and the mythology surrounding it.

cards.name: Forbidden Isle
cards.creator: Sillow
cards.description: Sillow extreme demon which, like their others, consists of mostly skill based gameplay, mostly wave and ship.

cards.name: Aimbotter Force
cards.creator: Aimbotter2123
cards.description: An XL Hexagon Force remake using the second half of the song. Features a long asymmetrical dual in the second half with lots of swingcopter gameplay using unusual gamemodes.

cards.name: The Lost Existence
cards.creator: JonathanGD
cards.description: A 5 minute XL level created for the #levelution movement during 2.1. The gameplay is mostly comprised of timings and clicksync with a sharp difficulty spike in the middle of the level.

cards.name: Insaction
cards.creator: Byboy11
cards.description: An XL early 2.1 level made by mostly relatively unknown creators. Used to be much more unbalanced and buggy before receiving an update in 2022.

cards.name: OVERDRIVE (smango23)
cards.creator: smango23
cards.description: A high CPS level with fast energetic gameplay and plenty of wave parts. Featuring a very bright and vibrant modern style and crystalline structures. Solo made and verified by the creator over the course of a year.

cards.name: Hollow
cards.creator: QuazeryIceCube
cards.description: A unique minimalistic memory level using simple but effective block structures on a dark background. The gameplay is very freeform, and the large maze at the end has an immeasurable number of possible routes.

cards.name: verisimilitude
cards.creator: whlt
cards.description: A very quirky timings focused level with many gimmicks. Has many fake spikes in the beginning spider and the brutal ending ball. Only has two ships, with one being very orb focused, and the other skill focused. Is very second half heavy with the second ship and the ball carrying most of the difficulty.

cards.name: Malevolent
cards.creator: PlaEnterprise
cards.description: A 1.9 styled level, made in 2.2, that is slightly based on Dry Out, containing gameplay that prioritizes cube timings along with ship, ball, and UFO parts. Even though is considered as an easy extreme demon, contains an infamous 80hz frame perfect at 71% during the UFO part, giving approximately 3 frames on 240 FPS to jump the gap, also mentioning that the level feels a bit awkward to play intentionally.

cards.name: Pro Lov Ad
cards.creator: Wyntaee
cards.description: 6 minute solo memory extreme using the entirety of the eponymous Sweet Trip song, and featuring high quality early 2000s WindowsXP style deco inspired by the album cover. Has mostly 2.2 physics memory ship gameplay through its runtime, and has an unusual alternating blind clicksync wave as well as other gimmicks. Made memory through it's confusing, constantly moving, and highly obscured gameplay (Including hiding your icon behind jumpingcat3.png).

cards.name: phantasmagoria (whlt)
cards.creator: whlt
cards.description: whlt's first solo extreme. It's extremely short at only 40 seconds long, and has pastel-colored effect decoration. The gameplay syncs well with the song and consists of 4 parts, with the gimmick of each part being increasingly difficult as the level goes on.

cards.name: smohcs
cards.creator: durianhead
cards.description: The long standing top 1 on the Insane Demon List before getting promoted. A 1.9 memory level built to showcase the update's capabilities instead of trying to look like a 1.9 level. Has two endings, though the 'good ending' requires a tough frame perfect timing far into the level.

cards.name: Cataclysm
cards.creator: GgB0y
cards.description: One of the most well known extreme demons. The first level in the Apocalyptic trilogy. Consists of a lot of difficult ship parts and an extremely hard beginning wave.

cards.name: my worst level
cards.creator: MrPoopyBurger
cards.description: Colorful modern extreme with wave and ship-centric clicksync gameplay. Described by the creator as a simple "idea dump" while also having a pretty arguable name.

cards.name: Lost Love
cards.creator: TheBlackHell
cards.description: Bright and effect-based memory extreme demon loosely themed around heartbreak. Consists of very well-received memory gameplay and hazy, atmospheric backgrounds. Definitely a fantastic introduction to memory extremes!

cards.name: Melancholy
cards.creator: Shulkern
cards.description: Dark and emotional XXL+ solo level with minimalistic but effective decoration. Nearly entirely greyscale, but gains a small but meaningful amount of colour at the second drop. The gameplay is heavily endurance based, and has multiple split paths and frequent timings. Took 4 years to get featured.

cards.name: A Fleeting Reverie
cards.creator: exscher
cards.description: Exscher's first serious attempt at getting a rated level. An insanely detailed art level with some small two player segments.

cards.name: Twitch Denan
cards.creator: Kapycta999
cards.description: An extreme with a theming around the streaming platform which is featured in its pre-drop and ending; it otherwise features purple-colored glow decoration. Contains flowy and learny gameplay with the wave parts being most prevalent in difficulty.

cards.name: Komodo
cards.creator: Espii
cards.description: An extreme that was formerly #1 on the Insane Demon list. Originally made in 2.0, though was reworked in 2.1. Features a mostly red and orange color scheme with its simpler decoration style. The gameplay is all-around with its gamemodes, though the wave parts can prove quite a challenge.

cards.name: Supernova
cards.creator: royen
cards.description: A beginner 1.9PS extreme demon megacollab. Manages to capture the essence of old megacollabs such as Supersonic with its varied decoration styles. Has an all-around fast-paced gameplay style with difficult ship and old swingcopter sections. Each part was built only after the previous part had been completed.

cards.name: Voluto
cards.creator: Sruj
cards.description: A beginner extreme demon worked on for several years with its decoration focusing on a colorful glow design style with a mixture of some effects. The flowy gameplay has a mixture of pacing with the first 33% generally being considered the hardest section.

cards.name: Gangnam Style
cards.creator: skorchxp
cards.description: Oppa Gangnam Style! Traditional 1.9 style megacollab using the full song, making it over 3 minutes long and tough on the nerves. Features a rather mean last click...

cards.name: goober land
cards.creator: APTbutAwesome
cards.description: Beginner extreme megacollab featuring multiple steamhappy cameos and a very silly tone overall.

cards.name: GLISTEN
cards.creator: Squizaaard
cards.description: Short timing level focused on clicking exactly to the songs beat, Typically well received due to being very satisfying.

cards.name: Destination 19
cards.creator: bosjoker
cards.description: Predecessor to the ex-list extreme Destruction 19, featuring hinds-styled 2.0 decoration created for Wod's 2.0 CC in 2022. Contains pretty modest visuals with vibrant colors at the drop, and a very very tricky ending. Surprisingly well-received despite its janky timings.

cards.name: IGAKU
cards.creator: ReymundoTK
