cards.description: Predominantly greyscale modern level with a Kasane Teto song! Contains some confusing memory parts and a few camera flips.

cards.name: Shotgun
cards.creator: SpinStudios
cards.description: An extreme demon by the large creation team SpinStudios, which gives it a very varying glow decoration style emphasising effects and design with a mostly red and orange color scheme. Contains flowy and fast paced gameplay with difficult wave sections.

cards.name: Alcatraz
cards.creator: Asuith
cards.description: Formerly a normal early 2.1 Extreme Demon, but due to some updates the level has pretty much become the equivalent to a griefed Minecraft server. Video showcase is of the latest version.

cards.name: eclipse
cards.creator: vit12
cards.description: Very bright and intense space rainbow level in Vit12's signature style. Also contains Vit's signature simple, skillbased gameplay style which can be divisive, though this time with better transitions and playtesting.

cards.name: 9blue
cards.creator: Sardina
cards.description: Very late 2.1 extreme demon collab that features blue/purple glow and flow visuals. The gameplay contains a lot of fast-paced, high CPS and clicksync sections as well as being unbalanced, with difficult spider parts at the start, followed by an easier second half.

cards.name: Cognitive Capacity
cards.creator: Griffin128
cards.description: A 1.9 themed remake of Thinking Space with significantly easier gameplay. The level consists of much of the same gameplay with a few changes to spice up the gameplay. Staying true to the original, the level still contains the same second-half carried gameplay as Thinking Space. Has a very nice player color decoration.

cards.name: Hazy Memories
cards.creator: oleki
cards.description: Complex & intuitive memory extreme with unconventional, flowy gameplay. Features unique gameplay tropes like breakable blocks and a ship section controlled by a green orb. Gameplay is extremely well-received.

cards.name: FEEL ALIVE
cards.creator: Loc9e
cards.description: A passion project megacollab hosted by Loc9e over 6 years in the making! Features Woogi inspired decoration with tasteful usage of glow, and a Porter Robinson song mashup. The gameplay is very well received and features learny/memory sections and a handful of duals. The 85% pink orb is not as hard as it used to be.

cards.creator: AranyaDeCueva
cards.description: Medium length megacollab that is surprisingly 1.9 themed. Has an ancient level ID that was updated.

cards.name: Shimmering Chamber
cards.creator: Devilmine
cards.description: Extreme demon with a consistent glow decoration style that shifts colors throughout. Has timings-based gameplay with there being a difficulty spike at the ending.

cards.name: Azurite (Sillow)
cards.creator: Sillow
cards.description: A skill-based Extreme Demon comprised of heavy wave and ship gameplay, as well as some fake orbs and somewhat difficult timings. Notably a very popular beginner Extreme, due to the gameplay being relatively straightforward and easy to learn.

cards.name: Paralysis
cards.creator: thazm
cards.description: Unorthodox extreme with a slow pre-drop which heightens in both pace and difficulty at the drop with the waves being the hardest parts. The effects are very flashy and aim to obscure the player's vision.

cards.name: Flappy Dynamix II
cards.creator: RadiationV2
cards.description: A short and intense UFO-only extreme. Has distinct segments with differing styles of effect decoration. Contains very unorthodox and learny gameplay, including 2P and a boss fight section.

cards.name: Final Epilogue
cards.creator: Pennutoh
cards.description: The last extreme demon from 2.0. Each section is styled after one of Pennutoh's other levels, and as such they vary a lot. Its gameplay is learny and fast-paced, and has all-round balancing.

cards.name: The Depths Above
cards.creator: Bram4Real
cards.description: A solo extreme themed around the game Outer Wilds. The gameplay is gimmicky with some hard timings and varying gravity, and there's a minigame section based on the game before the drop.

cards.name: Crimson Citadel
cards.creator: Ryder
cards.description: A remake to ZenthicAlpha's hard demon, Crimson Chamber. Heavily revamps the gameplay with 2.2 mechanics, and updates the decoration while staying true to the original. The gameplay balancing is all-around with some difficult dual sections.

cards.name: bunnies i guess
cards.creator: ciibule
cards.description: The sequel to KISMET, this time around themed around cute bunnies! (i guess). Has a few double clicks and a lot hard waves/ships.

cards.name: mischievousmechanism
cards.creator: fuze
cards.description: A design deco factory-themed extreme demon, with many different unique gimmicks throughout. The difficulty is heavily carried by the wave section at 66%, and it's overall very learny.

cards.name: UNLEASH WHALE WHALES
cards.creator: kovosrutek
cards.description: Almost two minutes of pure silent clubstep cube maze. Be very afraid...

cards.name: Artificial Climb
cards.creator: Rynoxious
cards.description: A red and gray-colored beginner megacollab extreme that captures the style of old 2.0 levels with both its decoration being influenced by Artificial Ideology, and its unconventional gameplay style. The gameplay itself is all-around, though the wave parts are slightly more difficult.

cards.name: Decay
cards.creator: KiwiPenguin
cards.description: A well-received slow-paced extreme demon with vibrant colors with eye-catching, glitchy effects, and a route around the start that changes the colour scheme. The gameplay is precision-based timings built with no spikes, which can take getting used to but do get consistent.

cards.name: TANTRUM
cards.creator: DanZmeN
cards.description: A megacollab hosted by DanZmeN and verified by Golden, featuring tricky, fast-paced timings, difficult wave sections and overall janky gameplay. Has an infamous mini-wave at the end of the level.

cards.name: Fun Friday
cards.creator: Zeronium
cards.description: A Zeronium solo level themed around FUN FRIDAY! Where many fun things can happen, on a Friday. Contains multiple references to fun and silly things from Zeronium's streams.

cards.name: Wavetrip
cards.creator: BombCraft2010
cards.description: Four minute wave only extreme that gets faster and more intense as the level progresses. Despite being an all wave level, the majority of the difficulty comes from consistency and nerve control.

cards.name: Sephtis
cards.creator: deThe
cards.description: An extreme similar to Reverence, with flowy gameplay and red and blue effecty glow decoration. The gameplay is learny and carried by the wave segments, with several bugs and chokepoints throughout the level.

cards.name: Mystic Bounds
cards.creator: gmdmann
cards.description: Extremely long and well received level with pixel decoration and an intense song. Features mostly clicksync based gameplay, and has a hard dual in the second half.

cards.name: Mizureta
cards.creator: dutchiee
cards.description: A reta-styled extreme which takes much aspects in decoration and gameplay from the levels it is styled upon. The gameplay is typical of a level of its style: highly flowy and features a lot of clicksync. A lot of the difficulty is condensed into the middle sections. Took a couple of years for it to get rated.

cards.name: Misty Mountains
cards.creator: We4therMan
cards.description: Well known atmospheric XL level with generally slow low cps timing based gameplay and a dual at the end. Has a long cutscene at the start.

cards.name: Freedom16
cards.creator: DShifter
cards.description: Freedom08 remake built entirely in the 1.6 editor. Showcases a variety of deco and gameplay styles throughout its 4 minute length, however sacrifices some of its intensity as the entire level is in 1x speed.

cards.name: niwa
cards.creator: Teno
cards.description: Very well known easy reta style extreme with the typical fast paced flow gameplay, purple glow decoration, and Yoasobi song. One of the most popular beginner extremes.

cards.name: Without U
cards.creator: NoobyPro27
cards.description: Extremely high-quality extreme demon that is very well-received. Contains intense and overall complex gameplay which makes it learny, especially the dual segments. Also features a gimmick nearing the end where eight heart shards must be collected in order to complete the level.

cards.name: JeonGi
cards.creator: Lebi06
cards.description: Electricity themed solo with simple design and effects, and a mixture of clicksync and timing based gameplay. Despite receiving a large nerf, it is highly unbalanced. Most of the difficulty comes from the middle sections and the very hard wave near the end. (verification video was privated/deleted)

cards.name: Prismatic
cards.creator: CatGeo
cards.description: Long and cute rainbow coloured extreme with an equally playful song. Mostly timing based, especially in the spider sections, but also features a hard dual and a challenge-like first wave. Has multiple double clicks.

cards.name: Devils Disco
cards.creator: SodaZ
cards.description: A very well-received extreme demon. The fast-paced, all-around gameplay of the level is highly learny and requires high CPS. The decoration is colorful, and it focuses on vibrant designs and effects which add to the intensity of the level.

cards.name: ReVolution Unleashed
cards.creator: WayAway04
cards.description: An extreme demon which has a very well-regarded theming of a desolate and decaying urban world captured through its purely greyscale coloring, design and art decoration style and the very fitting song-choice. The gameplay has been criticised for feeling tedious.

cards.name: Erosion
cards.creator: Vizitek
cards.description: Sequel to the insane demon Corrosion. The decoration is of a similar style to its predecessor, altered to reflect the heightened intensity of the song. Builds off of Corrosion's gameplay through an increase in difficult timings, a faster pace and higher complexity through the use of 2.2 mechanics.

cards.name: 4 Matilda
cards.creator: Jeyzor
cards.description: The final level in the For Matilda series. Features a mixture of design and art decoration which makes every segment distinct. The gameplay is timings-based and has an unconventional style. The final part of the level is a precise minigame section where multiple cubes have differing zooms and angles.

cards.name: lezicuv
cards.creator: Step4enko
cards.description: 2.0 level based on the infamous hack verified ozpectro levels, it has been subject to a multitude of buffs over the years, and is now known for awkward gameplay and two absurd predrop triple spikes.

cards.name: ANNIHILATED
cards.creator: AlvaroPaws :3
cards.description: The sequel to the insane demon DESTROYED which expands on its dual gameplay with a longer level length and has an overall higher CPS. Its high-quality design decoration features a very similar theme to its predecessor where you flee a burning facility that's being destroyed.
cards.note: Value is near impossible to settle

cards.name: Me Lin A
cards.creator: nickxd
cards.description: A sequel to insane demon Lin Anya. Features mostly all-around learny gameplay, though the ship is more prominent than the other gamemodes. The level mixes design, art and effect decoration with its vibrant and colorful glow style.

cards.name: memories III
cards.description: Dorami hosted megacollab featuring parts inspired by old popular levels, in a similar style to Idols. Known for having very challenging dual chokepoints.

cards.name: Pentakill
cards.creator: WOOGI1411
cards.description: An extreme demon collaboration between Xaro and WOOGI1411 from all the way back in 2.0 that took several years to get rated. Contains colorful decoration that is standard of the time. The gameplay is all-around and learny, with several chokepoints. My Eye :(

cards.name: Bang Gang (2P)
cards.creator: DanZmeN
cards.description: The first 2-player extreme in Geometry Dash. Was verified by four different people swapping positions mid-completion. The decoration is in DanZmeN's typicial 2019 style. Features learny segments and a bossfight with arrows that are not entirely accurate.

cards.name: Based Gang (2P)
cards.creator: Alph
cards.description: A 2-player level that takes inspiration from Bang Gang. In order to make it more feasible to beat it solo, the final 20% can be nerfed in exchange for not getting the coin.

cards.name: Raindance
cards.creator: Milos482
cards.description: 2019 design-style extreme demon megacollab that lacks a coherent theme. The gameplay is all-around and fast-paced. The ending segment can be a significant chokepoint, as the wave and ship in it are more challenging than the previous segments.

cards.name: BRUTAL
cards.creator: TShack
cards.description: Very short, looksmaxxing-themed beginner extreme, barely over half a minute long. Inspired by Cobwebs and Future Chaos, it features fast-paced flow gameplay with some tough ship and wave parts and high-quality design deco. Has quickly become one of the most popular extremes in the game despite still being very new.

cards.name: BRAINWASH
cards.creator: plxzTM
cards.description: A well-received medium-length extreme which contains a mixture of memory gameplay and timings throughout. The decoration emphasises design and is prominently blue with its coloring. Features a very memorable transition at the 71% mark. Has no wave and very minimal ship, making this a very accessible first extreme to low refresh rate users.

cards.name: troll level
cards.creator: Lexycat
cards.description: One of the more popular beginner extremes. Very light-hearted and unconventional in its structuring and colorful decoration style. The gameplay mixes memory gameplay with some precise timings. It also gives the player the freedom of having multiple paths to choose from, especially after the pre-drop.

cards.name: The Winged Sword
cards.creator: Will1
cards.description: A 1.9-style solo extreme with various styles of decoration throughout. Has generally skill-based ship and timings gameplay, with a difficult dual part at the drop.

cards.name: tran la luot
cards.creator: emily419
cards.description: A solo extreme that's the sequel to the medium demon 'nguyen bang qua'. Very experimental with its decoration with intense flashes and colors. The timing-heavy gameplay starts off with a slower-pace which quickens in its learny second-half.

cards.name: Jumping Demons
cards.creator: Smarted
cards.description: A solo extreme by smarted, themed as a lost pilot animation made in the analog VHS era, inspired by the Jumping Devils song animation. The deco has a lot of custom lineart and effects. The gameplay consists of sync-based duals, and changes direction a lot throughout the level.

cards.name: Horros (2P)
cards.creator: Shrc
cards.description: A 2-player level that has no consistent theme, as there is "no sense of continuity in dreams". For 2-player play it is borderline extreme demon gameplay, and has been rated as insane demon in the past.

cards.name: the super hotdog
cards.creator: AWESOMEME360
cards.description: A short and extremely silly rainbow level inspired by The Wiener. Features a hard first cube, clicksync gameplay, heavy shader and camera-trigger use, an incomprehensible spam dual, and, of course, the super hotdog itself. The high CPS/spammy nature of this level's gameplay can make this level difficult to approach if you are beating this as one of your first extreme demons.

cards.name: Fallen Horizon
cards.creator: chloechu
cards.description: An extreme demon focused on ship, timings and swingcopter gameplay that is highly received, with a satisfying flow. The art decoration has a theming of a submerged and overgrown city that the player falls into after the first third.

cards.name: SIGSEGV
cards.description: An extended remake of the 30 second long "Segmentation Fault." A highly unique extreme using only the cube gamemode but in unusual and gimmicky ways. This includes a maximum click section and many parts where an orb is taped to your cube. The strange gameplay is accompanied by appropriately unusual effects.

cards.name: Sweater Weather
cards.creator: VelYT
cards.description: A solo remake of the unrated hard demon "Unfound Emotions" with near-identical base gameplay. Its decoration style is similar, but it also introduces tasteful colour usage, especially in the drop to contrast it from the more grayscale predrop and ending. Despite its difficulty often being debated over extreme or insane demon, its ship parts are especially challenging for its difficulty.

cards.name: squeak
cards.creator: chloechu
cards.description: squeak (cute clicksync level featuring mostly cube and spider gameplay)

cards.name: Acu
cards.creator: neigefeu
cards.description: The most popular first extreme, for a good reason. Overall extremely well received for its accessible and fun gameplay throughout. Notably very 60hz friendly, and most of the difficulty is near the start and end.

cards.name: Monitor
cards.description: A 3 minute long pure solo extreme using a pixelation effect where each pixel is visibly split into its RGB subpixels, much like how actual monitor screens work. Its base gameplay is relatively simple for its difficulty though it gets more complex in the second half with asymmetrical duals.

cards.name: Through The Decay
cards.creator: spark
cards.description: A slow and peaceful minimalistic level themed around a set of ruins that was impressively built in only 2 hours. Features precision timing gameplay throughout, with lots of corner block jumps.

cards.name: Precipitance
cards.creator: Extravagon
cards.description: A popular beginner solo extreme with colorful glow decoration throughout and a very repetitive song. Features fast-paced, clicksync gameplay with a mixture of gamemodes. Watch out for skipping any orbs, as the level gets angry at you if you do.

cards.name: Red World
cards.creator: saRy
cards.description: The oldest rated extreme demon. Used to be impossible due to an update turning a solid block into a decoration piece, until that was fixed, and the level was rated. Consists of one of the first instances of the swing copter, and some extremely hard ship parts. Generally poorly received, and is not recommended as a first extreme due to its extremely unbalanced, ending carried gameplay.

cards.name: rauchkammer
cards.creator: Devilmine
cards.description: A short, skill-based level made using just three randomly generated colors. The gameplay is straightforward given its easier nature, but it spikes in difficulty with the ship and wave parts towards the second half of the level. rauchkammer is not advised to be beaten as a first extreme, as its gameplay is catered more towards skilled extreme grinders rather than new players.

cards.name: DOUBLE DYNAMO (2P)
cards.creator: spark
cards.description: A gimmicky 2 players level featuring unique parts like the beginning, where the screen moves like an elevator, revealing parts you're about to enter, a symmetrical and asymmetrical ship, a "tax evasion" swing copter (one after another) and a "the prohibited meat" inspired ending (tight ship and wave gameplay with the same path). Considered the easiest extreme demon on the list if you play it with someone, since playing it solo rises the difficulty by a lot.
